items.title: 文化一周 Culture Journal
items.title_zh: 香港美食彩灯

cues.zh: 其中展览香港彩灯会
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 zhan3 lan3 xiang1 gang3 cai3 deng1 hui4
cues.en: One exhibition is the Hong Kong Lantern Festival.

cues.zh: 于华山文创园区展出
cues.pinyin: yu2 hua4 shan1 wen2 chuang4 yuan2 qu1 zhan3 chu1
cues.en: It's held at Huashan Creative Park.

cues.zh: 现场展示许多
cues.pinyin: xian4 chang3 zhan3 shi4 xu3 duo1
cues.en: The exhibition features many lanterns

cues.zh: 以香港道地美食为造型的彩灯
cues.pinyin: yi3 xiang1 gang3 dao4 di4 mei3 shi2 wei4 zao4 xing2 de5 cai3 deng1
cues.en: shaped like Hong Kong's local food.

cues.zh: 有好喝的丝袜奶茶
cues.pinyin: you3 hao3 he1 de5 si1 wa4 nai3 cha2
cues.en: There's delicious silk-stocking milk tea,

cues.zh: 香喷喷的蛋挞
cues.pinyin: xiang1 pen1 pen1 de5 dan4 ta4
cues.en: fragrant egg tarts,

cues.zh: 好吃的菠萝油
cues.pinyin: hao3 chi1 de5 bo1 luo2 you2
cues.en: and tasty pineapple buns with butter.

cues.zh: 哇
cues.pinyin: wa5
cues.en: Wow!

cues.zh: 还有冒着烟的车仔面摊呢
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 mao4 zhe5 yan1 de5 che1 zai3 mian4 tan1 ne5
cues.en: There's even a steaming noodle stall!

items.title: 啾啾妹 CHUCHUMEI
items.title_zh: 住在香港的台湾女孩

cues.zh: 大家好我是啾啾妹
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 jiu1 jiu1 mei4
cues.en: Hi everyone, I'm Chuchumei.

cues.zh: 大家都知道
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: As you all know,

cues.zh: 我是嫁到香港的台湾媳妇
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 jia4 dao4 xiang1 gang3 de5 tai2 wan1 xi2 fu4
cues.en: I'm a Taiwanese woman who married into Hong Kong.

cues.zh: 身为一个在香港生活三年的人
cues.pinyin: shen1 wei4 yi2 ge4 zai4 xiang1 gang3 sheng1 huo2 san1 nian2 de5 ren2
cues.en: After living in Hong Kong for three years,

cues.zh: 会讲一两句广东话
cues.pinyin: hui4 jiang3 yi1 liang3 ju4 guang3 dong1 hua4
cues.en: being able to speak a little Cantonese

cues.zh: 还是很正常的吧
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 hen3 zheng4 chang2 de5 ba5
cues.en: is pretty normal, right?

cues.zh: 虽然不是很流利
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 bu2 shi4 hen3 liu2 li4
cues.en: I'm not very fluent,

cues.zh: 但是日常对话是OK的哦
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ri4 chang2 dui4 hua4 shi4 de5 o2
cues.en: but everyday conversation is fine.

cues.zh: 很多baby咨询我怎么学广东话
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 zi1 xun2 wo3 zen3 me5 xue2 guang3 dong1 hua4
cues.en: Many of you ask how I learned Cantonese.

cues.zh: 今天我就来分享
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 lai2 fen1 xiang3
cues.en: Today I'll share

cues.zh: 我学广东话的神秘历程
cues.pinyin: wo3 xue2 guang3 dong1 hua4 de5 shen2 mi4 li4 cheng2
cues.en: my journey learning Cantonese.

items.title: 啾啾妹 CHUCHUMEI
items.title_zh: 慢慢练习就会进步

cues.zh: 以上就是我学习广东话的经验
cues.pinyin: yi3 shang4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 xue2 xi2 guang3 dong1 hua4 de5 jing1 yan4
cues.en: That's my experience learning Cantonese.

cues.zh: 但语言这种东西
cues.pinyin: dan4 yu3 yan2 zhe4 zhong3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: But when it comes to language,

cues.zh: 每个人吸收力不同
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 xi1 shou1 li4 bu4 tong2
cues.en: everyone learns at a different pace.

cues.zh: 所以也不用太着急啦
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ye3 bu4 yong4 tai4 zhao2 ji2 la5
cues.en: So there's no need to rush.

cues.zh: 一天一天慢慢练习
cues.pinyin: yi1 tian1 yi1 tian1 man4 man4 lian4 xi2
cues.en: Practise a little every day.

cues.zh: 会在不知不觉中进步的
cues.pinyin: hui4 zai4 bu4 zhi1 bu4 jue2 zhong1 jin4 bu4 de5
cues.en: You'll improve without even noticing.

cues.zh: 像我就超想学好英文的
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 jiu4 chao1 xiang3 xue2 hao3 ying1 wen2 de5
cues.en: I really want to improve my English.

cues.zh: 从国小开始学英文
cues.pinyin: cong2 guo2 xiao3 kai1 shi3 xue2 ying1 wen2
cues.en: I started learning English in primary school.

cues.zh: 至今也学了十年了吧
cues.pinyin: zhi4 jin1 ye3 xue2 le5 shi2 nian2 le5 ba5
cues.en: It's been about ten years now.

cues.zh: 那你们留言分享学英文的妙招
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 men5 liu2 yan2 fen1 xiang3 xue2 ying1 wen2 de5 miao4 zhao1
cues.en: Share your English-learning tips in the comments.

cues.zh: 给我吧
cues.pinyin: gei3 wo3 ba5
cues.en: I'd love to hear them.

cues.zh: 那今天的影片就到这啰
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 de5 ying3 pian4 jiu4 dao4 zhe4 luo1
cues.en: That's all for today's video.

cues.zh: 我们下次再见拜拜
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 ci4 zai4 jian4 bai4 bai4
cues.en: See you next time. Bye!

cues.zh: 你喜欢吃甜米糕吗

cues.zh: 还好还好

cues.zh: 要不要拜一下

cues.zh: 就拜一下吧

cues.zh: 我真的好久没

cues.zh: 因为这些东西在韩国

cues.zh: 然后贴得还蛮稳的

cues.zh: 我这次又买了一些回去

cues.zh: 想说既然都买了

cues.zh: 就囤着吧

cues.zh: 这个还要分夜用跟日用
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hai2 yao4 fen1 ye4 yong4 gen1 ri4 yong4

cues.zh: 我觉得还蛮酷的

cues.zh: 用用看

items.title_zh: 戴牙套后的生活

cues.zh: 主要是因为觉得它长得蛮可爱的
cues.pinyin: zhu3 yao4 shi4 yin1 wei4 jue2 de5 ta1 zhang3 de2 man2 ke3 ai4 de5
cues.en: Mostly because I thought it looked cute.

cues.zh: 就是很简单
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 hen3 jian3 dan1
cues.en: It's very simple.

cues.zh: 然后想说就一起试试看
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 xiang3 shuo1 jiu4 yi4 qi3 shi4 shi4 kan4
cues.en: So I thought I'd try it too.

cues.zh: 没有看错这边就是
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 kan4 cuo4 zhe4 bian1 jiu4 shi4
cues.en: You're seeing that right. These are

cues.zh: 我这一次买的牙膏大军
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 yi1 ci4 mai3 de5 ya2 gao1 da4 jun1
cues.en: all the toothpastes I bought this time.

cues.zh: 因为自从戴牙套之后
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zi4 cong2 dai4 ya2 tao4 zhi1 hou4

cues.zh: 就刷牙次数变多

cues.zh: 今天的咖啡时光

cues.zh: 刚刚阴天所以就随便穿出门
cues.pinyin: gang1 gang1 yin1 tian1 suo3 yi3 jiu4 sui2 bian4 chuan1 chu1 men2
cues.en: It was cloudy, so I dressed casually.

cues.zh: 没想到天气这么好
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 tian1 qi4 zhe4 me5 hao3

cues.zh: 不然就穿得可爱一点出门了
cues.pinyin: bu4 ran2 jiu4 chuan1 de2 ke3 ai4 yi4 dian3 chu1 men2 le5

cues.zh: 应该会点这个戚风

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 挑选脆爽的小黄瓜

cues.zh: 大家好我是小高姐
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 xiao3 gao1 jie3
cues.en: Hi, I'm Xiaogaojie.

cues.zh: 今天我们来做拍黄瓜
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 pai1 huang2 gua1
cues.en: Today we're making smashed cucumber.

cues.zh: 我用的是这种小黄瓜
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong4 de5 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 xiao3 huang2 gua1
cues.en: I'm using these small cucumbers.

cues.zh: 它的皮儿比较薄个头也小
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 pi2 er2 bi3 jiao4 bao2 ge4 tou2 ye3 xiao3
cues.en: They have thin skins and are small.

cues.zh: 里头的黄瓜籽也很小
cues.pinyin: li3 tou5 de5 huang2 gua1 zi3 ye3 hen3 xiao3
cues.en: The seeds inside are small too.

cues.zh: 而且口感比较脆
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 kou3 gan3 bi3 jiao4 cui4
cues.en: And they have a crisp texture.

cues.zh: 洗干净去掉两头
cues.pinyin: xi3 gan1 jing4 qu4 diao4 liang3 tou2
cues.en: Wash them and trim both ends.

cues.zh: 直接拍
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 pai1
cues.en: Then smash them.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 拍黄瓜的小技巧

cues.zh: 但是呢你不要把它拍到完全断开
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ne5 ni3 bu2 yao4 ba3 ta1 pai1 dao4 wan2 quan2 duan4 kai1
cues.en: Don't smash it completely apart.

cues.zh: 然后切长菱形
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 qie4 zhang3 ling2 xing2
cues.en: Then cut it into long diamond shapes.

cues.zh: 我不把它拍到断开
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 ba3 ta1 pai1 dao4 duan4 kai1
cues.en: I don't smash it all the way through,

cues.zh: 切出来的黄瓜条形状完整
cues.pinyin: qie4 chu1 lai2 de5 huang2 gua1 tiao2 xing2 zhuang4 wan2 zheng3
cues.en: so the cut pieces keep their shape.

cues.zh: 也不会有很多黄瓜的小碎块
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu2 hui4 you3 hen3 duo1 huang2 gua1 de5 xiao3 sui4 kuai4
cues.en: And there aren't lots of little bits.

cues.zh: 拍散的黄瓜心儿呢
cues.pinyin: pai1 san4 de5 huang2 gua1 xin1 er2 ne5
cues.en: The smashed cucumber center

cues.zh: 还可以吸收很多调料的汁水
cues.pinyin: hai2 ke3 yi3 xi1 shou1 hen3 duo1 tiao2 liao4 de5 zhi1 shui3
cues.en: can soak up plenty of dressing.

cues.zh: 放盐先腌几分钟入味儿
cues.pinyin: fang4 yan2 xian1 yan1 ji3 fen1 zhong1 ru4 wei4 er5
cues.en: Add salt and let it season for a few minutes.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 黄瓜皮和籽怎么处理

cues.zh: 如果你买的黄瓜皮比较厚呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 mai3 de5 huang2 gua1 pi2 bi3 jiao4 hou4 ne5
cues.en: If your cucumber has thick skin,

cues.zh: 可以用刮刀刮去一部分皮
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 yong4 gua1 dao1 gua1 qu4 yi1 bu4 fen4 pi2
cues.en: peel some of it off.

cues.zh: 切开看看里面
cues.pinyin: qie4 kai1 kan4 kan4 li3 mian4
cues.en: Cut it open and look inside.

cues.zh: 这个黄瓜的籽儿不算大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 huang2 gua1 de5 zi3 er2 bu4 suan4 da4
cues.en: This cucumber's seeds aren't very big.

cues.zh: 你可以留着
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 liu2 zhe5
cues.en: You can leave them in.

cues.zh: 如果黄瓜籽比较大的话呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 huang2 gua1 zi3 bi3 jiao4 da4 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If the seeds are large,

cues.zh: 可以像这样刮掉
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 xiang4 zhe4 yang4 gua1 diao4
cues.en: scrape them out like this.

cues.zh: 不过用那样的黄瓜的话
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 yong4 na4 yang4 de5 huang2 gua1 de5 hua4
cues.en: But with that kind of cucumber,

cues.zh: 口感会打折扣
cues.pinyin: kou3 gan3 hui4 da3 zhe2 kou4
cues.en: the texture won't be quite as good.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 为什么要把蒜捣成泥

cues.zh: 捣碎的蒜是成泥状的
cues.pinyin: dao3 sui4 de5 suan4 shi4 cheng2 ni2 zhuang4 de5
cues.en: Crushed garlic becomes a paste.

cues.zh: 它比较容易附着在黄瓜的表面
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4 fu4 zhuo2 zai4 huang2 gua1 de5 biao3 mian4
cues.en: It clings more easily to the cucumber.

cues.zh: 吃到嘴里蒜味会很足
cues.pinyin: chi1 dao4 zui3 li3 suan4 wei4 hui4 hen3 zu2
cues.en: So each bite has plenty of garlic flavor.

cues.zh: 要不然这个菜也叫蒜泥黄瓜
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 zhe4 ge5 cai4 ye3 jiao4 suan4 ni2 huang2 gua1
cues.en: That's why it's also called garlic cucumber.

cues.zh: 如果是用刀把蒜切小颗粒
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 yong4 dao1 ba4 suan4 qie4 xiao3 ke1 li4
cues.en: If you chop the garlic into little bits,

cues.zh: 它不容易挂在黄瓜的上面
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 rong2 yi4 gua4 zai4 huang2 gua1 de5 shang4 mian4
cues.en: it doesn't stick to the cucumber as well.

cues.zh: 你吃完黄瓜呢你会发现
cues.pinyin: ni3 chi1 wan2 huang2 gua1 ne5 ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: After eating the cucumber, you'll find

cues.zh: 有一盘子底的小蒜粒
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 pan2 zi5 di3 de5 xiao3 suan4 li4
cues.en: little garlic bits left on the plate.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 调出酸辣开胃的味道

cues.zh: 夏季开胃小菜
cues.pinyin: xia4 ji4 kai1 wei4 xiao3 cai4
cues.en: For an appetizing summer side dish,

cues.zh: 少不了酸和辣的味道
cues.pinyin: shao4 bu4 liao3 suan1 he2 la4 de5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: you need sour and spicy flavors.

cues.zh: 一大勺醋和一勺辣椒油
cues.pinyin: yi1 da4 shao2 cu4 he2 yi1 shao2 la4 jiao1 you2
cues.en: A tablespoon of vinegar and a spoon of chili oil.

cues.zh: 加一点糖来平衡它们的味道
cues.pinyin: jia1 yi4 dian3 tang2 lai2 ping2 heng2 ta1 men5 de5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: Add a little sugar to balance the flavors.

cues.zh: 生抽增加它的鲜味
cues.pinyin: sheng1 chou1 zeng1 jia1 ta1 de5 xian1 wei4
cues.en: Light soy sauce adds savoriness.

cues.zh: 点一点香油增加它的香味儿
cues.pinyin: dian3 yi4 dian3 xiang1 you2 zeng1 jia1 ta1 de5 xiang1 wei4 er2
cues.en: A little sesame oil adds aroma.

cues.zh: 拌匀就可以装盘了
cues.pinyin: ban4 yun2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zhuang1 pan2 le5

items.title: History Odyssey
items.title_zh: 一口氣看完中華五千年歷史：從三皇五帝到清朝滅亡！誰是最強王朝？｜歷史之旅

cues.zh: 今天我们一口气来聊聊中华五千年历史
cues.en: Let's take a quick tour of five thousand years of Chinese history.
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 yi4 kou3 qi4 lai2 liao2 liao2 zhong1 hua2 wu3 qian1 nian2 li4 shi3

cues.zh: 开始大约在西元前三千年左右的时候
cues.en: We begin around 3000 BCE.
cues.pinyin: kai1 shi3 da4 yue1 zai4 xi1 yuan2 qian2 san1 qian1 nian2 zuo3 you4 de5 shi2 hou4

cues.zh: 中华大地上的原始部落发展得非常旺盛
cues.en: Tribal communities were flourishing across the land.
cues.pinyin: zhong1 hua2 da4 di4 shang4 de5 yuan2 shi3 bu4 luo4 fa1 zhan3 de2 fei1 chang2 wang4 sheng4

cues.zh: 慢慢的一些比较强的部落就把比较弱的给并吞了
cues.en: Over time, stronger tribes absorbed weaker ones.
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 de5 yi1 xie1 bi3 jiao4 qiang2 de5 bu4 luo4 jiu4 ba3 bi3 jiao4 ruo4 de5 gei3 bing4 tun1 le5

cues.zh: 在中原形成了两个很厉害的部落群
cues.en: Two powerful tribal groups emerged in the Central Plains:
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 yuan2 xing2 cheng2 le5 liang3 ge4 hen3 li4 hai4 de5 bu4 luo4 qun2

cues.zh: 炎帝部落和黄帝部落
cues.en: the tribes of the Yan Emperor and the Yellow Emperor.
cues.pinyin: yan2 di4 bu4 luo4 he2 huang2 di4 bu4 luo4

cues.zh: 这两个部落在阪泉打了一仗
cues.en: The two tribes fought at Banquan.
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 ge4 bu4 luo4 zai4 ban3 quan2 da3 le5 yi1 zhang4

cues.zh: 黄帝打败了炎帝两个部落慢慢融合成华夏族
cues.en: The Yellow Emperor won; the tribes gradually became the Huaxia people.
cues.pinyin: huang2 di4 da3 bai4 le5 yan2 di4 liang3 ge4 bu4 luo4 man4 man4 rong2 he2 cheng2 hua2 xia4 zu2

cues.zh: 炎帝跟黄帝也成了华夏的始祖
cues.en: Both emperors became ancestral figures of the Huaxia.
cues.pinyin: yan2 di4 gen1 huang2 di4 ye3 cheng2 le5 hua2 xia4 de5 shi3 zu3

cues.zh: 这就是炎黄子孙的由来

cues.zh: 没多久黄帝又在涿鹿之战中把东南方的蚩尤部落给打败了

cues.zh: 黄帝也成了三皇五帝里五帝的第一位

cues.zh: 三皇五帝简单来说就是三皇加上五个帝王

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 今天我继续和大家漫谈相对论
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 ji4 xu4 he2 da4 jia1 man4 tan2 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: Today I'll continue our informal chat about relativity.

cues.zh: 我们之前说过
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 qian2 shuo1 guo4
cues.en: As we mentioned before,

cues.zh: 牛顿力学只能处理速度远远低
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 li4 xue2 zhi3 neng2 chu3 li3 su4 du4 yuan3 yuan3 di1
cues.en: Newtonian mechanics can only handle situations where speed is far

cues.zh: 于光速的情况
cues.pinyin: yu2 guang1 su4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: below the speed of light.

cues.zh: 一旦物体的速度足够快
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 wu4 ti3 de5 su4 du4 zu2 gou4 kuai4
cues.en: Once an object's speed is fast enough,

cues.zh: 就应该使用狭义相对论了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ying1 gai1 shi3 yong4 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 le5
cues.en: special relativity should be used instead.

cues.zh: 而狭义相对论只能处理没有物质
cues.pinyin: er2 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhi3 neng2 chu3 li3 mei2 you3 wu4 zhi4
cues.en: But special relativity can only handle cases with no matter,

cues.zh: 空间是平直的情况
cues.pinyin: kong1 jian1 shi4 ping2 zhi2 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: where space is flat.

cues.zh: 一旦因为引力造成了空间弯曲
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 yin1 wei4 yin3 li4 zao4 cheng2 le5 kong1 jian1 wan1 qu1
cues.en: Once gravity causes space to curve,

cues.zh: 就要使用广义相对论了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 shi3 yong4 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 le5
cues.en: general relativity must be used.

cues.zh: 于是有人说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 you3 ren2 shuo1
cues.en: So some people say,

cues.zh: 牛顿定律被狭义相对论推翻了
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 bei4 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 tui1 fan1 le5
cues.en: Newton's laws were overturned by special relativity,

cues.zh: 而狭义相对论又被广义相对论推翻了
cues.pinyin: er2 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 you4 bei4 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 tui1 fan1 le5
cues.en: and special relativity was in turn overturned by general relativity.

cues.zh: 对于这种观点
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 zhe4 zhong3 guan1 dian3
cues.en: Regarding this view,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦在他写的小册子
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 ta1 xie3 de5 xiao3 ce4 zi5
cues.en: in the booklet Einstein wrote,

cues.zh: 狭义与广义相对论浅说中
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian3 shuo1 zhong1
cues.en: 'Relativity: The Special and the General Theory,'

cues.zh: 做了一个比喻
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 bi3 yu4
cues.en: he gave an analogy.

cues.zh: 他说想计算两个电荷之间的作用力
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 xiang3 ji4 suan4 liang3 ge4 dian4 he4 zhi1 jian1 de5 zuo4 yong4 li4
cues.en: He said if you want to calculate the force between two charges,

cues.zh: 可以使用静电学的库仑定律
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 shi3 yong4 jing4 dian4 xue2 de5 ku4 lun2 ding4 lv4
cues.en: you can use Coulomb's law of electrostatics,

cues.zh: 但是这是在电荷静止不动的情况下
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 shi4 zai4 dian4 he4 jing4 zhi3 bu4 dong4 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: but that's only when the charges are stationary.

cues.zh: 一旦这个电荷运动起来
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 zhe4 ge5 dian4 he4 yun4 dong4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Once the charge starts moving,

cues.zh: 就应该使用麦克斯威方程组和电动
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ying1 gai1 shi3 yong4 mai4 ke4 si1 wei1 fang1 cheng2 zu3 he2 dian4 dong4
cues.en: you should use Maxwell's equations and the theory

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 力学的理论了
cues.pinyin: li4 xue2 de5 li3 lun4 le5
cues.en: of electrodynamics.

cues.zh: 那么我们是不是能说电动力学
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 shi4 bu2 shi4 neng2 shuo1 dian4 dong4 li4 xue2
cues.en: So can we say that electrodynamics

cues.zh: 就推翻了静电学定律呢
cues.pinyin: jiu4 tui1 fan1 le5 jing4 dian4 xue2 ding4 lv4 ne5
cues.en: overturned the laws of electrostatics?

cues.zh: 绝非如此
cues.pinyin: jue2 fei1 ru2 ci3
cues.en: Not at all.

cues.zh: 在电场不随时间变化的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 dian4 chang3 bu4 sui2 shi2 jian1 bian4 hua4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When the electric field doesn't change with time,

cues.zh: 电动力学会得出静电学的结论
cues.pinyin: dian4 dong4 li4 xue2 hui4 de2 chu1 jing4 dian4 xue2 de5 jie2 lun4
cues.en: electrodynamics gives the same conclusions as electrostatics.

cues.zh: 所以静电学是一种特殊或者说极限的情况
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jing4 dian4 xue2 shi4 yi1 zhong3 te4 shu1 huo4 zhe3 shuo1 ji2 xian4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: So electrostatics is a special, or limiting, case,

cues.zh: 在新的理论电动力学中依然是成立的
cues.pinyin: zai4 xin1 de5 li3 lun4 dian4 dong4 li4 xue2 zhong1 yi1 ran2 shi4 cheng2 li4 de5
cues.en: that still holds true within the new theory of electrodynamics.

cues.zh: 只是新的理论适用范围更广泛了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 xin1 de5 li3 lun4 shi4 yong4 fan4 wei2 geng4 guang3 fan4 le5
cues.en: It's just that the new theory has a broader range of applicability.

cues.zh: 所以物理学的发展其实是阶段性的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wu4 li3 xue2 de5 fa1 zhan3 qi2 shi2 shi4 jie1 duan4 xing4 de5
cues.en: So the development of physics actually happens in stages.

cues.zh: 牛顿定律曾经非常精确地阐述了宇
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 ceng2 jing1 fei1 chang2 jing1 que4 di4 chan3 shu4 le5 yu3
cues.en: Newton's laws once described the laws governing

cues.zh: 宙运行的规律
cues.pinyin: zhou4 yun4 xing2 de5 gui1 lv4
cues.en: the operation of the universe very precisely.

cues.zh: 可是后来随着人们测量越来越精确
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hou4 lai2 sui2 zhe5 ren2 men5 ce4 liang2 yue4 lai2 yue4 jing1 que4
cues.en: But later, as measurements became more and more precise,

cues.zh: 才发现牛顿定律与事实不相符的地方
cues.pinyin: cai2 fa1 xian4 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 yu3 shi4 shi2 bu4 xiang1 fu2 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: people found places where Newton's laws didn't match reality,

cues.zh: 才需要新的理论把牛顿定律进行拓展
cues.pinyin: cai2 xu1 yao4 xin1 de5 li3 lun4 ba3 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 jin4 xing2 tuo4 zhan3
cues.en: and new theories were needed to extend Newton's laws.

cues.zh: 狭义和广义相对论并没有推翻牛顿定律
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 he2 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 bing4 mei2 you3 tui1 fan1 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: Special and general relativity didn't overturn Newton's laws,

cues.zh: 而是发展了牛顿定律
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 fa1 zhan3 le5 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: they developed them further.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 水星的进冻速度并不快
cues.pinyin: shui3 xing1 de5 jin4 dong4 su4 du4 bing4 bu4 kuai4
cues.en: Mercury's perihelion precession isn't fast,

cues.zh: 可是科学家们认死理
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ke1 xue2 jia1 men5 ren4 si3 li3
cues.en: but scientists were stubborn about it,

cues.zh: 非要弄清楚这个进冻是从哪里来的
cues.pinyin: fei1 yao4 nong4 qing1 chu3 zhe4 ge5 jin4 dong4 shi4 cong2 na3 li3 lai2 de5
cues.en: insisting on figuring out where this precession came from.

cues.zh: 根据牛顿定律计算
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 ji4 suan4
cues.en: Calculating according to Newton's laws,

cues.zh: 考虑各种天体之间的射动影响
cues.pinyin: kao3 lv4 ge4 zhong3 tian1 ti3 zhi1 jian1 de5 she4 dong4 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: taking into account the gravitational perturbations between various celestial bodies,

cues.zh: 科学家们可以解释其中的 55 57 秒
cues.pinyin: ke1 xue2 jia1 men5 ke3 yi3 jie3 shi4 qi2 zhong1 de5 55 57 miao3
cues.en: scientists could explain 5557 arcseconds of it,

cues.zh: 但是还有 43 秒的差别是无法解释的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hai2 you3 43 miao3 de5 cha1 bie2 shi4 wu2 fa3 jie3 shi4 de5
cues.en: but the remaining 43 arcseconds couldn't be explained.

cues.zh: 许多科学家提出了一些假说
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 ke1 xue2 jia1 ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 xie1 jia3 shuo1
cues.en: Many scientists proposed hypotheses.

cues.zh: 比如说也许水星轨道附近存在尘埃阻力
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ye3 xu3 shui3 xing1 gui3 dao4 fu4 jin4 cun2 zai4 chen2 ai1 zu3 li4
cues.en: For example, maybe there was dust drag near Mercury's orbit,

cues.zh: 太阳是不均匀的
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 shi4 bu4 jun1 yun2 de5
cues.en: or the sun wasn't uniform,

cues.zh: 水星轨道内部还有一颗没有发现的助容星
cues.pinyin: shui3 xing1 gui3 dao4 nei4 bu4 hai2 you3 yi1 ke1 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4 de5 zhu4 rong2 xing1
cues.en: or there was an undiscovered planet, Vulcan, inside Mercury's orbit,

cues.zh: 甚至怀疑牛顿的万有引力定律
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 huai2 yi2 niu2 dun4 de5 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: or they even suspected Newton's law of universal gravitation

cues.zh: 不是严格的平方反比定律
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 yan2 ge2 de5 ping2 fang1 fan3 bi3 ding4 lv4
cues.en: wasn't exactly an inverse-square law.

cues.zh: 但是这些理论都无法完美的解释这个差别
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 xie1 li3 lun4 dou1 wu2 fa3 wan2 mei3 de5 jie3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 cha1 bie2
cues.en: But none of these theories could perfectly explain the discrepancy.

cues.zh: 直到爱因斯坦提出广义相对论之后
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 ti2 chu1 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Not until Einstein proposed general relativity

cues.zh: 他发现由于水星轨道距离太阳很近
cues.pinyin: ta1 fa1 xian4 you2 yu2 shui3 xing1 gui3 dao4 ju4 li2 tai4 yang2 hen3 jin4
cues.en: did he find that because Mercury's orbit is so close to the sun,

cues.zh: 时空被太阳弯曲的太强烈了
cues.pinyin: shi2 kong1 bei4 tai4 yang2 wan1 qu1 de5 tai4 qiang2 lie4 le5
cues.en: spacetime is curved very strongly by the sun.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 光线也会发生向下的弯折
cues.pinyin: guang1 xian4 ye3 hui4 fa1 sheng1 xiang4 xia4 de5 wan1 zhe2
cues.en: Light also bends downward because of this.

cues.zh: 引力能够让光发生弯折
cues.pinyin: yin3 li4 neng2 gou4 rang4 guang1 fa1 sheng1 wan1 zhe2
cues.en: Gravity can cause light to bend —

cues.zh: 这就是爱因斯坦的预言
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 de5 yu4 yan2
cues.en: this was Einstein's prediction.

cues.zh: 不过地球的引力还不够大
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 di4 qiu2 de5 yin3 li4 hai2 bu4 gou4 da4
cues.en: But Earth's gravity isn't strong enough.

cues.zh: 如果有一束光在地面上运动 3000 公里
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 yi1 shu4 guang1 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 yun4 dong4 3000 gong1 li3
cues.en: If a beam of light traveled 3000 kilometers on Earth's surface,

cues.zh: 由于引力影响造成的光线偏折也
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 yin3 li4 ying3 xiang3 zao4 cheng2 de5 guang1 xian4 pian1 zhe2 ye3
cues.en: the deflection caused by gravity would be

cues.zh: 只有 0 5 毫米
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 0 5 hao2 mi3
cues.en: only 0.5 millimeters.

cues.zh: 所以爱因斯坦电梯实验没有办法
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 dian4 ti1 shi2 yan4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3
cues.en: So Einstein's elevator thought experiment couldn't be

cues.zh: 在地面上实现
cues.pinyin: zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 shi2 xian4
cues.en: realized on Earth.

cues.zh: 但是太阳的引力远远比地球大
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 tai4 yang2 de5 yin3 li4 yuan3 yuan3 bi3 di4 qiu2 da4
cues.en: But the sun's gravity is far stronger than Earth's.

cues.zh: 假如光线经过太阳附近
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 guang1 xian4 jing1 guo4 tai4 yang2 fu4 jin4
cues.en: If light passes near the sun,

cues.zh: 那么光线的偏折就会达到可以观测的程度
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 guang1 xian4 de5 pian1 zhe2 jiu4 hui4 da2 dao4 ke3 yi3 guan1 ce4 de5 cheng2 du4
cues.en: the deflection would be large enough to observe.

cues.zh: 其实在爱因斯坦之前就有人根据牛顿定律
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zai4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zhi1 qian2 jiu4 you3 ren2 gen1 ju4 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: Actually, even before Einstein, people had used Newton's laws

cues.zh: 计算出了光线经过太阳附近会发生偏折
cues.pinyin: ji4 suan4 chu1 le5 guang1 xian4 jing1 guo4 tai4 yang2 fu4 jin4 hui4 fa1 sheng1 pian1 zhe2
cues.en: to calculate that light passing near the sun would bend.

cues.zh: 只不过用牛顿定律计算出的结果只有爱
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 yong4 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 ji4 suan4 chu1 de5 jie2 guo3 zhi3 you3 ai4
cues.en: It's just that the result calculated with Newton's laws was only half

cues.zh: 因斯坦的一半
cues.pinyin: yin1 si1 tan3 de5 yi2 ban4
cues.en: of Einstein's.

cues.zh: 牛顿和爱因斯坦谁对谁错
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 he2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shui2 dui4 shui2 cuo4
cues.en: Who was right, Newton or Einstein —

cues.zh: 必须要通过实验来验证
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 yao4 tong1 guo4 shi2 yan4 lai2 yan4 zheng4
cues.en: it had to be verified by experiment.

cues.zh: 于是历史上两个最伟大的物理学家
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 li4 shi3 shang4 liang3 ge4 zui4 wei3 da4 de5 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1
cues.en: And so the two greatest physicists in history,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 跨越 200 年的 P K 开始了
cues.pinyin: kua4 yue4 200 nian2 de5 P K kai1 shi3 le5
cues.en: separated by 200 years, began their showdown.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦在 19 16 年写成这本小册子
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 19 16 nian2 xie3 cheng2 zhe4 ben3 xiao3 ce4 zi5
cues.en: When Einstein finished writing this booklet in 1916,

cues.zh: 狭义与广义相对论潜说的时候
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian2 shuo1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: 'Relativity: The Special and the General Theory,'

cues.zh: 实验还没有人做
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 hai2 mei2 you3 ren2 zuo4
cues.en: no one had done the experiment yet.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦明确地给出了实验的方法
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 ming2 que4 di4 gei3 chu1 le5 shi2 yan4 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Einstein clearly laid out the experimental method:

cues.zh: 设量两颗恒星光线之间的夹角
cues.pinyin: she4 liang4 liang3 ke1 heng2 xing1 guang1 xian4 zhi1 jian1 de5 jia1 jiao3
cues.en: measure the angle between the light rays of two stars,

cues.zh: 然后随着地球的自转和公转
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 sui2 zhe5 di4 qiu2 de5 zi4 zhuan4 he2 gong1 zhuan4
cues.en: then, as the Earth rotates and orbits,

cues.zh: 找到一个时刻
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 yi2 ge4 shi2 ke4
cues.en: find a moment

cues.zh: 此时太阳刚好位于两条光线中间
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 tai4 yang2 gang1 hao3 wei4 yu2 liang3 tiao2 guang1 xian4 zhong1 jian1
cues.en: when the sun happens to be right between the two light rays.

cues.zh: 如果太阳的引力真的让光线发生了偏折
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 tai4 yang2 de5 yin3 li4 zhen1 de5 rang4 guang1 xian4 fa1 sheng1 le5 pian1 zhe2
cues.en: If the sun's gravity really does bend the light,

cues.zh: 那么此时两条光线的夹角
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ci3 shi2 liang3 tiao2 guang1 xian4 de5 jia1 jiao3
cues.en: then the angle between the two rays at that moment

cues.zh: 应该与没有太阳的时候是不一样的
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 yu3 mei2 you3 tai4 yang2 de5 shi2 hou4 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5
cues.en: should be different from when the sun isn't there.

cues.zh: 由于太阳过于耀眼
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 tai4 yang2 guo4 yu2 yao4 yan3
cues.en: Because the sun is too bright,

cues.zh: 那么这个实验只能在日全时的时候来做
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 shi2 yan4 zhi3 neng2 zai4 ri4 quan2 shi2 de5 shi2 hou4 lai2 zuo4
cues.en: this experiment can only be done during a total solar eclipse.

cues.pinyin: 19 19 nian2 5 yue4 29 ri4

cues.zh: 英国天文学家爱丁顿率领观测队
cues.pinyin: ying1 guo2 tian1 wen2 xue2 jia1 ai4 ding1 dun4 shuai4 ling3 guan1 ce4 dui4
cues.en: British astronomer Eddington led an observation team

cues.zh: 在西非的普林西壁岛观测了日全时
cues.pinyin: zai4 xi1 fei1 de5 pu3 lin2 xi1 bi4 dao3 guan1 ce4 le5 ri4 quan2 shi2
cues.en: to observe the total solar eclipse on Príncipe Island in West Africa,

cues.zh: 拍摄日全时时太阳附近的恒星位置
cues.pinyin: pai1 she4 ri4 quan2 shi2 shi2 tai4 yang2 fu4 jin4 de5 heng2 xing1 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: photographing the positions of stars near the sun during the eclipse.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦说
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shuo1
cues.en: Einstein said,

cues.zh: 那我会为上帝感到遗憾
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 hui4 wei4 shang4 di4 gan3 dao4 yi2 han4
cues.en: then I would feel sorry for God —

cues.zh: 不管怎么说
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 zen3 me5 shuo1
cues.en: no matter what,

cues.zh: 理论总还是对的
cues.pinyin: li3 lun4 zong3 hai2 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: the theory is still correct.

cues.zh: 你看爱因斯坦就是这么自信
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 me5 zi4 xin4
cues.en: See, that's how confident Einstein was.

cues.zh: 验证广义相对论的第三个实验
cues.pinyin: yan4 zheng4 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 di4 san1 ge4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: The third experiment verifying general relativity

cues.zh: 是引力红移现象
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin3 li4 hong2 yi2 xian4 xiang4
cues.en: was the phenomenon of gravitational redshift.

cues.zh: 广义相对论告诉我们
cues.pinyin: guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 gao4 su4 wo3 men5
cues.en: General relativity tells us

cues.zh: 在引力是低的地方
cues.pinyin: zai4 yin3 li4 shi4 di1 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: that in places with low gravitational potential,

cues.zh: 始终会变慢
cues.pinyin: shi3 zhong1 hui4 bian4 man4
cues.en: time runs slower.

cues.zh: 如果大质量的恒星发光
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 da4 zhi4 liang4 de5 heng2 xing1 fa1 guang1
cues.en: If a massive star emits light,

cues.zh: 光从引力是很低的星球表面
cues.pinyin: guang1 cong2 yin3 li4 shi4 hen3 di1 de5 xing1 qiu2 biao3 mian4
cues.en: and the light travels from the star's surface, where the gravitational potential is low,

cues.zh: 到达地球的时候
cues.pinyin: dao4 da2 di4 qiu2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: to reach Earth,

cues.zh: 频率就会变小
cues.pinyin: pin2 lv4 jiu4 hui4 bian4 xiao3
cues.en: its frequency decreases —

cues.zh: 发生红移
cues.pinyin: fa1 sheng1 hong2 yi2
cues.en: a redshift occurs.

cues.zh: 也就是某种元素
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 mou3 zhong3 yuan2 su4
cues.en: That is, the light emitted by a certain element

cues.zh: 发出光的频率会低于地面上同样元
cues.pinyin: fa1 chu1 guang1 de5 pin2 lv4 hui4 di1 yu2 di4 mian4 shang4 tong2 yang4 yuan2
cues.en: will have a lower frequency than light from the same element

cues.zh: 素发光的频率
cues.pinyin: su4 fa1 guang1 de5 pin2 lv4
cues.en: emitted on Earth.

cues.zh: 反过来说
cues.pinyin: fan3 guo4 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: Conversely,

cues.zh: 如果在地面上向天空发出一道光
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 xiang4 tian1 kong1 fa1 chu1 yi1 dao4 guang1
cues.en: if a beam of light is sent from the ground up into the sky,

cues.zh: 在光线远离地球的过程中
cues.pinyin: zai4 guang1 xian4 yuan3 li2 di4 qiu2 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: as the light moves away from Earth,

cues.zh: 频率也会变低发生红移
cues.pinyin: pin2 lv4 ye3 hui4 bian4 di1 fa1 sheng1 hong2 yi2
cues.en: its frequency also decreases, causing a redshift.

cues.zh: 或者你也可以理解成
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 li3 jie3 cheng2
cues.en: Or you can think of it this way:

cues.zh: 光线从弯曲的空间中爬出来
cues.pinyin: guang1 xian4 cong2 wan1 qu1 de5 kong1 jian1 zhong1 pa2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: light climbing out of curved space

cues.zh: 需要消耗一定的能量
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 xiao1 hao4 yi2 ding4 de5 neng2 liang4
cues.en: has to expend some energy,

cues.zh: 所以频率变低了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 pin2 lv4 bian4 di1 le5
cues.en: so its frequency decreases.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 手术过程中突然停电了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 tu1 ran2 ting2 dian4 le5
cues.en: During the surgery, the power suddenly went out.

cues.zh: 天才医生该怎么救人呢
cues.pinyin: tian1 cai2 yi1 sheng1 gai1 zen3 me5 jiu4 ren2 ne5
cues.en: What should the genius doctor do to save the patient?

cues.zh: 今天是他们来到这里第一次开
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 shi4 ta1 men5 lai2 dao4 zhe4 li3 di4 yi1 ci4 kai1
cues.en: Today was the first day

cues.zh: 始手术的日子
cues.pinyin: shi3 shou3 shu4 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: they started performing surgery here.

cues.zh: 大家都挺兴奋的
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 ting3 xing1 fen4 de5
cues.en: Everyone was quite excited.

cues.zh: 利姆把所有人分成了三组开展工作
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 ba3 suo3 you3 ren2 fen1 cheng2 le5 san1 zu3 kai1 zhan3 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: Liam split everyone into three groups to start the work.

cues.zh: 只不过大家刚上手没多久医院就突然停电
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 da4 jia1 gang1 shang4 shou3 mei2 duo1 jiu3 yi1 yuan4 jiu4 tu1 ran2 ting2 dian4
cues.en: But not long after they got started, the hospital suddenly lost power.

cues.zh: 顿时陷入了昏暗之中
cues.pinyin: dun4 shi2 xian4 ru4 le5 hun1 an4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: Everything was plunged into darkness.

cues.zh: 护士大姐过来道歉
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 da4 jie3 guo4 lai2 dao4 qian4
cues.en: The nurse came over to apologize.

cues.zh: 这里地处山上经常停电他们备有发电机
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 di4 chu3 shan1 shang4 jing1 chang2 ting2 dian4 ta1 men5 bei4 you3 fa1 dian4 ji1
cues.en: This place is up in the mountains and often loses power, so they have a generator.

cues.zh: 只不过不幸的是发电机也坏掉了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 bu4 xing4 de5 shi4 fa1 dian4 ji1 ye3 huai4 diao4 le5
cues.en: Unfortunately, the generator was broken too.

cues.zh: 连医院的人也不知道什么时候才来电
cues.pinyin: lian2 yi1 yuan4 de5 ren2 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 shen2 me5 shi2 hou4 cai2 lai2 dian4
cues.en: Even the hospital staff didn't know when the power would come back.

cues.zh: 这可怎么办
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: What on earth could they do?

cues.zh: 患者还都敞着肚皮在病床上躺着呢
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 hai2 dou1 chang3 zhe5 du4 pi2 zai4 bing4 chuang2 shang4 tang3 zhe5 ne5
cues.en: The patients were still lying on their beds with their bellies cut open.

cues.zh: 再过会儿说不定都凉透了
cues.pinyin: zai4 guo4 hui4 er5 shuo1 bu4 ding4 dou1 liang2 tou4 le5
cues.en: In a little while, they might go completely cold.

cues.zh: 对于要求简单的手术
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 yao1 qiu2 jian3 dan1 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: For surgeries that didn't require much,

cues.zh: 医生打算趁着窗外的光线凑合凑合
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 da3 suan4 chen4 zhe5 chuang1 wai4 de5 guang1 xian4 cou4 he2 cou4 he2
cues.en: the doctor planned to make do with the light from the window.

cues.zh: 仪器不能用就直接上手感受血管和器官
cues.pinyin: yi2 qi4 bu4 neng2 yong4 jiu4 zhi2 jie1 shang4 shou3 gan3 shou4 xue4 guan3 he2 qi4 guan1
cues.en: If the equipment couldn't be used, they'd just feel the blood vessels and organs by hand.

cues.zh: 而萧恩负责的病人身上长了个肿瘤
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao1 en1 fu4 ze2 de5 bing4 ren2 shen1 shang4 zhang3 le5 ge4 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: Meanwhile, the patient Sean was in charge of had a tumor.

cues.zh: 没有超声波也不好切除啊
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 chao1 sheng1 bo1 ye3 bu4 hao3 qie1 chu2 a5
cues.en: Without an ultrasound, it wouldn't be easy to remove either.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 萧恩回想着病人之前的超声波图
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 hui2 xiang3 zhe5 bing4 ren2 zhi1 qian2 de5 chao1 sheng1 bo1 tu2
cues.en: Sean recalled the patient's previous ultrasound images.

cues.zh: 无数影像在他脑中浮现
cues.pinyin: wu2 shu4 ying3 xiang4 zai4 ta1 nao3 zhong1 fu2 xian4
cues.en: Countless images flashed through his mind.

cues.zh: 仔细衡量后
cues.pinyin: zi3 xi4 heng2 liang2 hou4
cues.en: After carefully weighing it,

cues.zh: 他确定自己可以在没有超声波的情况下
cues.pinyin: ta1 que4 ding4 zi4 ji3 ke3 yi3 zai4 mei2 you3 chao1 sheng1 bo1 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: he was confident he could locate the tumor

cues.zh: 确定肿瘤位置
cues.pinyin: que4 ding4 zhong3 liu2 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: even without an ultrasound.

cues.zh: 于是萧恩拿起医用剪刀
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao1 en1 na2 qi3 yi1 yong4 jian3 dao1
cues.en: So Sean picked up a pair of surgical scissors

cues.zh: 慢慢伸进病人的腹腔内
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 shen1 jin4 bing4 ren2 de5 fu4 qiang1 nei4
cues.en: and slowly reached into the patient's abdominal cavity.

cues.zh: 他试探着感受到了条索状的东西
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 tan4 zhe5 gan3 shou4 dao4 le5 tiao2 suo3 zhuang4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: Feeling around carefully, he found something cord-like.

cues.zh: 应该就是肿瘤了
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 jiu4 shi4 zhong3 liu2 le5
cues.en: That should be the tumor.

cues.zh: 既然位置确定了
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 wei4 zhi4 que4 ding4 le5
cues.en: Now that its location was confirmed,

cues.zh: 那么他们就可以切除了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 qie1 chu2 le5
cues.en: they could go ahead and remove it.

cues.zh: 工作一天后大家都十分疲惫
cues.pinyin: gong1 zuo4 yi1 tian1 hou4 da4 jia1 dou1 shi2 fen1 pi2 bei4
cues.en: After a full day of work, everyone was exhausted.

cues.zh: 坐在车上都昏昏欲睡
cues.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 che1 shang4 dou1 hun1 hun1 yu4 shui4
cues.en: They were all drowsy in the car.

cues.zh: 利姆和兰登经过昨天的绑架事件后
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 he2 lan2 deng1 jing1 guo4 zuo2 tian1 de5 bang3 jia4 shi4 jian4 hou4
cues.en: After yesterday's kidnapping incident, Liam and Landon's

cues.zh: 关系得到了迅速的转变
cues.pinyin: guan1 xi4 de2 dao4 le5 xun4 su4 de5 zhuan3 bian4
cues.en: relationship changed rapidly.

cues.zh: 回到旅馆后立马滚到床上贪欢
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 lv3 guan3 hou4 li4 ma3 gun3 dao4 chuang2 shang4 tan1 huan1
cues.en: As soon as they got back to the hotel, they rolled straight into bed to indulge themselves.

cues.zh: 兰登是美国人
cues.pinyin: lan2 deng1 shi4 mei3 guo2 ren2
cues.en: Landon is American,

cues.zh: 但是在墨西哥长大
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zai4 mo4 xi1 ge1 zhang3 da4
cues.en: but grew up in Mexico.

cues.zh: 还是个混血儿
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 ge4 hun4 xue4 er2
cues.en: He's also mixed-race.

cues.zh: 这么多年辗转各个国家和城市
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 zhan3 zhuan3 ge4 ge4 guo2 jia1 he2 cheng2 shi4
cues.en: After drifting between so many countries and cities over the years,

cues.zh: 已经十年没回去了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 shi2 nian2 mei2 hui2 qu4 le5
cues.en: he hasn't been back in ten years.

cues.zh: 他的履历十分丰富
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 lv3 li4 shi2 fen1 feng1 fu4
cues.en: His résumé is very impressive,

cues.zh: 加上长得不错
cues.pinyin: jia1 shang4 zhang3 de2 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: and on top of that he's good-looking,

cues.zh: 的确十分吸引人
cues.pinyin: di2 que4 shi2 fen1 xi1 yin3 ren2
cues.en: which really does make him attractive.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 小布的手术也被安排好了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 de5 shou3 shu4 ye3 bei4 an1 pai2 hao3 le5
cues.en: Xiao Bu's surgery was also scheduled.

cues.zh: 手术台上
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4
cues.en: On the operating table,

cues.zh: 黑哥小心翼翼的将肿瘤
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4 de5 jiang1 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: Brother Hei carefully removed the tumor

cues.zh: 从小布的鼻旁窦处切除
cues.pinyin: cong2 xiao3 bu4 de5 bi2 pang2 dou4 chu4 qie1 chu2
cues.en: from near Xiao Bu's nasal sinus.

cues.zh: 修复过程比黑哥预料的要艰难的多
cues.pinyin: xiu1 fu4 guo4 cheng2 bi3 hei1 ge1 yu4 liao4 de5 yao4 jian1 nan2 de5 duo1
cues.en: The repair turned out to be much harder than Brother Hei expected.

cues.zh: 一不小心就会伤到小布的眼眶和其他骨头
cues.pinyin: yi2 bu4 xiao3 xin1 jiu4 hui4 shang1 dao4 xiao3 bu4 de5 yan3 kuang4 he2 qi2 ta1 gu3 tou5
cues.en: One careless move could injure Xiao Bu's eye socket or other bones.

cues.zh: 必须得先移开几块骨头
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 de2 xian1 yi2 kai1 ji3 kuai4 gu3 tou5
cues.en: Several bones had to be removed first

cues.zh: 以得到更开阔的手术空间
cues.pinyin: yi3 de2 dao4 geng4 kai1 kuo4 de5 shou3 shu4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: to create more room to operate.

cues.zh: 可是医院里缺少必须的辅助工具
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 yuan4 li3 que1 shao3 bi4 xu1 de5 fu3 zhu4 gong1 ju4
cues.en: But the hospital lacked the necessary supporting tools.

cues.zh: 不得已
cues.pinyin: bu4 de2 yi3
cues.en: With no other choice,

cues.zh: 黑哥只能先终止手术
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 zhi3 neng2 xian1 zhong1 zhi3 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Brother Hei had to pause the surgery for now

cues.zh: 和护士小美一起去一家牙科诊所找找工具
cues.pinyin: he2 hu4 shi4 xiao3 mei3 yi4 qi3 qu4 yi1 jia1 ya2 ke1 zhen3 suo3 zhao3 zhao3 gong1 ju4
cues.en: and go with nurse Xiaomei to a dental clinic to look for tools.

cues.zh: 路上黑哥为自己之前跟小美说的调情的话
cues.pinyin: lu4 shang4 hei1 ge1 wei4 zi4 ji3 zhi1 qian2 gen1 xiao3 mei3 shuo1 de5 tiao2 qing2 de5 hua4
cues.en: On the way, Brother Hei felt bad about the flirty things he'd said to Xiaomei before,

cues.zh: 而感到抱歉
cues.pinyin: er2 gan3 dao4 bao4 qian4
cues.en: and felt sorry about it.

cues.zh: 他告诉小美
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: He told Xiaomei

cues.zh: 自己和妻子的感情出现了问题
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 he2 qi1 zi3 de5 gan3 qing2 chu1 xian4 le5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: that things had gone wrong between him and his wife.

cues.zh: 他和别人在一起了
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 bie2 ren2 zai4 yi4 qi3 le5
cues.en: He'd gotten together with someone else.

cues.zh: 对方前几天前就已经搬出去住了
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 qian2 ji3 tian1 qian2 jiu4 yi3 jing1 ban1 chu1 qu4 zhu4 le5
cues.en: The other woman had already moved out a few days earlier.

cues.zh: 此次出差的人员中本来没有他的
cues.pinyin: ci3 ci4 chu1 chai1 de5 ren2 yuan2 zhong1 ben3 lai2 mei2 you3 ta1 de5
cues.en: He wasn't originally supposed to be on this trip.

cues.zh: 他特地来到这里
cues.pinyin: ta1 te4 di4 lai2 dao4 zhe4 li3
cues.en: He came here specifically

cues.zh: 也是为了好好整理一下思绪
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 wei4 le5 hao3 hao3 zheng3 li3 yi1 xia4 si1 xu4
cues.en: to sort out his thoughts

cues.zh: 想想要不要挽回一下他们的婚姻
cues.pinyin: xiang3 xiang3 yao4 bu2 yao4 wan3 hui2 yi1 xia4 ta1 men5 de5 hun1 yin1
cues.en: and think about whether to try to save their marriage.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 看着布朗的心情好像不是很好的样子
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 bu4 lang3 de5 xin1 qing2 hao3 xiang4 bu2 shi4 hen3 hao3 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: Seeing that Brown didn't seem to be in a good mood,

cues.zh: 护士大姐开口安慰他
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 da4 jie3 kai1 kou3 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: the nurse spoke up to comfort him.

cues.zh: 来这里做志愿者的医生有三种
cues.pinyin: lai2 zhe4 li3 zuo4 zhi4 yuan4 zhe3 de5 yi1 sheng1 you3 san1 zhong3
cues.en: There are three kinds of doctors who come here to volunteer.

cues.zh: 一种是太在乎
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhong3 shi4 tai4 zai4 hu1
cues.en: One kind cares too much,

cues.zh: 但是他们不可能救下所有人
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 men5 bu4 ke3 neng2 jiu4 xia4 suo3 you3 ren2
cues.en: but they can't possibly save everyone,

cues.zh: 所以自己把自己给压垮了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zi4 ji3 ba3 zi4 ji3 gei3 ya1 kua3 le5
cues.en: so they end up crushing themselves under the weight of it.

cues.zh: 一种是太冷漠
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhong3 shi4 tai4 leng3 mo4
cues.en: Another kind is too indifferent,

cues.zh: 这种人本身就有问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 ren2 ben3 shen1 jiu4 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and that kind of person has issues of their own.

cues.zh: 还有一种是尽量去疏远自己的感情
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 zhong3 shi4 jin3 liang4 qu4 shu1 yuan3 zi4 ji3 de5 gan3 qing2
cues.en: And another kind tries to keep their emotions at a distance,

cues.zh: 以便于更好的工作
cues.pinyin: yi3 bian4 yu2 geng4 hao3 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: so they can work better.

cues.zh: 但布朗不一样
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 lang3 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: But Brown is different.

cues.zh: 他在乎并爱护着每一个病人
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 hu1 bing4 ai4 hu4 zhe5 mei3 yi2 ge4 bing4 ren2
cues.en: He cares about and looks after every single patient,

cues.zh: 但他并没有因此垮掉
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 bing4 mei2 you3 yin1 ci3 kua3 diao4
cues.en: yet he hasn't broken down because of it.

cues.zh: 反而从压力中摄取力量
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 cong2 ya1 li4 zhong1 she4 qu3 li4 liang4
cues.en: Instead, he draws strength from the pressure,

cues.zh: 让自己变得更强
cues.pinyin: rang4 zi4 ji3 bian4 de2 geng4 qiang2
cues.en: making himself stronger.

cues.zh: 布朗大受感触
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 da4 shou4 gan3 chu4
cues.en: Brown was deeply moved.

cues.zh: 说了声谢谢
cues.pinyin: shuo1 le5 sheng1 xie4 xie4
cues.en: He said thanks

cues.zh: 自信满满的和他一起走进手术室
cues.pinyin: zi4 xin4 man3 man3 de5 he2 ta1 yi4 qi3 zou3 jin4 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: and walked into the operating room with him, full of confidence.

cues.zh: 可是手术并没有那么顺利
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 shou3 shu4 bing4 mei2 you3 na4 me5 shun4 li4
cues.en: But the surgery didn't go as smoothly as that.

cues.zh: 小微的肝脏里不只有胆结石
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 gan1 zang4 li3 bu4 zhi3 you3 dan3 jie2 shi2
cues.en: Xiaowei's liver didn't just have gallstones,

cues.zh: 还有肿瘤
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: it also had a tumor,

cues.zh: 而且已经扩散到了肝脏表面
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yi3 jing1 kuo4 san4 dao4 le5 gan1 zang4 biao3 mian4
cues.en: and it had already spread to the surface of the liver.

cues.zh: 他们需要做肝脏部分切除术
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xu1 yao4 zuo4 gan1 zang4 bu4 fen4 qie1 chu2 shu4
cues.en: The surgery might stretch on for 12 hours.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 但是医院人手短缺
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 yuan4 ren2 shou3 duan3 que1
cues.en: But the hospital was short-staffed,

cues.zh: 他只能自己坚持
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 neng2 zi4 ji3 jian1 chi2
cues.en: so he had to push through on his own.

cues.zh: 他们需要做交叉前颊切除术
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xu1 yao4 zuo4 jiao1 cha1 qian2 jia2 qie1 chu2 shu4
cues.en: They needed to perform a partial liver resection.

cues.zh: 但布朗只看过
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 lang3 zhi3 kan4 guo4
cues.en: But Brown had only ever studied it,

cues.zh: 从没有上手操作过
cues.pinyin: cong2 mei2 you3 shang4 shou3 cao1 zuo4 guo4
cues.en: never actually performed one himself.

cues.zh: 所以他很紧张
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 hen3 jin3 zhang1
cues.en: So he was nervous.

cues.zh: 可布朗的专业性依旧让他有条不紊的
cues.pinyin: ke3 bu4 lang3 de5 zhuan1 ye4 xing4 yi1 jiu4 rang4 ta1 you3 tiao2 bu4 wen3 de5
cues.en: But Brown's expertise still let him proceed steadily,

cues.zh: 完成一步又一步的操作
cues.pinyin: wan2 cheng2 yi1 bu4 you4 yi1 bu4 de5 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: completing each step one after another.

cues.zh: 可是突然意外发生了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 tu1 ran2 yi4 wai4 fa1 sheng1 le5
cues.en: Then suddenly something unexpected happened.

cues.zh: 小微的心率飙升
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 xin1 lv4 biao1 sheng1
cues.en: Xiaowei's heart rate spiked

cues.zh: 血压下降
cues.pinyin: xue4 ya1 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: and her blood pressure dropped.

cues.zh: 马上就要不行了
cues.pinyin: ma3 shang4 jiu4 yao4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: She was about to crash.

cues.zh: 可是他们又找不出原因
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 you4 zhao3 bu4 chu1 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: But they couldn't figure out the cause.

cues.zh: 这下不成功便成仁
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 bu4 cheng2 gong1 bian4 cheng2 ren2
cues.en: Brown immediately paused the surgery

cues.zh: 找到理论知识储备非常丰富的肖恩
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 li3 lun4 zhi1 shi2 chu3 bei4 fei1 chang2 feng1 fu4 de5 xiao4 en1
cues.en: and found Sean, who had a wealth of theoretical knowledge,

cues.zh: 向他寻求帮助
cues.pinyin: xiang4 ta1 xun2 qiu2 bang1 zhu4
cues.en: to ask him for help.

cues.zh: 肖恩向他提供了几种思路
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 xiang4 ta1 ti2 gong1 le5 ji3 zhong3 si1 lu4
cues.en: Sean offered him a few possible leads.

cues.zh: 是那个得了腹膜炎的卷毛
cues.pinyin: shi4 na4 ge5 de2 le5 fu4 mo2 yan2 de5 juan3 mao2
cues.en: Brown immediately made up his mind.

cues.zh: 他们不能确定是哪一种可能
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu4 neng2 que4 ding4 shi4 na3 yi1 zhong3 ke3 neng2
cues.en: They couldn't be sure which possibility it was,

cues.zh: 只能按照概率最大的来
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 an4 zhao4 gai4 lv4 zui4 da4 de5 lai2
cues.en: so they could only go with the most likely one.

cues.zh: 这下不成功贬成人
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 bu4 cheng2 gong1 bian3 cheng2 ren2
cues.en: This time, it was succeed or die trying.

cues.zh: 幸运的是布朗是对的
cues.pinyin: xing4 yun4 de5 shi4 bu4 lang3 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: Luckily, Brown was right.

cues.zh: 手术很快就完成了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 wan2 cheng2 le5
cues.en: The surgery was finished quickly.

cues.zh: 此刻医院又来了一位熟悉的病人
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 yi1 yuan4 you4 lai2 le5 yi1 wei4 shu2 xi1 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: Just then, a familiar patient came to the hospital again.

cues.zh: 是那个得了腹膳的卷毛
cues.pinyin: shi4 na4 ge5 de2 le5 fu4 shan4 de5 juan3 mao2
cues.en: It was Curly, the one who had peritonitis.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 而且手指关节的疼痛几乎让他
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 shou3 zhi3 guan1 jie2 de5 teng2 tong4 ji1 hu1 rang4 ta1
cues.en: And the pain in his finger joints almost

cues.zh: 拿不稳手术剪
cues.pinyin: na2 bu4 wen3 shou3 shu4 jian3
cues.en: made him unable to hold the surgical scissors steady.

cues.zh: 可这已经到了收尾阶段
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 yi3 jing1 dao4 le5 shou1 wei3 jie1 duan4
cues.en: But they'd already reached the final stage,

cues.zh: 他死撑着也要完成
cues.pinyin: ta1 si3 cheng1 zhe5 ye3 yao4 wan2 cheng2
cues.en: so he forced himself to push through and finish.

cues.zh: 此时刚从手术台上下来的朴医生
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 gang1 cong2 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4 xia4 lai2 de5 pu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: At that moment, Dr. Park, who had just come off another operating table,

cues.zh: 立刻赶来剃了摩根的斑
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 gan3 lai2 ti4 le5 mo2 gen1 de5 ban1
cues.en: rushed over to take over Morgan's shift.

cues.zh: 在手术结束后
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 hou4
cues.en: After the surgery was over,

cues.zh: 一向强势的摩根难得露出了软弱的一面
cues.pinyin: yi2 xiang4 qiang2 shi4 de5 mo2 gen1 nan2 de2 lu4 chu1 le5 ruan3 ruo4 de5 yi2 mian4
cues.en: the usually strong-willed Morgan rarely let his vulnerable side show.

cues.zh: 即使手受伤了
cues.pinyin: ji2 shi3 shou3 shou4 shang1 le5
cues.en: Even though his hand was injured,

cues.zh: 他也从来没有放弃当外科医生
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 fang4 qi4 dang1 wai4 ke1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: he had never given up on being a surgeon.

cues.zh: 可手上的伤阻止了他对职业的追求
cues.pinyin: ke3 shou3 shang4 de5 shang1 zu3 zhi3 le5 ta1 dui4 zhi2 ye4 de5 zhui1 qiu2
cues.en: But the injury to his hand stood in the way of pursuing that career.

cues.zh: 他并不是讨厌当内科医生
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 bu2 shi4 tao3 yan4 dang1 nei4 ke1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: It wasn't that he hated being a physician,

cues.zh: 而是讨厌失败
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 tao3 yan4 shi1 bai4
cues.en: it was that he hated failing.

cues.zh: 但朴医生告诉他
cues.pinyin: dan4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: But Dr. Park told him

cues.zh: 他从来没有失败过
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 shi1 bai4 guo4
cues.en: that he had never once failed.

cues.zh: 他们做了三年的同事
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zuo4 le5 san1 nian2 de5 tong2 shi4
cues.en: They'd been colleagues for three years,

cues.zh: 他看着摩根在工作上大放异彩
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 zhe5 mo2 gen1 zai4 gong1 zuo4 shang4 da4 fang4 yi4 cai3
cues.en: and he had watched Morgan shine brilliantly at work.

cues.zh: 不能当外科医生
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 dang1 wai4 ke1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Not being able to be a surgeon

cues.zh: 不能成为他的失败
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 cheng2 wei2 ta1 de5 shi1 bai4
cues.en: couldn't be counted as his failure.

cues.zh: 维基一周的出差工作结束了
cues.pinyin: wei2 ji1 yi1 zhou1 de5 chu1 chai1 gong1 zuo4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: The week-long work trip had come to an end.

cues.zh: 病人也陆陆续续康复出院
cues.pinyin: bing4 ren2 ye3 lu4 lu4 xu4 xu4 kang1 fu4 chu1 yuan4
cues.en: The patients gradually recovered and were discharged one by one.

cues.zh: 医生们和这里的每个人告别
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 he2 zhe4 li3 de5 mei3 ge4 ren2 gao4 bie2
cues.en: The doctors said goodbye to everyone there.

cues.zh: 护士病人邻居
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 bing4 ren2 lin2 ju1
cues.en: Nurses, patients, neighbors.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 忠于自我，不比随波逐流更重要吗？

cues.zh: 学艺术的人可能不会谈艺术
cues.pinyin: xue2 yi4 shu4 de5 ren2 ke3 neng2 bu2 hui4 tan2 yi4 shu4
cues.en: People who study art may not talk about art much

cues.zh: 谈的更多的是生活
cues.pinyin: tan2 de5 geng4 duo1 de5 shi4 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: What they talk about more is life

cues.zh: 你敢去抛弃一些东西去做你想做的事吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 gan3 qu4 pao1 qi4 yi1 xie1 dong1 xi1 qu4 zuo4 ni3 xiang3 zuo4 de5 shi4 ma5
cues.en: Do you dare give up certain things to do what you want to do

cues.zh: 来你机会来尝一尝
cues.pinyin: lai2 ni3 ji1 hui4 lai2 chang2 yi1 chang2
cues.en: Come on, here's your chance to try it

cues.zh: 其实我觉得不是我在开这辆车它引领着我
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 wo3 jue2 de5 bu2 shi4 wo3 zai4 kai1 zhe4 liang4 che1 ta1 yin3 ling3 zhe5 wo3
cues.en: Actually I don't think I'm the one driving this car — it's leading me

cues.zh: 它曾经是有故事的剩下的故事我来写
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 jing1 shi4 you3 gu4 shi4 de5 sheng4 xia4 de5 gu4 shi4 wo3 lai2 xie3
cues.en: It used to have its own story, and I'll write the rest of it

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 动动脑时间5｜要封住哪一个开口，老虎就走不出来了呢？｜大大小小

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这哦
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o2
cues.en: The answer to last episode's question is here!

cues.zh: 3 颗 100 元跟 2 颗 100 元合起来可以卖
cues.pinyin: 3 ke1 100 yuan2 gen1 2 ke1 100 yuan2 he2 qi3 lai2 ke3 yi3 mai4
cues.en: 3 apples for 100 yuan and 2 apples for 100 yuan combined can be sold

cues.zh: 5 颗 200 元没错
cues.pinyin: 5 ke1 200 yuan2 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: as 5 apples for 200 yuan, that's right

cues.zh: 但在卖了 10 组也就是 50 颗后
cues.pinyin: dan4 zai4 mai4 le5 10 zu3 ye3 jiu4 shi4 50 ke1 hou4
cues.en: But after selling 10 sets, meaning 50 apples,

cues.zh: 小明的苹果已经卖光了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 de5 ping2 guo3 yi3 jing1 mai4 guang1 le5
cues.en: Xiaoming's apples were already sold out

cues.zh: 剩下的 10 颗苹果其实全部都是小华的
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 10 ke1 ping2 guo3 qi2 shi2 quan2 bu4 dou1 shi4 xiao3 hua2 de5
cues.en: The remaining 10 apples were actually all Xiaohua's

cues.zh: 把原本小华 2 颗 100 元的苹果
cues.pinyin: ba3 yuan2 ben3 xiao3 hua2 2 ke1 100 yuan2 de5 ping2 guo3
cues.en: Taking Xiaohua's apples, originally 2 for 100 yuan,

cues.zh: 变成 5 颗 200 元再卖
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 5 ke1 200 yuan2 zai4 mai4
cues.en: and selling them as 5 for 200 yuan instead

cues.zh: 那当然就会少收钱咯
cues.pinyin: na4 dang1 ran2 jiu4 hui4 shao3 shou1 qian2 ge1
cues.en: that would obviously mean collecting less money

cues.zh: 你答对了吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 da2 dui4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Did you get it right?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话64｜吹牛大王｜比你蠢的猪｜浇花｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我哥哥跑起来跟风一样快
cues.pinyin: wo3 ge1 ge1 pao3 qi3 lai2 gen1 feng1 yi1 yang4 kuai4
cues.en: My older brother runs as fast as the wind.

cues.zh: 他常常叫别人朝着他的背部开枪
cues.pinyin: ta1 chang2 chang2 jiao4 bie2 ren2 chao2 zhe5 ta1 de5 bei4 bu4 kai1 qiang1
cues.en: He often tells people to shoot at his back.

cues.zh: 一听到枪声他就往前跑
cues.pinyin: yi1 ting1 dao4 qiang1 sheng1 ta1 jiu4 wang3 qian2 pao3
cues.en: As soon as he hears the gunshot, he runs forward.

cues.zh: 每次他都跑在子弹的前面那哪有厉害
cues.pinyin: mei3 ci4 ta1 dou1 pao3 zai4 zi3 dan4 de5 qian2 mian4 na4 na3 you3 li4 hai4
cues.en: He always runs ahead of the bullet — but that's nothing impressive.

cues.zh: 我哥才厉害每次晚上睡觉的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 ge1 cai2 li4 hai4 mei3 ci4 wan3 shang4 shui4 jiao4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: My brother is the truly impressive one — every night when he goes to sleep,

cues.zh: 他把灯一关掉换上睡衣然后还打拳
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 deng1 yi1 guan1 diao4 huan4 shang4 shui4 yi1 ran2 hou4 hai2 da3 quan2
cues.en: he turns off the light, changes into his pajamas, and even throws some punches,

cues.zh: 还跳上床当他钻进被窝的时候
cues.pinyin: hai2 tiao4 shang4 chuang2 dang1 ta1 zuan1 jin4 bei4 wo1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: then jumps onto the bed — and by the time he's snuggled into the covers,

cues.zh: 我们的房间都还没有完全暗下来
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 fang2 jian1 dou1 hai2 mei2 you3 wan2 quan2 an4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: our room still hasn't gone completely dark.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话64｜吹牛大王｜比你蠢的猪｜浇花｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 珊珊
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1
cues.en: Shanshan.

cues.zh: 我考你喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 kao3 ni3 o1
cues.en: Let me quiz you.

cues.zh: 你知道有比十大的数字吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 you3 bi3 shi2 da4 de5 shu4 zi4 ma5
cues.en: Do you know a number bigger than ten?

cues.zh: 知道
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Yes.

cues.zh: 那你知道有比一百大的数字吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zhi1 dao4 you3 bi3 yi4 bai3 da4 de5 shu4 zi4 ma5
cues.en: Then do you know a number bigger than a hundred?

cues.zh: 知道
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Yes.

cues.zh: 那你知道有比一千大的数字吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zhi1 dao4 you3 bi3 yi1 qian1 da4 de5 shu4 zi4 ma5
cues.en: Then do you know a number bigger than a thousand?

cues.zh: 那你知道有比你蠢的猪吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zhi1 dao4 you3 bi3 ni3 chun3 de5 zhu1 ma5
cues.en: Then do you know a pig dumber than you?

cues.zh: 不好了今天我忘记浇花了
cues.pinyin: bu4 hao3 le5 jin1 tian1 wo3 wang4 ji4 jiao1 hua1 le5
cues.en: Oh no, I forgot to water the flowers today!

cues.zh: 那个没关系啦
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 mei2 guan1 xi4 la5
cues.en: Oh, that's fine.

cues.zh: 天快要下雨了不用浇了
cues.pinyin: tian1 kuai4 yao4 xia4 yu3 le5 bu4 yong4 jiao1 le5
cues.en: It's about to rain, so you don't need to water them.

cues.zh: 不行啊如果我现在不浇
cues.pinyin: bu4 xing2 a5 ru2 guo3 wo3 xian4 zai4 bu4 jiao1
cues.en: No way — if I don't water them now,

cues.zh: 待会下雨了我就会被雨淋湿了
cues.pinyin: dai4 hui4 xia4 yu3 le5 wo3 jiu4 hui4 bei4 yu3 lin2 shi1 le5
cues.en: then when it rains later, I'll get soaked myself.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一个普通女孩，靠自己到底可以走多远？

cues.zh: 现在网红在好多人眼里是一个贬义词
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wang3 hong2 zai4 hao3 duo1 ren2 yan3 li3 shi4 yi2 ge4 bian3 yi4 ci2
cues.en: Nowadays, 'internet celebrity' is a derogatory term to a lot of people

cues.zh: 但是我觉得做自己就好了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 jue2 de5 zuo4 zi4 ji3 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: But I think it's fine to just be yourself

cues.zh: 很多人都因为这辆车而认识到我
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 yin1 wei4 zhe4 liang4 che1 er2 ren4 shi2 dao4 wo3
cues.en: A lot of people came to know me because of this car

cues.zh: 我想先搞事我想被别人看扁
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 xian1 gao3 shi4 wo3 xiang3 bei4 bie2 ren2 kan4 bian3
cues.en: I wanted to stir things up first, I wanted people to look down on me

cues.zh: 我就是要征服他加油
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 shi4 yao4 zheng1 fu2 ta1 jia1 you2
cues.en: I'm determined to conquer it, come on!

cues.zh: 明天继续跟女孩子不靠漂亮
cues.pinyin: ming2 tian1 ji4 xu4 gen1 nv3 hai2 zi5 bu4 kao4 piao4 liang4
cues.en: Today, let's keep talking about how girls don't rely on looks

cues.zh: 到底能够走多远
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 neng2 gou4 zou3 duo1 yuan3
cues.en: just how far can they really go

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我能为农村的孩子做点什么？

cues.zh: 我是李永乐我任教育中国最好的高中之一
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 wo3 ren4 jiao4 yu4 zhong1 guo2 zui4 hao3 de5 gao1 zhong1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: I'm Li Yongle, and I teach at one of the best high schools in China.

cues.zh: 我怎么样才能够让我自己的生活变
cues.pinyin: wo3 zen3 me5 yang4 cai2 neng2 gou4 rang4 wo3 zi4 ji3 de5 sheng1 huo2 bian4
cues.en: How can I make my own life

cues.zh: 得更加精彩呢
cues.pinyin: de2 geng4 jia1 jing1 cai3 ne5
cues.en: more fulfilling?

cues.zh: 我就希望再做一些突破
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xi1 wang4 zai4 zuo4 yi1 xie1 tu1 po4
cues.en: I wanted to make some kind of breakthrough.

cues.zh: 那于是我就开始制作视频
cues.pinyin: na4 yu2 shi4 wo3 jiu4 kai1 shi3 zhi4 zuo4 shi4 pin2
cues.en: So I started making videos.

cues.zh: 我希望我的这些课程能让更多的人受益
cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 wo3 de5 zhe4 xie1 ke4 cheng2 neng2 rang4 geng4 duo1 de5 ren2 shou4 yi4
cues.en: I hope these lessons of mine can benefit more people.

cues.zh: 我想为教育公平贡献我的一点力量
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 wei4 jiao4 yu4 gong1 ping2 gong4 xian4 wo3 de5 yi4 dian3 li4 liang4
cues.en: I want to contribute a little to educational equality.

cues.zh: 他们都跟我说离开村子离开大山
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 gen1 wo3 shuo1 li2 kai1 cun1 zi5 li2 kai1 da4 shan1
cues.en: They all told me to leave the village, leave the mountains.

cues.zh: 山的外面是什么呢
cues.pinyin: shan1 de5 wai4 mian4 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What's outside the mountains?

cues.zh: 没有人能告诉我
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 neng2 gao4 su4 wo3
cues.en: No one could tell me.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我能为农村的孩子做点什么？

cues.zh: 孩子的父母
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 de5 fu4 mu3
cues.en: The children's parents

cues.zh: 知道外面的世界很精彩
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 wai4 mian4 de5 shi4 jie4 hen3 jing1 cai3
cues.en: know the outside world is wonderful,

cues.zh: 但是他们又无可奈何
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 men5 you4 wu2 ke3 nai4 he2
cues.en: but there's nothing they can do about it.

cues.zh: 你物理作业写完了吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 wu4 li3 zuo4 ye4 xie3 wan2 le5 ma5
cues.en: Have you finished your physics homework?

cues.zh: 我也不懂啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 bu4 dong3 a5
cues.en: I don't understand it either.

cues.zh: 上学课太难了
cues.pinyin: shang4 xue2 ke4 tai4 nan2 le5
cues.en: School lessons are too hard.

cues.zh: 谁能辅导啊
cues.pinyin: shui2 neng2 fu3 dao3 a5
cues.en: Who can tutor me?

cues.zh: 咱爸妈啥也不懂
cues.pinyin: zan2 ba4 ma1 sha2 ye3 bu4 dong3
cues.en: Our parents don't understand anything.

cues.zh: 还教我物理
cues.pinyin: hai2 jiao4 wo3 wu4 li3
cues.en: And they're supposed to teach me physics?

cues.zh: 他们故意听都没听过
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 gu4 yi4 ting1 dou1 mei2 ting1 guo4
cues.en: They've never even heard of it on purpose.

cues.zh: 怎么教啊
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 jiao4 a5
cues.en: How could they teach it?

cues.zh: 那个我先不跟你说了
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 wo3 xian1 bu4 gen1 ni3 shuo1 le5
cues.en: I won't tell you about that for now.

cues.zh: 谢谢我喝点水
cues.pinyin: xie4 xie4 wo3 he1 dian3 shui3
cues.en: Thanks, let me drink some water.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我能为农村的孩子做点什么？

cues.zh: 孩子的父母
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 de5 fu4 mu3
cues.en: The children's parents

cues.zh: 咱们认为这就是现实
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 ren4 wei2 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 xian4 shi2
cues.en: we think this is just reality.

cues.zh: 只有自己拼命地赚钱
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 zi4 ji3 pin1 ming4 di4 zhuan4 qian2
cues.en: Only by working desperately to earn money

cues.zh: 拼命地努力
cues.pinyin: pin1 ming4 di4 nu3 li4
cues.en: and struggling with all our might

cues.zh: 才能让自己的孩子
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 rang4 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: can we give our children

cues.zh: 过上更好的生活
cues.pinyin: guo4 shang4 geng4 hao3 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: a better life.

cues.zh: 但是如果忽略了教育
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 hu1 lve4 le5 jiao4 yu4
cues.en: But if education is neglected,

cues.zh: 他的孩子很有可能又重复
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 hen3 you3 ke3 neng2 you4 chong2 fu4
cues.en: his child will likely just repeat

cues.zh: 他这一代所做的事情
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhe4 yi2 dai4 suo3 zuo4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: what his generation did.

cues.zh: 我想种一粒种子
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 zhong3 yi1 li4 zhong3 zi5
cues.en: I want to plant a seed,

cues.zh: 让我的学生们理解
cues.pinyin: rang4 wo3 de5 xue2 sheng1 men5 li3 jie3
cues.en: to let my students understand

cues.zh: 学习不仅仅是为了
cues.pinyin: xue2 xi2 bu4 jin3 jin3 shi4 wei4 le5
cues.en: that learning isn't just about

cues.zh: 获得生存本领
cues.pinyin: huo4 de2 sheng1 cun2 ben3 ling3
cues.en: gaining the skills to survive.

cues.zh: 学习也可以充满乐趣
cues.pinyin: xue2 xi2 ye3 ke3 yi3 chong1 man3 le4 qu4
cues.en: Learning can also be full of joy.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我能为农村的孩子做点什么？

cues.zh: 直到现在我也不知道
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 xian4 zai4 wo3 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Even now I still don't know

cues.zh: 多年走不出过村子的父亲
cues.pinyin: duo1 nian2 zou3 bu4 chu1 guo4 cun1 zi5 de5 fu4 qin1
cues.en: how the father, who rarely ever left the village,

cues.zh: 是怎样买到一台平板电脑的
cues.pinyin: shi4 zen3 yang4 mai3 dao4 yi1 tai2 ping2 ban3 dian4 nao3 de5
cues.en: managed to buy a tablet computer.

cues.zh: 但他的出现打开了新的窗口
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 de5 chu1 xian4 da3 kai1 le5 xin1 de5 chuang1 kou3
cues.en: But his appearance opened a new window.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 李永乐老师您是怎么考上北大的
cues.pinyin: li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1 nin2 shi4 zen3 me5 kao3 shang4 bei3 da4 de5
cues.en: Teacher Li Yongle, how did you get into Peking University?

cues.zh: 其实我是保送到北大的
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 wo3 shi4 bao3 song4 dao4 bei3 da4 de5
cues.en: Actually, I was admitted to Peking University through recommendation, without the exam.

cues.zh: 我保送到北大的时候还有一件特
cues.pinyin: wo3 bao3 song4 dao4 bei3 da4 de5 shi2 hou4 hai2 you3 yi1 jian4 te4
cues.en: When I was recommended to Peking University, there was also a particularly

cues.zh: 别有意思的事
cues.pinyin: bie2 you3 yi4 si5 de5 shi4
cues.en: interesting thing that happened.

cues.zh: 那天早上起来也不知道为什么那么倒霉
cues.pinyin: na4 tian1 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 na4 me5 dao3 mei2
cues.en: That morning when I got up, I don't know why, but I was so unlucky.

cues.zh: 我早上起来一骑自行车
cues.pinyin: wo3 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2 yi1 qi2 zi4 xing2 che1
cues.en: When I got up that morning and rode my bike,

cues.zh: 发现自行车闸线断了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 zi4 xing2 che1 zha2 xian4 duan4 le5
cues.en: I found that the bike's brake cable was broken.

cues.zh: 然后我就推着车赶紧来到修车师傅面前
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 jiu4 tui1 zhe5 che1 gan3 jin3 lai2 dao4 xiu1 che1 shi1 fu4 mian4 qian2
cues.en: So I pushed the bike and hurried over to a bike repairman.

cues.zh: 我说你帮我把这个闸修一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 ni3 bang1 wo3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xiu1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: I said, please help me fix this brake.

cues.zh: 结果师傅看了一眼然后拿了一把钳子出来
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 shi1 fu4 kan4 le5 yi1 yan3 ran2 hou4 na2 le5 yi1 ba3 qian2 zi5 chu1 lai2
cues.en: The repairman took one look, then pulled out a pair of pliers,

cues.zh: 就把我这个闸线给剪断了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ba3 wo3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 gei3 jian3 duan4 le5
cues.en: and cut my brake cable.

cues.zh: 我说我这个闸线断了你给我修好
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 duan4 le5 ni3 gei3 wo3 xiu1 hao3
cues.en: I said, my brake cable is broken, I need you to fix it.

cues.zh: 他就说了一句让我震惊的话
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shuo1 le5 yi1 ju4 rang4 wo3 zhen4 jing1 de5 hua4
cues.en: He said something that shocked me.

cues.zh: 他说如果我不给你这个闸线剪断
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ru2 guo3 wo3 bu4 gei3 ni3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 jian3 duan4
cues.en: He said if he hadn't cut this brake cable for me,

cues.zh: 你这个闸线就会缠到轮子里就会有危险
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 jiu4 hui4 chan2 dao4 lun2 zi5 li3 jiu4 hui4 you3 wei1 xian3
cues.en: the cable would get tangled in the wheel, which would be dangerous.

cues.zh: 现在我把你这个闸线剪断了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 ba3 ni3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 jian3 duan4 le5
cues.en: Now that he'd cut my brake cable,

cues.zh: 它就不会缠到轮子里了交钱吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 bu2 hui4 chan2 dao4 lun2 zi5 li3 le5 jiao1 qian2 ba5
cues.en: it wouldn't get tangled in the wheel anymore — now pay up.

cues.zh: 我当时年轻气盛我就跟这个修车
cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 shi2 nian2 qing1 qi4 sheng4 wo3 jiu4 gen1 zhe4 ge5 xiu1 che1
cues.en: I was young and hot-tempered back then, so I

cues.zh: 师傅吵了一下
cues.pinyin: shi1 fu4 chao3 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: argued with the repairman for a bit.

cues.zh: 吵完之后等我赶到学校
cues.pinyin: chao3 wan2 zhi1 hou4 deng3 wo3 gan3 dao4 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: After arguing, by the time I rushed to school,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 已经迟到了半个小时了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 chi2 dao4 le5 ban4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 le5
cues.en: I was already half an hour late.

cues.zh: 那一次是全国物理竞赛的初赛
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 ci4 shi4 quan2 guo2 wu4 li3 jing4 sai4 de5 chu1 sai4
cues.en: That time was the preliminary round of the National Physics Competition.

cues.zh: 如果我要是通不过这个初赛
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 yao4 shi4 tong1 bu4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 chu1 sai4
cues.en: If I failed to pass this preliminary round,

cues.zh: 我就不能参加复赛不能参加决赛
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 bu4 neng2 can1 jia1 fu4 sai4 bu4 neng2 can1 jia1 jue2 sai4
cues.en: I wouldn't be able to take part in the semifinal or the final.

cues.zh: 但是我当时准备物理竞赛已经
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 dang1 shi2 zhun3 bei4 wu4 li3 jing4 sai4 yi3 jing1
cues.en: But at that time I had already been preparing for the physics competition

cues.zh: 准备了一年了
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 le5 yi1 nian2 le5
cues.en: for a whole year.

cues.zh: 我想难道就因为一个自行车
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 nan2 dao4 jiu4 yin1 wei4 yi2 ge4 zi4 xing2 che1
cues.en: I thought, could it really be that because of a bicycle,

cues.zh: 我最后就失去了这个机会吗
cues.pinyin: wo3 zui4 hou4 jiu4 shi1 qu4 le5 zhe4 ge5 ji1 hui4 ma5
cues.en: I would end up losing this opportunity?

cues.zh: 绝对不行
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 bu4 xing2
cues.en: Absolutely not.

cues.zh: 所以我当时坐在考场上
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 dang1 shi2 zuo4 zai4 kao3 chang3 shang4
cues.en: So I sat there in the exam room,

cues.zh: 深吸一口气
cues.pinyin: shen1 xi1 yi4 kou3 qi4
cues.en: took a deep breath,

cues.zh: 稳了稳情绪开始打卷
cues.pinyin: wen3 le5 wen3 qing2 xu4 kai1 shi3 da3 juan3
cues.en: calmed myself down, and started answering the paper.

cues.zh: 没想到就越打越顺
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 jiu4 yue4 da3 yue4 shun4
cues.en: Unexpectedly, the more I wrote, the smoother it went.

cues.zh: 越打越顺
cues.pinyin: yue4 da3 yue4 shun4
cues.en: Smoother and smoother.

cues.zh: 最后反而还提前打完了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 fan3 er2 hai2 ti2 qian2 da3 wan2 le5
cues.en: In the end, I actually finished early.

cues.zh: 然后我又通过了负载决赛
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 you4 tong1 guo4 le5 fu4 zai4 jue2 sai4
cues.en: Then I also passed the semifinal and the final.

cues.zh: 就荣幸的被北京大学物理系给录取了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 rong2 xing4 de5 bei4 bei3 jing1 da4 xue2 wu4 li3 xi4 gei3 lu4 qu3 le5
cues.en: and was honored to be admitted to Peking University's Physics Department.

cues.zh: 所以我有时候在想
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 you3 shi2 hou4 zai4 xiang3
cues.en: So sometimes I think,

cues.zh: 一个人在考试之中
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ren2 zai4 kao3 shi4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: when a person is taking an exam,

cues.zh: 可能一定会遇到一些意外
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 yi2 ding4 hui4 yu4 dao4 yi1 xie1 yi4 wai4
cues.en: they'll probably run into some unexpected accidents.

cues.zh: 但是只要你有实力
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhi3 yao4 ni3 you3 shi2 li4
cues.en: But as long as you have real ability,

cues.zh: 你就会无惧意外
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 hui4 wu2 ju4 yi4 wai4
cues.en: you won't fear those accidents.

cues.zh: 那您后来又上了清华
cues.pinyin: na4 nin2 hou4 lai2 you4 shang4 le5 qing1 hua2
cues.en: So you later went on to Tsinghua University.

cues.zh: 在这个过程中有什么趣事吗
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 you3 shen2 me5 qu4 shi4 ma5
cues.en: Were there any interesting stories in that process?

cues.zh: 我本科毕业的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 ben3 ke1 bi4 ye4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I graduated with my bachelor's degree,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 这个老师让我保研
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lao3 shi1 rang4 wo3 bao3 yan2
cues.en: my teacher wanted me to get recommended for grad school without an exam.

cues.zh: 当时想让我保到这个北京大学技术物理系
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 xiang3 rang4 wo3 bao3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 bei3 jing1 da4 xue2 ji4 shu4 wu4 li3 xi4
cues.en: At the time they wanted to place me into Peking University's Department of Technical Physics,

cues.zh: 去搞原子弹是吧
cues.pinyin: qu4 gao3 yuan2 zi3 dan4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: to work on atomic bombs, you know.

cues.zh: 但是我当时已经想要去考研了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 dang1 shi2 yi3 jing1 xiang3 yao4 qu4 kao3 yan2 le5
cues.en: But by then I had already decided to take the graduate entrance exam.

cues.zh: 我之所以想要考研
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 suo3 yi3 xiang3 yao4 kao3 yan2
cues.en: The reason I wanted to take the grad exam

cues.zh: 就是因为我想通过一个机会来证明自己
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 wo3 xiang3 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 ji1 hui4 lai2 zheng4 ming2 zi4 ji3
cues.en: was because I wanted a chance to prove myself,

cues.zh: 看看我到底还有没有能力去学习
cues.pinyin: kan4 kan4 wo3 dao4 di3 hai2 you3 mei2 you3 neng2 li4 qu4 xue2 xi2
cues.en: to see whether I still had the ability to study.

cues.zh: 而且要考就考最难考的
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yao4 kao3 jiu4 kao3 zui4 nan2 kao3 de5
cues.en: And if I was going to take an exam, I'd take the hardest one there was.

cues.zh: 我就选了个清华电子系
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xuan3 le5 ge4 qing1 hua2 dian4 zi5 xi4
cues.en: So I chose Tsinghua's Electronics Department.

cues.zh: 清华电子系当年特别难考
cues.pinyin: qing1 hua2 dian4 zi5 xi4 dang1 nian2 te4 bie2 nan2 kao3
cues.en: Back then, Tsinghua's Electronics Department was extremely hard to get into.

cues.zh: 有点类似于现在的计算机
cues.pinyin: you3 dian3 lei4 si4 yu2 xian4 zai4 de5 ji4 suan4 ji1
cues.en: It was a bit like computer science is today.

cues.zh: 然后我当时在准备考研的时候
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 dang1 shi2 zai4 zhun3 bei4 kao3 yan2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Then while I was preparing for the grad exam,

cues.zh: 还有一件趣事就是有一个这个同学
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 jian4 qu4 shi4 jiu4 shi4 you3 yi2 ge4 zhe4 ge5 tong2 xue2
cues.en: there was another funny thing — a classmate of mine

cues.zh: 他这个端着一个盘子走到我面前就跟我说
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhe4 ge5 duan1 zhe5 yi2 ge4 pan2 zi5 zou3 dao4 wo3 mian4 qian2 jiu4 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: carried a tray over to me and said,

cues.zh: 说这个听说你想考清华电子系
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 ge5 ting1 shuo1 ni3 xiang3 kao3 qing1 hua2 dian4 zi5 xi4
cues.en: 'I heard you want to take the exam for Tsinghua's Electronics Department.

cues.zh: 你能考上吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 kao3 shang4 ma5
cues.en: Can you actually get in?'

cues.zh: 我说考不上也没事再考一年就行了
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 kao3 bu4 shang4 ye3 mei2 shi4 zai4 kao3 yi1 nian2 jiu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: I said, if I don't get in, it's fine, I'll just try again next year.

cues.zh: 他就说你现在就为你考不上找借口
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shuo1 ni3 xian4 zai4 jiu4 wei4 ni3 kao3 bu4 shang4 zhao3 jie4 kou3
cues.en: He said, 'You're already making excuses for failing before you even try.'

cues.zh: 哎呀给我气的是吧
cues.pinyin: ai1 ya1 gei3 wo3 qi4 de5 shi4 ba5
cues.en: Ugh, that made me so angry.

cues.zh: 虽然我当时非常生气
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 wo3 dang1 shi2 fei1 chang2 sheng1 qi4
cues.en: Although I was very angry at the time,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 但是我什么话都没说
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 shen2 me5 hua4 dou1 mei2 shuo1
cues.en: I didn't say a word.

cues.zh: 我这个后来我复习的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 ge5 hou4 lai2 wo3 fu4 xi2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Later on, when I was reviewing,

cues.zh: 每当我复习不下去
cues.pinyin: mei3 dang1 wo3 fu4 xi2 bu4 xia4 qu4
cues.en: whenever I felt like I couldn't keep studying,

cues.zh: 我就想起这个人奚落我的这种表情
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xiang3 qi3 zhe4 ge5 ren2 xi1 luo4 wo3 de5 zhe4 zhong3 biao3 qing2
cues.en: I'd remember the mocking look on his face,

cues.zh: 哎呀结果我就满血复活了
cues.pinyin: ai1 ya1 jie2 guo3 wo3 jiu4 man3 xue4 fu4 huo2 le5
cues.en: and that would instantly reenergize me.

cues.zh: 没想到后来经过这个 8 个月的紧张复习
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 hou4 lai2 jing1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 8 ge4 yue4 de5 jin3 zhang1 fu4 xi2
cues.en: Then, after 8 months of intense review,

cues.zh: 我就走入了这个考场
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 zou3 ru4 le5 zhe4 ge5 kao3 chang3
cues.en: I walked into the exam room.

cues.zh: 那我记得我当时走入清华这个考场的时候
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 ji4 de5 wo3 dang1 shi2 zou3 ru4 qing1 hua2 zhe4 ge5 kao3 chang3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: I remember when I walked into that Tsinghua exam room,

cues.zh: 也发生了一些意外
cues.pinyin: ye3 fa1 sheng1 le5 yi1 xie1 yi4 wai4
cues.en: some unexpected things happened too.

cues.zh: 什么意外呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yi4 wai4 ne5
cues.en: What kind of accident?

cues.zh: 就是我在头一天晚上的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 zai4 tou2 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: The night before,

cues.zh: 不知道吃什么吃坏肚子了
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 chi1 shen2 me5 chi1 huai4 du3 zi5 le5
cues.en: I ate something that upset my stomach, I don't know what.

cues.zh: 那一天晚上基本就没睡
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang4 ji1 ben3 jiu4 mei2 shui4
cues.en: That night I basically didn't sleep at all.

cues.zh: 就是连续上厕所上了七八次
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 lian2 xu4 shang4 ce4 suo3 shang4 le5 qi1 ba1 ci4
cues.en: I went to the bathroom seven or eight times in a row.

cues.zh: 第二天早上起来就快虚脱了
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 kuai4 xu1 tuo1 le5
cues.en: The next morning I woke up nearly drained.

cues.zh: 整个人就懵了
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 ren2 jiu4 meng3 le5
cues.en: I was completely dazed.

cues.zh: 而且第二天早上起来
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: And on top of that, the next morning,

cues.zh: 我也不知道怎么想
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 xiang3
cues.en: I don't know what I was thinking,

cues.zh: 我还喝了一碗豆浆
cues.pinyin: wo3 hai2 he1 le5 yi1 wan3 dou4 jiang1
cues.en: but I still drank a bowl of soy milk.

cues.zh: 结果进了考场之后我就想上厕所
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jin4 le5 kao3 chang3 zhi1 hou4 wo3 jiu4 xiang3 shang4 ce4 suo3
cues.en: As a result, once I got into the exam room, I needed to use the bathroom.

cues.zh: 然后我又不知道能不能让我上厕所
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 you4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 neng2 bu4 neng2 rang4 wo3 shang4 ce4 suo3
cues.en: And I wasn't sure if I'd even be allowed to go.

cues.zh: 于是我就憋着
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 jiu4 bie1 zhe5
cues.en: So I held it in.

cues.zh: 我就开始憋憋憋
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 kai1 shi3 bie1 bie1 bie1
cues.en: I just kept holding it in, and holding it in.

cues.zh: 憋了一个半小时
cues.pinyin: bie1 le5 yi2 ge4 ban4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: I held it for an hour and a half.

cues.zh: 我实在是憋不住了
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi2 zai4 shi4 bie1 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: I really couldn't hold it any longer.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 最后我就提前交卷去上厕所去了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wo3 jiu4 ti2 qian2 jiao1 juan4 qu4 shang4 ce4 suo3 qu4 le5
cues.en: In the end, I turned in my test early just to go to the bathroom.

cues.zh: 这样一来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2
cues.en: Because of that,

cues.zh: 我第一课考政治就考得非常非常差
cues.pinyin: wo3 di4 yi1 ke4 kao3 zheng4 zhi4 jiu4 kao3 de2 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 cha4
cues.en: I did really, really badly on the first exam, Politics.

cues.zh: 但是我那天中午的时候就在想
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 na4 tian1 zhong1 wu3 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 zai4 xiang3
cues.en: But that noon, I found myself thinking,

cues.zh: 难道说我复习了这么长时间
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 shuo1 wo3 fu4 xi2 le5 zhe4 me5 zhang3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: could it really be that after reviewing for so long,

cues.zh: 就因为我吃坏了肚子
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yin1 wei4 wo3 chi1 huai4 le5 du3 zi5
cues.en: just because I had an upset stomach,

cues.zh: 就因为我喝了一碗豆浆
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yin1 wei4 wo3 he1 le5 yi1 wan3 dou4 jiang1
cues.en: just because I drank a bowl of soy milk,

cues.zh: 最后我就失去了这个机会吗
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wo3 jiu4 shi1 qu4 le5 zhe4 ge5 ji1 hui4 ma5
cues.en: I would end up losing this opportunity?

cues.zh: 不行
cues.pinyin: bu4 xing2
cues.en: No way.

cues.zh: 我一定要抓紧后面的这些内容
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi2 ding4 yao4 zhua1 jin3 hou4 mian4 de5 zhe4 xie1 nei4 rong2
cues.en: I had to make sure to focus hard on what was left.

cues.zh: 然后那天中午
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 na4 tian1 zhong1 wu3
cues.en: So that noon,

cues.zh: 我觉得宿舍里边好好的睡了一觉
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 su4 she4 li3 bian1 hao3 hao3 de5 shui4 le5 yi1 jiao4
cues.en: I went back to the dorm and had a really good sleep.

cues.zh: 睡得特别香
cues.pinyin: shui4 de2 te4 bie2 xiang1
cues.en: I slept really soundly.

cues.zh: 到了下午在考试的时候
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 xia4 wu3 zai4 kao3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: By the time the afternoon exam came around,

cues.zh: 我就感觉到顺风顺水
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 gan3 jue2 dao4 shun4 feng1 shun4 shui3
cues.en: I felt like everything was going smoothly.

cues.zh: 就感觉越来越打越顺
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gan3 jue2 yue4 lai2 yue4 da3 yue4 shun4
cues.en: I felt like the more I answered, the smoother it went.

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: You know.

cues.zh: 再往后到专业课的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 wang3 hou4 dao4 zhuan1 ye4 ke4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Then later, when it came to the specialized subject exam,

cues.zh: 就觉得哇
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jue2 de5 wa5
cues.en: I thought, wow,

cues.zh: 这个专业课怎么这么简单呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhuan1 ye4 ke4 zen3 me5 zhe4 me5 jian3 dan1 ne5
cues.en: how is this specialized exam so easy?

cues.zh: 跟我复习的非常对路
cues.pinyin: gen1 wo3 fu4 xi2 de5 fei1 chang2 dui4 lu4
cues.en: It matched exactly what I had reviewed.

cues.zh: 结果我的专业课就考了 14 6 分
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 wo3 de5 zhuan1 ye4 ke4 jiu4 kao3 le5 14 6 fen1
cues.en: As a result, I scored 146 on the specialized subject.

cues.zh: 我只扣了 4 分
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi3 kou4 le5 4 fen1
cues.en: I only lost 4 points.

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: You know.

cues.zh: 后来我就考了 4 20 多分
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 jiu4 kao3 le5 4 20 duo1 fen1
cues.en: In the end, I scored over 420 points total.

cues.zh: 最后就荣幸的被清华大学录取了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 jiu4 rong2 xing4 de5 bei4 qing1 hua2 da4 xue2 lu4 qu3 le5
cues.en: and I was honored to be admitted to Tsinghua University.

cues.zh: 所以这件事又再次的给了我一个印证
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 you4 zai4 ci4 de5 gei3 le5 wo3 yi2 ge4 yin4 zheng4
cues.en: So this experience once again confirmed something for me.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 就是当你真的是对一件事
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 dang1 ni3 zhen1 de5 shi4 dui4 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: That is, when you've truly

cues.zh: 付出了足够的努力的时候
cues.pinyin: fu4 chu1 le5 zu2 gou4 de5 nu3 li4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: put in enough effort toward something,

cues.zh: 即便是你遇到了很多的意外
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 shi4 ni3 yu4 dao4 le5 hen3 duo1 de5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: even if you run into a lot of unexpected setbacks,

cues.zh: 你也可以无惧这个意外
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 wu2 ju4 zhe4 ge5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: you can face them without fear.

cues.zh: 我想跟各位参加高考的考生说
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 gen1 ge4 wei4 can1 jia1 gao1 kao3 de5 kao3 sheng1 shuo1
cues.en: I want to tell all of you taking the college entrance exam

cues.zh: 这么一个故事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 gu4 shi4
cues.en: a story.

cues.zh: 这个故事是我小的时候看的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gu4 shi4 shi4 wo3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 kan4 de5
cues.en: I read this story when I was young.

cues.zh: 就是有一个新兵
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 you3 yi2 ge4 xin1 bing1
cues.en: There was a new recruit.

cues.zh: 他呢在第一次跳伞之前
cues.pinyin: ta1 ne5 zai4 di4 yi1 ci4 tiao4 san3 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: Before his first parachute jump,

cues.zh: 去问自己的教官
cues.pinyin: qu4 wen4 zi4 ji3 de5 jiao4 guan1
cues.en: he went to ask his instructor,

cues.zh: 说如果说我跳下去之后
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ru2 guo3 shuo1 wo3 tiao4 xia4 qu4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: 'If, after I jump,

cues.zh: 发现我的伞包打不开了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 wo3 de5 san3 bao1 da3 bu4 kai1 le5
cues.en: I find that my main parachute won't open,

cues.zh: 我的备用伞包也打不开了
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 bei4 yong4 san3 bao1 ye3 da3 bu4 kai1 le5
cues.en: and my backup parachute won't open either,

cues.zh: 那我该怎么办呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 gai1 zen3 me5 ban4 ne5
cues.en: what should I do then?'

cues.zh: 这个时候这个教官就跟他说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 jiao4 guan1 jiu4 gen1 ta1 shuo1
cues.en: At that point, the instructor said to him,

cues.zh: 说呀当我当新兵的时候
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ya5 dang1 wo3 dang1 xin1 bing1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: 'When I was a new recruit,

cues.zh: 我也问过我的教官同样的问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 wen4 guo4 wo3 de5 jiao4 guan1 tong2 yang4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: I asked my instructor that very same question.
