cues.zh: 你知道教官是怎么回答我的吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 jiao4 guan1 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 da2 wo3 de5 ma5
cues.en: Do you know how he answered me?

cues.zh: 教官跟我说
cues.pinyin: jiao4 guan1 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: My instructor told me,

cues.zh: 在一个成功者的眼中
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 cheng2 gong1 zhe3 de5 yan3 zhong1
cues.en: "In the eyes of someone who succeeds,

cues.zh: 是没有那么多万一的
cues.pinyin: shi4 mei2 you3 na4 me5 duo1 wan4 yi1 de5
cues.en: there's no room for so many 'what ifs.'

cues.zh: 只有一万个信心
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 yi1 wan4 ge4 xin4 xin1
cues.en: There's only absolute confidence."'

cues.zh: 然后就把我一脚踢了下去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 ba3 wo3 yi1 jiao3 ti1 le5 xia4 qu4
cues.en: Then he just kicked me right out of the plane.

cues.zh: 希望我们今年参加高考的考生中
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 wo3 men5 jin1 nian2 can1 jia1 gao1 kao3 de5 kao3 sheng1 zhong1
cues.en: I hope that among this year's college entrance exam candidates,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 现女友给前女友做手术
cues.pinyin: xian4 nv3 you3 gei3 qian2 nv3 you3 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: His current girlfriend has to operate on his ex-girlfriend.

cues.zh: 手术室差点变成修罗场
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shi4 cha4 dian3 bian4 cheng2 xiu1 luo2 chang3
cues.en: The operating room nearly turned into a battlefield.

cues.zh: 小美患有急性肾衰竭
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 huan4 you3 ji2 xing4 shen4 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: Xiaomei has acute kidney failure.

cues.zh: 三年前因肾动脉狭窄而接受过治疗
cues.pinyin: san1 nian2 qian2 yin1 shen4 dong4 mai4 xia2 zhai3 er2 jie1 shou4 guo4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: Three years ago she was treated for renal artery stenosis.

cues.zh: 但如今植入的支架不行了
cues.pinyin: dan4 ru2 jin1 zhi2 ru4 de5 zhi1 jia4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: But the stent implanted back then has now failed.

cues.zh: 需要立即进行绕道手术
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 li4 ji2 jin4 xing2 rao4 dao4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: She needs an emergency bypass surgery.

cues.zh: 手术没什么大问题
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 mei2 shen2 me5 da4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: The surgery itself isn't a big problem.

cues.zh: 但主要是这个人
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhu3 yao4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ren2
cues.en: But the real issue is the people involved.

cues.zh: 林医生接触起来多多少少有点心理障碍
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 jie1 chu4 qi3 lai2 duo1 duo1 shao3 shao3 you3 dian3 xin1 li3 zhang4 ai4
cues.en: Dr. Lin feels somewhat uneasy about treating her.

cues.zh: 因为小美是自己的男友的前任不仅如此
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 shi4 zi4 ji3 de5 nan2 you3 de5 qian2 ren4 bu4 jin3 ru2 ci3
cues.en: Because Xiaomei is her boyfriend's ex — and not only that,

cues.zh: 她还是自己男友推荐过来做手术的
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shi4 zi4 ji3 nan2 you3 tui1 jian4 guo4 lai2 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5
cues.en: it was her own boyfriend who recommended Xiaomei for the surgery.

cues.zh: 因为小美所在的地方医院没有做手
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 suo3 zai4 de5 di4 fang1 yi1 yuan4 mei2 you3 zuo4 shou3
cues.en: Because the hospital in Xiaomei's hometown doesn't have

cues.zh: 术的相关仪器
cues.pinyin: shu4 de5 xiang1 guan1 yi2 qi4
cues.en: the equipment needed for the operation.

cues.zh: 不过作为一个医生
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zuo4 wei2 yi2 ge4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: But as a doctor,

cues.zh: 林医生对患者一视同仁
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 dui4 huan4 zhe3 yi1 shi4 tong2 ren2
cues.en: Dr. Lin treats every patient the same.

cues.zh: 并没有趁机打击报复什么的
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 chen4 ji1 da3 ji1 bao4 fu4 shen2 me5 de5
cues.en: She doesn't use the chance to settle any personal scores.

cues.zh: 医生旋转小美那次的所有器官
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 xuan2 zhuan3 xiao3 mei3 na4 ci4 de5 suo3 you3 qi4 guan1
cues.en: The doctor carefully moves aside Xiaomei's organs,

cues.zh: 将肾血管暴露出来
cues.pinyin: jiang1 shen4 xue4 guan3 bao4 lu4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: exposing the renal blood vessels.

cues.zh: 但接着就发现有一个巨大的动脉瘤
cues.pinyin: dan4 jie1 zhe5 jiu4 fa1 xian4 you3 yi2 ge4 ju4 da4 de5 dong4 mai4 liu2
cues.en: But then they find a huge aneurysm

cues.zh: 阻断了血液流动
cues.pinyin: zu3 duan4 le5 xue4 ye4 liu2 dong4
cues.en: blocking the blood flow.

cues.zh: 这就表明无法进行血管重建
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 biao3 ming2 wu2 fa3 jin4 xing2 xue4 guan3 chong2 jian4
cues.en: This means vascular reconstruction isn't possible.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 林医生建议可以从主动脉
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 jian4 yi4 ke3 yi3 cong2 zhu3 dong4 mai4
cues.en: Dr. Lin suggests they could bypass from the aorta

cues.zh: 或者下动脉处做旁路手术
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 xia4 dong4 mai4 chu4 zuo4 pang2 lu4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: or from the lower artery instead.

cues.zh: 但腹部主动脉周围有好几个动脉流断
cues.pinyin: dan4 fu4 bu4 zhu3 dong4 mai4 zhou1 wei2 you3 hao3 ji3 ge4 dong4 mai4 liu2 duan4
cues.en: But there are several aneurysms around the abdominal aorta,

cues.zh: 是一个方案不可行
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 fang1 an4 bu4 ke3 xing2
cues.en: so this plan isn't feasible either.

cues.zh: 最后医生用一根血管绕过了肾动脉
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 sheng1 yong4 yi1 gen1 xue4 guan3 rao4 guo4 le5 shen4 dong4 mai4
cues.en: In the end, the doctor uses a vessel graft to bypass the renal artery,

cues.zh: 解决了肾衰竭问题
cues.pinyin: jie3 jue2 le5 shen4 shuai1 jie2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: solving the kidney failure problem.

cues.zh: 但同时发现小美患有纤维肌肉发育不良症
cues.pinyin: dan4 tong2 shi2 fa1 xian4 xiao3 mei3 huan4 you3 xian1 wei2 ji1 rou4 fa1 yu4 bu4 liang2 zheng4
cues.en: But they also discover Xiaomei has fibromuscular dysplasia,

cues.zh: 这会导致心脏
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui4 dao3 zhi4 xin1 zang4
cues.en: which can cause the heart,

cues.zh: 大脑和其他主要血管出现动脉流氧
cues.pinyin: da4 nao3 he2 qi2 ta1 zhu3 yao4 xue4 guan3 chu1 xian4 dong4 mai4 liu2 yang3
cues.en: brain, and other major blood vessels to develop aneurysms,

cues.zh: 狭窄危及生命
cues.pinyin: xia2 zhai3 wei1 ji2 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: narrowing that endangers her life.

cues.zh: 医生可以给大家进行药物治疗
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ke3 yi3 gei3 da4 jia1 jin4 xing2 yao4 wu4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: The doctor could treat her with medication

cues.zh: 控制潜在风险
cues.pinyin: kong4 zhi4 qian2 zai4 feng1 xian3
cues.en: to control the underlying risk,

cues.zh: 并且再做一次手术
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 zai4 zuo4 yi1 ci4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and then perform another surgery

cues.zh: 修复每个动脉瘤
cues.pinyin: xiu1 fu4 mei3 ge4 dong4 mai4 liu2
cues.en: to repair each aneurysm.

cues.zh: 但手术有中风和大出血的风险
cues.pinyin: dan4 shou3 shu4 you3 zhong4 feng1 he2 da4 chu1 xue4 de5 feng1 xian3
cues.en: But that surgery carries a risk of stroke and major bleeding.

cues.zh: 可不做手术的话
cues.pinyin: ke3 bu4 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: On the other hand, if they don't operate,

cues.zh: 动脉瘤破裂只是时间的问题
cues.pinyin: dong4 mai4 liu2 po4 lie4 zhi3 shi4 shi2 jian1 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: the aneurysm rupturing is only a matter of time —

cues.zh: 到时候肯定是死路一条
cues.pinyin: dao4 shi2 hou4 ken3 ding4 shi4 si3 lu4 yi1 tiao2
cues.en: and when it does, death is certain.

cues.zh: 小美选择进行手术
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 xuan3 ze2 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Xiaomei chooses to go through with the surgery.

cues.zh: 但如果出事了的话
cues.pinyin: dan4 ru2 guo3 chu1 shi4 le5 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if something goes wrong,

cues.zh: 希望能让前男友
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 neng2 rang4 qian2 nan2 you3
cues.en: she hopes her ex-boyfriend —

cues.zh: 也就是林医生的现男友告诉自己的父母
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 lin2 yi1 sheng1 de5 xian4 nan2 you3 gao4 su4 zi4 ji3 de5 fu4 mu3
cues.en: that is, Dr. Lin's current boyfriend — will tell her parents,

cues.zh: 因为他不想爸妈从陌生人口中得
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 bu4 xiang3 ba4 ma1 cong2 mo4 sheng1 ren2 kou3 zhong1 de2
cues.en: because she doesn't want her parents to learn

cues.zh: 知自己的死讯
cues.pinyin: zhi1 zi4 ji3 de5 si3 xun4
cues.en: of her death from a stranger.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 林医生都不能放弃小美
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 dou1 bu4 neng2 fang4 qi4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: Dr. Lin refuses to give up on Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 但把人救回来是不可能了
cues.pinyin: dan4 ba3 ren2 jiu4 hui2 lai2 shi4 bu4 ke3 neng2 le5
cues.en: But saving her there turns out to be impossible,

cues.zh: 所以林医生直接赶到了县医院
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 lin2 yi1 sheng1 zhi2 jie1 gan3 dao4 le5 xian4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: so Dr. Lin rushes straight to the county hospital

cues.zh: 给小美做手术
cues.pinyin: gei3 xiao3 mei3 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: to operate on Xiaomei herself.

cues.zh: 她修复了小美所有的动脉瘤
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiu1 fu4 le5 xiao3 mei3 suo3 you3 de5 dong4 mai4 liu2
cues.en: She repairs all of Xiaomei's aneurysms.

cues.zh: 不出一周
cues.pinyin: bu4 chu1 yi1 zhou1
cues.en: Within a week,

cues.zh: 小美就能回家了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 jiu4 neng2 hui2 jia1 le5
cues.en: Xiaomei is able to go home.

cues.zh: 两个前提最终握手言和
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 qian2 ti2 zui4 zhong1 wo4 shou3 yan2 he2
cues.en: The two of them finally make peace,

cues.zh: 将狗男人抛至脑后
cues.pinyin: jiang1 gou3 nan2 ren2 pao1 zhi4 nao3 hou4
cues.en: putting the cheating ex behind her.

cues.zh: 话说肖恩又自闭了
cues.pinyin: hua4 shuo1 xiao4 en1 you4 zi4 bi4 le5
cues.en: Meanwhile, Shaun withdraws into himself again.

cues.zh: 医院搞了个患者评价
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 gao3 le5 ge4 huan4 zhe3 ping2 jia4
cues.en: The hospital has set up a patient review

cues.zh: 对医生打分的系统
cues.pinyin: dui4 yi1 sheng1 da3 fen1 de5 xi4 tong3
cues.en: system for rating doctors.

cues.zh: 结果在一个周期末统计时
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zai4 yi2 ge4 zhou1 qi1 mo4 tong3 ji4 shi2
cues.en: When the results are tallied at the end of one cycle,

cues.zh: 肖恩名字排到了最后
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ming2 zi4 pai2 dao4 le5 zui4 hou4
cues.en: Shaun's name comes in last,

cues.zh: 偏分低到没眼看
cues.pinyin: pian1 fen1 di1 dao4 mei2 yan3 kan4
cues.en: with a score too low to look at.

cues.zh: 网上对肖恩的评价
cues.pinyin: wang3 shang4 dui4 xiao4 en1 de5 ping2 jia4
cues.en: Online comments about Shaun

cues.zh: 都是不尊重别人
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi4 bu4 zun1 zhong4 bie2 ren2
cues.en: all say things like "disrespectful,"

cues.zh: 给我压迫感
cues.pinyin: gei3 wo3 ya1 po4 gan3
cues.en: "makes me feel pressured,"

cues.zh: 这个医生有点怪之类的评价
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yi1 sheng1 you3 dian3 guai4 zhi1 lei4 de5 ping2 jia4
cues.en: and "this doctor is kind of weird."

cues.zh: 肖恩这下老伤情了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhe4 xia4 lao3 shang1 qing2 le5
cues.en: Shaun is really hurt by this.

cues.zh: 发誓要提高自己的分数
cues.pinyin: fa1 shi4 yao4 ti2 gao1 zi4 ji3 de5 fen1 shu4
cues.en: He vows to raise his score.

cues.zh: 老壮是一家五金店的老板
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 shi4 yi1 jia1 wu3 jin1 dian4 de5 lao3 ban3
cues.en: Lao Zhuang owns a hardware store.

cues.zh: 这天点被碰上一群小混混
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 dian3 bei4 peng4 shang4 yi1 qun2 xiao3 hun4 hun4
cues.en: One day he runs into a group of thugs.

cues.zh: 推丧之下
cues.pinyin: tui1 sang4 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: In the scuffle,

cues.zh: 这天碰上了一群小混混
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 peng4 shang4 le5 yi1 qun2 xiao3 hun4 hun4
cues.en: he's slammed into the car's side mirror.

cues.zh: 一整个脸外嘴斜
cues.pinyin: yi1 zheng3 ge4 lian3 wai4 zui3 xie2
cues.en: His whole face ends up twisted.

cues.zh: 进医院检查才发现
cues.pinyin: jin4 yi1 yuan4 jian3 cha2 cai2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Only at the hospital exam do they discover

cues.zh: 腹林八管的骨折导致了舌下出血
cues.pinyin: fu4 lin2 ba1 guan3 de5 gu3 zhe2 dao3 zhi4 le5 she2 xia4 chu1 xie3
cues.en: a jaw fracture has caused bleeding under his tongue,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 下摆骨折了
cues.pinyin: xia4 bai3 gu3 zhe2 le5
cues.en: his jaw is broken.

cues.zh: 女儿认为那群小混混是故意的
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 ren4 wei2 na4 qun2 xiao3 hun4 hun4 shi4 gu4 yi4 de5
cues.en: His daughter believes the thugs did it on purpose.

cues.zh: 这种事情也不是一天两天了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shi4 qing2 ye3 bu2 shi4 yi1 tian1 liang3 tian1 le5
cues.en: This isn't the first time something like this has happened,

cues.zh: 想要报警
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 bao4 jing3
cues.en: and she wants to report it to the police.

cues.zh: 但老壮觉得多一事不如少一事
cues.pinyin: dan4 lao3 zhuang4 jue2 de5 duo1 yi1 shi4 bu4 ru2 shao3 yi1 shi4
cues.en: But Lao Zhuang feels it's better not to make a fuss,

cues.zh: 想大事化小小事化两
cues.pinyin: xiang3 da4 shi4 hua4 xiao3 xiao3 shi4 hua4 liang3
cues.en: wanting to downplay the whole thing.

cues.zh: 正说着呢
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shuo1 zhe5 ne5
cues.en: Just as they're talking about it,

cues.zh: 老壮突然变得呼吸困难
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 tu1 ran2 bian4 de2 hu1 xi1 kun4 nan2
cues.en: Lao Zhuang suddenly can't breathe.

cues.zh: 一看才发现
cues.pinyin: yi1 kan4 cai2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: On checking, they discover

cues.zh: 骨折的骨头和舌头向后滑动
cues.pinyin: gu3 zhe2 de5 gu3 tou5 he2 she2 tou5 xiang4 hou4 hua2 dong4
cues.en: the broken bone and his tongue have slid backward,

cues.zh: 阻塞了他的口液
cues.pinyin: zu3 se4 le5 ta1 de5 kou3 ye4
cues.en: blocking his airway.

cues.zh: 医生立刻给他推进了手术室
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 li4 ke4 gei3 ta1 tui1 jin4 le5 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: The doctors rush him into the operating room.

cues.zh: 医生将老壮的骨折碎片复位
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jiang1 lao3 zhuang4 de5 gu3 zhe2 sui4 pian4 fu4 wei4
cues.en: They reposition the fractured bone fragments.

cues.zh: 科手术图中
cues.pinyin: ke1 shou3 shu4 tu2 zhong1
cues.en: During the surgery,

cues.zh: 老壮心率减缓
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 xin1 lv4 jian3 huan3
cues.en: Lao Zhuang's heart rate slows,

cues.zh: 心跳和碎牙皱降
cues.pinyin: xin1 tiao4 he2 sui4 ya2 zhou4 jiang4
cues.en: and his heart rate and blood pressure suddenly crash.

cues.zh: 黑哥猜测老壮可能会有心脏问题
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 cai1 ce4 lao3 zhuang4 ke3 neng2 hui4 you3 xin1 zang4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Dr. Park suspects Lao Zhuang might have a heart condition

cues.zh: 导致了对麻醉剂的不良反应
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 le5 dui4 ma2 zui4 ji4 de5 bu4 liang2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: causing a bad reaction to the anesthetic.

cues.zh: 但做了超声波和心电图后
cues.pinyin: dan4 zuo4 le5 chao1 sheng1 bo1 he2 xin1 dian4 tu2 hou4
cues.en: But after an ultrasound and an ECG,

cues.zh: 并没有发现什么问题
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: they find nothing wrong.

cues.zh: 而手术中的不良反应
cues.pinyin: er2 shou3 shu4 zhong1 de5 bu4 liang2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: So the reaction during surgery

cues.zh: 大概只是轻微的麻药反应
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 zhi3 shi4 qing1 wei1 de5 ma2 yao4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: was probably just a mild anesthesia response,

cues.zh: 属于正常范围
cues.pinyin: shu3 yu2 zheng4 chang2 fan4 wei2
cues.en: within the normal range.

cues.zh: 但事情似乎并没有那么简单
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qing2 si4 hu1 bing4 mei2 you3 na4 me5 jian3 dan1
cues.en: But things turn out not to be so simple.

cues.zh: 术后老壮又发生了一次心率降低
cues.pinyin: shu4 hou4 lao3 zhuang4 you4 fa1 sheng1 le5 yi1 ci4 xin1 lv4 jiang4 di1
cues.en: After the surgery, Lao Zhuang's heart rate drops again,

cues.zh: 还伴随着窒息危险
cues.pinyin: hai2 ban4 sui2 zhe5 zhi4 xi1 wei1 xian3
cues.en: along with a risk of suffocation.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 感到的不止是伤心
cues.pinyin: gan3 dao4 de5 bu4 zhi3 shi4 shang1 xin1
cues.en: What his daughter feels isn't just sadness,

cues.zh: 还要委屈
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 wei3 qu1
cues.en: but also resentment.

cues.zh: 老壮怎么这样
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 zen3 me5 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: Why is her father like this —

cues.zh: 小心翼翼地活着
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4 di4 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: living so carefully,

cues.zh: 不愿意冒一点风险
cues.pinyin: bu4 yuan4 yi4 mao4 yi4 dian3 feng1 xian3
cues.en: unwilling to take even a small risk,

cues.zh: 就算被小混混袭击
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 bei4 xiao3 hun4 hun4 xi2 ji1
cues.en: not even thinking to call the police

cues.zh: 也不想着报警
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 xiang3 zhe5 bao4 jing3
cues.en: when he's attacked by thugs,

cues.zh: 吃下这个哑巴亏
cues.pinyin: chi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 ya3 ba5 kui1
cues.en: just swallowing the injustice

cues.zh: 继续软弱下去
cues.pinyin: ji4 xu4 ruan3 ruo4 xia4 qu4
cues.en: and staying weak.

cues.zh: 出了这么大的事情
cues.pinyin: chu1 le5 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: Something this serious happened,

cues.zh: 也不告诉自己
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 gao4 su4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: and he still won't even tell his daughter.

cues.zh: 是想自己欺人下去吗
cues.pinyin: shi4 xiang3 zi4 ji3 qi1 ren2 xia4 qu4 ma5
cues.en: Is he trying to keep deceiving himself?

cues.zh: 但朴医生告诉他
cues.pinyin: dan4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: But Dr. Park tells her

cues.zh: 老壮至此也会这样
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 zhi4 ci3 ye3 hui4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: the reason Lao Zhuang is like this

cues.zh: 是为了保护女儿
cues.pinyin: shi4 wei4 le5 bao3 hu4 nv3 er2
cues.en: is to protect his daughter.

cues.zh: 她想独自面对这个世界的恶意
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 du2 zi4 mian4 dui4 zhe4 ge5 shi4 jie4 de5 e4 yi4
cues.en: He wants to face the world's malice alone,

cues.zh: 就像当初来到一厢白手起家
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 dang1 chu1 lai2 dao4 yi1 xiang1 bai2 shou3 qi3 jia1
cues.en: just like back when he built the business from nothing by himself,

cues.zh: 护着她长大一样
cues.pinyin: hu4 zhe5 ta1 zhang3 da4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: shielding her as she grew up.

cues.zh: 是生活逼着她在坚强
cues.pinyin: shi4 sheng1 huo2 bi1 zhe5 ta1 zai4 jian1 qiang2
cues.en: It's life that forced him to be strong.

cues.zh: 在朴医生的劝说之下

cues.zh: 不仅是因为老壮不同意手术

cues.zh: 还不讨喜

cues.zh: 丽雅告诉她

cues.zh: 但肖恩直言

cues.zh: 纠结于此

cues.zh: 这会让你陷入疯狂的漩涡

cues.zh: 男子骑自行车居然骑出了三场手术
cues.pinyin: nan2 zi5 qi2 zi4 xing2 che1 ju1 ran2 qi2 chu1 le5 san1 chang3 shou3 shu4
cues.en: A man riding a bike ended up needing three surgeries.

cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 ta1 zi4 ji3 tai4 dao3 mei2
cues.en: Was it just that he was terribly unlucky,

cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 yi1 sheng1 quan1 qian2 tai4 hei1 xin1 ne5
cues.en: or that doctors are just too money-hungry and heartless?

cues.zh: 萧恩的医院接诊了一个伤势十分严
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 de5 yi1 yuan4 jie1 zhen3 le5 yi2 ge4 shang1 shi4 shi2 fen1 yan2

cues.zh: 心里已经清楚了

cues.en: and already knew in his mind

cues.zh: 飞哥需要做三个手术
cues.pinyin: fei1 ge1 xu1 yao4 zuo4 san1 ge4 shou3 shu4

cues.zh: 才能修复他摔的稀烂的面部骨骼

cues.zh: 把旁边青创的沃尔科医生看得一脸崇拜
cues.pinyin: ba3 pang2 bian1 qing1 chuang4 de5 wo4 er3 ke1 yi1 sheng1 kan4 de2 yi1 lian3 chong2 bai4
cues.en: left the junior doctor Volker nearby looking at him in awe.

cues.zh: 肖恩给大家详细介绍飞哥的手术
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 gei3 da4 jia1 xiang2 xi4 jie4 shao4 fei1 ge1 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Shaun explained Fei's surgeries to everyone in detail.

cues.zh: 第一个手术创作额下气刀
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 shou3 shu4 chuang4 zuo4 e2 xia4 qi4 dao1
cues.en: The first surgery would create a submandibular airway.

cues.zh: 第二个手术修复鼻子附近的颅骨骨折
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 shou3 shu4 xiu1 fu4 bi2 zi5 fu4 jin4 de5 lu2 gu3 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: The second surgery would repair the skull fracture near the nose.

cues.zh: 第三个手术是修复眼眶附近的颅骨骨折
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ge4 shou3 shu4 shi4 xiu1 fu4 yan3 kuang4 fu4 jin4 de5 lu2 gu3 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: The third surgery would repair the skull fracture near the eye socket.

cues.zh: 三个手术听起来是有点多
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 shou3 shu4 ting1 qi3 lai2 shi4 you3 dian3 duo1
cues.en: Three surgeries sounded like a lot.

cues.zh: 沃尔克对肖恩很崇拜
cues.pinyin: wo4 er3 ke4 dui4 xiao4 en1 hen3 chong2 bai4
cues.en: Volker admired Shaun greatly

cues.zh: 没有质疑肖恩的方案
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 zhi4 yi2 xiao4 en1 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: and didn't question his plan at all.

cues.zh: 可艾伦却对肖恩的手术方案不知可否
cues.pinyin: ke3 ai4 lun2 que4 dui4 xiao4 en1 de5 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 bu4 zhi1 ke3 fou3
cues.en: But Ellen was noncommittal about Shaun's surgical plan.

cues.zh: 在手术中
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou3 shu4 zhong1
cues.en: During the surgery,

cues.zh: 艾伦果然提出了一个新的方案
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 guo3 ran2 ti2 chu1 le5 yi2 ge4 xin1 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: Ellen indeed proposed a new plan.

cues.zh: 飞哥或许不需要做三次手术
cues.pinyin: fei1 ge1 huo4 xu3 bu4 xu1 yao4 zuo4 san1 ci4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Fei might not need three surgeries after all.

cues.zh: 按照艾伦的方案
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 ai4 lun2 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: According to Ellen's plan,

cues.zh: 两次手术就能搞定
cues.pinyin: liang3 ci4 shou3 shu4 jiu4 neng2 gao3 ding4
cues.en: two surgeries could get the job done.

cues.zh: 在修复下恶骨的同时修复眼眶
cues.pinyin: zai4 xiu1 fu4 xia4 e4 gu3 de5 tong2 shi2 xiu1 fu4 yan3 kuang4
cues.en: Fixing the jawbone and the eye socket at the same time

cues.zh: 这样飞哥也能早点出现不适
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 fei1 ge1 ye3 neng2 zao3 dian3 chu1 xian4 bu4 shi4
cues.en: would let Fei be discharged sooner too.

cues.zh: 可肖恩觉得这样做风险太大
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao4 en1 jue2 de5 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 feng1 xian3 tai4 da4
cues.en: But Shaun felt this approach was too risky.

cues.zh: 可艾伦直接指出这样做更能省钱
cues.pinyin: ke3 ai4 lun2 zhi2 jie1 zhi3 chu1 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 geng4 neng2 sheng3 qian2
cues.en: Ellen pointed out directly that it would also save money.

cues.zh: 肖恩一时间也不知道还能说啥
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 yi1 shi2 jian1 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 hai2 neng2 shuo1 sha2
cues.en: For a moment Shaun didn't know what else to say.

cues.zh: 可也就在这时候

cues.en: For an ordinary person this wouldn't have been a big deal,

cues.zh: 但是肖恩现在处于极度敏感期
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao4 en1 xian4 zai4 chu3 yu2 ji2 du4 min3 gan3 qi1
cues.en: but Shaun was currently in an extremely sensitive phase.

cues.zh: 那干手机的声音在肖恩耳朵里
cues.pinyin: na4 gan4 shou3 ji1 de5 sheng1 yin1 zai4 xiao4 en1 er3 duo3 li3
cues.en: That hand dryer noise, to Shaun's ears,

cues.zh: 就跟天打雷 P 一样无法很受
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gen1 tian1 da3 lei2 P yi1 yang4 wu2 fa3 hen3 shou4
cues.en: was as unbearable as a thunderclap.

cues.zh: 肖恩把气撒到了萨伦身上
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ba3 qi4 sa1 dao4 le5 sa4 lun2 shen1 shang4
cues.en: Shaun took his frustration out on Salen,

cues.zh: 他把一堆投诉书丢给了萨伦
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 yi1 dui1 tou2 su4 shu1 diu1 gei3 le5 sa4 lun2
cues.en: dumping a stack of complaint forms on her.

cues.zh: 他投诉干手机
cues.pinyin: ta1 tou2 su4 gan4 shou3 ji1
cues.en: He complained about the hand dryer,

cues.zh: 要投诉洗手液
cues.pinyin: yao4 tou2 su4 xi3 shou3 ye4
cues.en: wanted to complain about the hand soap,

cues.zh: 要投诉手术服
cues.pinyin: yao4 tou2 su4 shou3 shu4 fu2
cues.en: and wanted to complain about the surgical gowns.

cues.zh: 萨伦一脸懵逼的看着肖恩
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 yi1 lian3 meng3 bi1 de5 kan4 zhe5 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Salen stared at Shaun completely baffled.

cues.zh: 他知道此时不能跟肖恩对着干
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 dao4 ci3 shi2 bu4 neng2 gen1 xiao4 en1 dui4 zhe5 gan4
cues.en: She knew she couldn't clash with Shaun right now,

cues.zh: 要不然肖恩敢把全员的干手机都砸了
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 xiao4 en1 gan3 ba3 quan2 yuan2 de5 gan4 shou3 ji1 dou1 za2 le5
cues.en: or he might just smash all the hand dryers in the building.

cues.zh: 萨伦安抚肖恩
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 an1 fu3 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Salen tried to soothe Shaun:

cues.zh: 你说的没错
cues.pinyin: ni3 shuo1 de5 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: "You're not wrong,

cues.zh: 我做的也没错
cues.pinyin: wo3 zuo4 de5 ye3 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: and what I did isn't wrong either —

cues.zh: 咱俩都没错
cues.pinyin: zan2 lia3 dou1 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: neither of us is wrong.

cues.zh: 所以肖恩你要乖
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao4 en1 ni3 yao4 guai1
cues.en: So Shaun, be good.

cues.zh: 你可以不用洗手液
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 bu4 yong4 xi3 shou3 ye4
cues.en: You don't have to use the hand soap,

cues.zh: 不用干手机
cues.pinyin: bu4 yong4 gan4 shou3 ji1
cues.en: you don't have to use the hand dryer,

cues.zh: 也可以穿你喜欢的手术服
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 chuan1 ni3 xi3 huan1 de5 shou3 shu4 fu2
cues.en: and you can wear whichever surgical gown you like.

cues.zh: 你要乖哦
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 guai1 o2
cues.en: Just be good, okay?"

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 让每个人的心里的不快都少了不少
cues.pinyin: rang4 mei3 ge4 ren2 de5 xin1 li3 de5 bu4 kuai4 dou1 shao3 le5 bu4 shao3
cues.en: This eased the frustration in everyone's hearts quite a bit.

cues.zh: 艾伦和乌尔克也互相道歉兵士前行了
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 he2 wu1 er3 ke4 ye3 hu4 xiang1 dao4 qian4 bing1 shi4 qian2 xing2 le5
cues.en: Ellen and Volker also apologized to each other and moved on together.

cues.zh: 这也要感谢飞科给他们创造了和好的机会
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 yao4 gan3 xie4 fei1 ke1 gei3 ta1 men5 chuang4 zao4 le5 he2 hao3 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: For that, they had Brother Fei to thank for giving them a chance to make up.

cues.zh: 肖恩这边的难题刚结束
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhe4 bian1 de5 nan2 ti2 gang1 jie2 shu4
cues.en: Just as Shaun's dilemma wrapped up,

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯那边的难题又来了
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 na4 bian1 de5 nan2 ti2 you4 lai2 le5
cues.en: another dilemma arose over on Andrews' side.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯接诊了一个十分奇怪的病人
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 jie1 zhen3 le5 yi2 ge4 shi2 fen1 qi2 guai4 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: Andrews took on a very strange patient —

cues.zh: 他是私生癫痫患者梅姐
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 si1 sheng1 dian1 xian2 huan4 zhe3 mei2 jie3
cues.en: an epilepsy patient named Sister Mei.

cues.zh: 梅姐虽然有癫痫
cues.pinyin: mei2 jie3 sui1 ran2 you3 dian1 xian2
cues.en: Although Sister Mei has epilepsy,

cues.zh: 但是却能跟正常人一样带人接物
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 que4 neng2 gen1 zheng4 chang2 ren2 yi1 yang4 dai4 ren2 jie1 wu4
cues.en: she can still interact with people just like anyone else,

cues.zh: 这都归功于两年前
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dou1 gui1 gong1 yu2 liang3 nian2 qian2
cues.en: and can even drive and cook normally.

cues.zh: 他不说你都不知道他有病
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 shuo1 ni3 dou1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 you3 bing4
cues.en: If she didn't tell you, you'd never know she was sick.

cues.zh: 这调归功于两年前
cues.pinyin: zhe4 diao4 gui1 gong1 yu2 liang3 nian2 qian2
cues.en: That's all thanks to two years ago,

cues.zh: 他脑袋里被植入了一个植入物
cues.pinyin: ta1 nao3 dai4 li3 bei4 zhi2 ru4 le5 yi2 ge4 zhi2 ru4 wu4
cues.en: when an implant was placed in her brain.

cues.zh: 这个植入物有效地抑制了他癫痫发作
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhi2 ru4 wu4 you3 xiao4 di4 yi4 zhi4 le5 ta1 dian1 xian2 fa1 zuo4
cues.en: This implant effectively suppressed her seizures.

cues.zh: 但是梅姐这次来医院却主动要把
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei2 jie3 zhe4 ci4 lai2 yi1 yuan4 que4 zhu3 dong4 yao4 ba3
cues.en: But this time, Sister Mei came to the hospital wanting

cues.zh: 要关门大吉了
cues.pinyin: yao4 guan1 men2 da4 ji2 le5
cues.en: to have the implant removed.

cues.zh: 这因为植入物的研发公司赚不到钱
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yin1 wei4 zhi2 ru4 wu4 de5 yan2 fa1 gong1 si1 zhuan4 bu2 dao4 qian2
cues.en: That's because the company that developed the implant couldn't turn a profit

cues.zh: 要关门大姐了
cues.pinyin: yao4 guan1 men2 da4 jie3 le5
cues.en: and was about to go out of business.

cues.zh: 公司都关门了
cues.pinyin: gong1 si1 dou1 guan1 men2 le5
cues.en: Now that the company had closed down,

cues.zh: 植入物自然也就没法采用
cues.pinyin: zhi2 ru4 wu4 zi4 ran2 ye3 jiu4 mei2 fa3 cai3 yong4
cues.en: the implant naturally couldn't be supported anymore.

cues.zh: 所以梅姐很无奈啊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei2 jie3 hen3 wu2 nai4 a5
cues.en: So Sister Mei was left with no good options.

cues.zh: 几个医生聚在办公室里替梅姐的前途发愁
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 yi1 sheng1 ju4 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 li3 ti4 mei2 jie3 de5 qian2 tu2 fa1 chou2
cues.en: Several doctors gathered in the office worrying about Sister Mei's future.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 取出植物物以后
cues.pinyin: qu3 chu1 zhi2 wu4 wu4 yi3 hou4
cues.en: Once the implant was removed,

cues.zh: 梅姐又要回到每天吃药控制病情的日子
cues.pinyin: mei2 jie3 you4 yao4 hui2 dao4 mei3 tian1 chi1 yao4 kong4 zhi4 bing4 qing2 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: Sister Mei would go back to controlling her condition with daily medication.

cues.zh: 可是只用药物也不一定能控制
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhi3 yong4 yao4 wu4 ye3 bu4 yi2 ding4 neng2 kong4 zhi4
cues.en: But medication alone might not necessarily be able to

cues.zh: 住梅姐的病情
cues.pinyin: zhu4 mei2 jie3 de5 bing4 qing2
cues.en: keep Sister Mei's condition under control.

cues.zh: 她一天至少癫痫 50 次呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 tian1 zhi4 shao3 dian1 xian2 50 ci4 ne5
cues.en: She has seizures at least 50 times a day.

cues.zh: 奥斯玛医生提出
cues.pinyin: ao4 si1 ma3 yi1 sheng1 ti2 chu1
cues.en: Dr. Osma suggested

cues.zh: 不如把她的癫痫病灶直接吸了一劳永逸
cues.pinyin: bu4 ru2 ba3 ta1 de5 dian1 xian2 bing4 zao4 zhi2 jie1 xi1 le5 yi4 lao2 yong3 yi4
cues.en: that they might as well remove her seizure focus directly, once and for all.

cues.zh: 朴一生说这想法太疯狂了
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 zhe4 xiang3 fa3 tai4 feng1 kuang2 le5
cues.en: Dr. Park said that idea was too crazy —

cues.zh: 稍微差一点点梅姐就偏瘫了
cues.pinyin: shao1 wei1 cha4 yi4 dian3 dian3 mei2 jie3 jiu4 pian1 tan1 le5
cues.en: the slightest slip and Sister Mei would end up paralyzed.

cues.zh: 可奥斯玛医生表示
cues.pinyin: ke3 ao4 si1 ma3 yi1 sheng1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: But Dr. Osma said

cues.zh: 自己充分相信安德鲁斯的医术
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 chong1 fen4 xiang1 xin4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 de5 yi1 shu4
cues.en: she fully trusted Andrews' surgical skill.

cues.zh: 别人开刀有几率偏瘫
cues.pinyin: bie2 ren2 kai1 dao1 you3 ji1 lv4 pian1 tan1
cues.en: Other surgeons' patients might have a chance of paralysis,

cues.zh: 咱领导的医术绝对没问题
cues.pinyin: zan2 ling3 dao3 de5 yi1 shu4 jue2 dui4 mei2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: but their boss's skill was absolutely not in question.

cues.zh: 这一码皮拍的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ma3 pi2 pai1 de5
cues.en: That bit of flattery

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯十分舒爽
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 shi2 fen1 shu1 shuang3
cues.en: left Andrews feeling quite pleased,

cues.zh: 而且奥斯玛这个夜线确实让他更勤动
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ao4 si1 ma3 zhe4 ge5 ye4 xian4 que4 shi2 rang4 ta1 geng4 qin2 dong4
cues.en: and Osma's little provocation really did make her more tempted.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯打算大胆试一试
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 da3 suan4 da4 dan3 shi4 yi1 shi4
cues.en: Andrews decided to boldly give it a try.

cues.zh: 就算几个医生
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 ji3 ge4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Just as the doctors

cues.zh: 值得意义满地想给美姐受疏的时候
cues.pinyin: zhi2 de5 yi4 yi4 man3 di4 xiang3 gei3 mei3 jie3 shou4 shu1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: were full of fighting spirit and about to operate on Sister Mei,

cues.zh: 收到了来自老板萨伦的质疑
cues.pinyin: shou1 dao4 le5 lai2 zi4 lao3 ban3 sa4 lun2 de5 zhi4 yi2
cues.en: they received pushback from their boss, Salen.

cues.zh: 萨伦说
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 shuo1
cues.en: Salen said,

cues.zh: 你们这套手术方案太冒险了
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 zhe4 tao4 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 tai4 mao4 xian3 le5
cues.en: "This surgical plan of yours is too risky.

cues.zh: 一旦失误患者没准又要投诉
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 shi1 wu4 huan4 zhe3 mei2 zhun3 you4 yao4 tou2 su4
cues.en: If there's a mistake, the patient might file a complaint again,

cues.zh: 法欧部还得忙着打官司
cues.pinyin: fa3 ou1 bu4 hai2 de2 mang2 zhe5 da3 guan1 si1
cues.en: and legal will be stuck dealing with lawsuits."

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 可是谁能说服萨伦呢
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 shui2 neng2 shuo1 fu2 sa4 lun2 ne5
cues.en: But who could possibly talk Salen out of it?

cues.zh: 那家伙可是钻到前眼子里了
cues.pinyin: na4 jia1 huo5 ke3 shi4 zuan1 dao4 qian2 yan3 zi5 li3 le5
cues.en: That woman was obsessed with money through and through —

cues.zh: 心里眼里只有规避风险
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 yan3 li3 zhi3 you3 gui1 bi4 feng1 xian3
cues.en: all she cared about was avoiding risk

cues.zh: 少有麻烦
cues.pinyin: shao3 you3 ma2 fan2
cues.en: and minimizing trouble.

cues.zh: 于是安德鲁斯把主意打到了亚
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 ba3 zhu3 yi4 da3 dao4 le5 ya4
cues.en: So Andrews set her sights on

cues.zh: 伦院长的身上
cues.pinyin: lun2 yuan4 zhang3 de5 shen1 shang4
cues.en: Director Yalun instead.

cues.zh: 可是亚伦院长已经人老成精了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ya4 lun2 yuan4 zhang3 yi3 jing1 ren2 lao3 cheng2 jing1 le5
cues.en: But Director Yalun was already an old fox,

cues.zh: 才不会掺和到他们这些事中呢
cues.pinyin: cai2 bu2 hui4 chan1 huo5 dao4 ta1 men5 zhe4 xie1 shi4 zhong1 ne5
cues.en: and wasn't about to get mixed up in their business.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯实在没办法了
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 shi2 zai4 mei2 ban4 fa3 le5
cues.en: With no other options left,

cues.zh: 她只好硬着头皮去找萨伦
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 hao3 ying4 zhe5 tou2 pi2 qu4 zhao3 sa4 lun2
cues.en: Andrews had to swallow her pride and go find Salen.

cues.zh: 萨伦是一个杀人思路
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 shi4 yi2 ge4 sha1 ren2 si1 lu4
cues.en: Salen was someone with a businessman's mindset,

cues.zh: 会衡量每一次手术的性价比
cues.pinyin: hui4 heng2 liang2 mei3 yi1 ci4 shou3 shu4 de5 xing4 jia4 bi3
cues.en: who weighed the cost-effectiveness of every single surgery.

cues.zh: 或许帮梅姐做手术的性价比不高
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 bang1 mei2 jie3 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 xing4 jia4 bi3 bu4 gao1
cues.en: Operating on Sister Mei might not be very cost-effective,

cues.zh: 但是安德鲁斯打引卖身给她
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 da3 yin3 mai4 shen1 gei3 ta1
cues.en: but Andrews offered to indenture herself to her —

cues.zh: 帮她做牛做马
cues.pinyin: bang1 ta1 zuo4 niu2 zuo4 ma3
cues.en: to work tirelessly for her —

cues.zh: 做一次性价比低的手术
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yi2 ci4 xing4 jia4 bi3 di1 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: doing one low-value surgery

cues.zh: 再做两次性价比高的手术如何
cues.pinyin: zai4 zuo4 liang3 ci4 xing4 jia4 bi3 gao1 de5 shou3 shu4 ru2 he2
cues.en: in exchange for doing two highly cost-effective ones. How about that?

cues.zh: 萨伦十分的开心同意了
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 shi2 fen1 de5 kai1 xin1 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: Salen was delighted and agreed.

cues.zh: 梅姐终于躺在手术台上了
cues.pinyin: mei2 jie3 zhong1 yu2 tang3 zai4 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4 le5
cues.en: Sister Mei was finally lying on the operating table.

cues.zh: 医生们打开她的头盖骨
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 da3 kai1 ta1 de5 tou2 gai4 gu3
cues.en: The doctors opened up her skull.

cues.zh: 为了预防手术中出现偏差
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 yu4 fang2 shou3 shu4 zhong1 chu1 xian4 pian1 cha1
cues.en: To prevent any deviation during the surgery,

cues.zh: 朴医生他们特意用机器绘图
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 ta1 men5 te4 yi4 yong4 ji1 qi4 hui4 tu2
cues.en: Dr. Park and the others specially used machine mapping

cues.zh: 来识别运动性语言中枢皮层的边界
cues.pinyin: lai2 shi2 bie2 yun4 dong4 xing4 yu3 yan2 zhong1 shu1 pi2 ceng2 de5 bian1 jie4
cues.en: to identify the boundaries of the motor speech center cortex.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个公式预测世界杯决赛：西班牙VS阿根廷谁能捧起大力神杯？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 20 26 年世界杯决赛马上就要打响了
cues.pinyin: 20 26 nian2 shi4 jie4 bei1 jue2 sai4 ma3 shang4 jiu4 yao4 da3 xiang3 le5
cues.en: The 2026 World Cup final is about to kick off.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: A young viewer asked me

cues.zh: 你能不能用数学方法预测一下世界杯
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 bu4 neng2 yong4 shu4 xue2 fang1 fa3 yu4 ce4 yi1 xia4 shi4 jie4 bei1
cues.en: whether I could use math to predict the outcome

cues.zh: 决赛的结果呢
cues.pinyin: jue2 sai4 de5 jie2 guo3 ne5
cues.en: of the World Cup final.

cues.zh: 其实在两年以前我就曾经在世
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zai4 liang3 nian2 yi3 qian2 wo3 jiu4 ceng2 jing1 zai4 shi4
cues.en: Actually, two years ago I already

cues.zh: 界杯小组赛中
cues.pinyin: jie4 bei1 xiao3 zu3 sai4 zhong1
cues.en: made a prediction during the World Cup group stage

cues.zh: 对国足对战日本队的比赛进行
cues.pinyin: dui4 guo2 zu2 dui4 zhan4 ri4 ben3 dui4 de5 bi3 sai4 jin4 xing2
cues.en: for the match between China's national team and Japan,

cues.zh: 过数学的预测
cues.pinyin: guo4 shu4 xue2 de5 yu4 ce4
cues.en: using math.

cues.zh: 最后计算出的结论是
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ji4 suan4 chu1 de5 jie2 lun4 shi4
cues.en: The final calculated conclusion was

cues.zh: 国足只有万分之一的可能性战胜日本队
cues.pinyin: guo2 zu2 zhi3 you3 wan4 fen1 zhi1 yi1 de5 ke3 neng2 xing4 zhan4 sheng4 ri4 ben3 dui4
cues.en: that China had only a one-in-ten-thousand chance of beating Japan.

cues.zh: 最后的结果也证实了我的预测
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 de5 jie2 guo3 ye3 zheng4 shi2 le5 wo3 de5 yu4 ce4
cues.en: The final result confirmed my prediction.

cues.zh: 那今天我就斗胆再来计算一下
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 dou3 dan3 zai4 lai2 ji4 suan4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: So today I'll be bold and calculate again

cues.zh: 医生来了之后告诉她不用担心
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 lai2 le5 zhi1 hou4 gao4 su4 ta1 bu4 yong4 dan1 xin1
cues.en: After the doctor arrived, he told her not to worry.

cues.zh: 这是甲沟炎是常见的细菌引起的脓肿
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 jia3 gou1 yan2 shi4 chang2 jian4 de5 xi4 jun1 yin3 qi3 de5 nong2 zhong3
cues.en: This is paronychia, an abscess commonly caused by bacteria.

cues.zh: 等把脓肿挑破排出来就能回家
cues.pinyin: deng3 ba3 nong2 zhong3 tiao1 po4 pai2 chu1 lai2 jiu4 neng2 hui2 jia1
cues.en: Once the abscess is lanced and drained, she can go home.

cues.zh: 三天后疼痛和肿胀都会消失
cues.pinyin: san1 tian1 hou4 teng2 tong4 he2 zhong3 zhang4 du1 hui4 xiao1 shi1
cues.en: In three days the pain and swelling will go away.

cues.zh: 然后她就可以继续拉小提琴了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ji4 xu4 la1 xiao3 ti2 qin2 le5
cues.en: Then she can go back to playing the violin.

cues.zh: 可是当肖恩帮小美清除脓肿的时候
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dang1 xiao4 en1 bang1 xiao3 mei3 qing1 chu2 nong2 zhong3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But when Shaun was draining Xiao Mei's abscess,

cues.zh: 她疼得忍不住叫了一声
cues.pinyin: ta1 teng2 de2 ren3 bu2 zhu4 jiao4 le5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: she couldn't help but cry out in pain.

cues.zh: 肖恩觉得不对劲啊
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 jue2 de5 bu2 dui4 jin4 a5
cues.en: Shaun felt something was off.

cues.zh: 明明给她做了局部麻醉
cues.pinyin: ming2 ming2 gei3 ta1 zuo4 liao3 ju2 bu4 ma2 zui4
cues.en: She had clearly been given a local anesthetic,

cues.zh: 应该感觉不到疼痛的才对
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 gan3 jue2 bu2 dao4 teng2 tong4 de5 cai2 dui4
cues.en: so she shouldn't have been able to feel pain.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 原来是小美长期拉小提琴
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 shi4 xiao3 mei3 chang2 qi1 la1 xiao3 ti2 qin2
cues.en: It turned out that from playing the violin for so long,

cues.zh: 患上了关节疼痛
cues.pinyin: huan4 shang4 le5 guan1 jie2 teng2 tong4
cues.en: Xiao Mei had developed joint pain.

cues.zh: 是刚才清理的动作牵扯到了手指关节
cues.pinyin: shi4 gang1 cai2 qing1 li3 de5 dong4 zuo4 qian1 che3 dao4 le5 shou3 zhi3 guan1 jie2
cues.en: The motion from the cleaning just now had tugged on her finger joint.

cues.zh: 可肖恩觉得没那么简单
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao4 en1 jue2 de5 mei2 na4 me5 jian3 dan1
cues.en: But Shaun didn't think it was that simple.

cues.zh: 这有可能是食肉菌感染
cues.pinyin: zhe4 you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 shi2 rou4 jun1 gan3 ran3
cues.en: This could be a flesh-eating bacteria infection.

cues.zh: 这样的话就得截掉她的手指了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 hua4 jiu4 de2 jie2 diao4 ta1 de5 shou3 zhi3 le5
cues.en: If so, her finger would have to be amputated.

cues.zh: 食肉菌又称为
cues.pinyin: shi2 rou4 jun1 you4 cheng1 wei2
cues.en: Flesh-eating bacteria are also known as

cues.zh: 食肉菌
cues.pinyin: shi2 rou4 jun1
cues.en: flesh-eating bacteria.

cues.zh: 是一系列菌类的总称
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 xi4 lie4 jun1 lei4 de5 zong3 cheng1
cues.en: It's a general term for a group of bacteria

cues.zh: 能引发坏死性筋膜炎
cues.pinyin: neng2 yin3 fa1 huai4 si3 xing4 jin1 mo2 yan2
cues.en: that can cause necrotizing fasciitis.

cues.zh: 因为临床病症快速而严重
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 lin2 chuang2 bing4 zheng4 kuai4 su4 er2 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: Because the clinical symptoms progress quickly and severely,

cues.zh: 死亡率很高
cues.pinyin: si3 wang2 lv4 hen3 gao1
cues.en: the mortality rate is very high.

cues.zh: 所以才被冠上食人菌的名称
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 bei4 guan1 shang4 shi2 ren2 jun1 de5 ming2 cheng1
cues.en: That's why it's been given the name "man-eating bacteria."

cues.zh: 听到要截掉手指
cues.pinyin: ting1 dao4 yao4 jie2 diao4 shou3 zhi3
cues.en: Upon hearing her finger might be amputated,

cues.zh: 小美惊了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 jing1 le5
cues.en: Xiao Mei was shocked.

cues.zh: 不就是个假钩炎吗
cues.pinyin: bu4 jiu4 shi4 ge4 jia3 gou1 yan2 ma5
cues.en: Isn't it just paronychia?

cues.zh: 怎么会这么严重
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hui4 zhe4 me5 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: How could it be this serious?

cues.zh: 摩根也觉得是小狠小题大做了
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 ye3 jue2 de5 shi4 xiao3 hen3 xiao3 ti2 da4 zuo4 le5
cues.en: Morgan also thought Shaun was overreacting.

cues.zh: 拒绝了她
cues.pinyin: ju4 jue2 le5 ta1
cues.en: She turned down

cues.zh: 要在小美手指伸出做一个切口
cues.pinyin: yao4 zai4 xiao3 mei3 shou3 zhi3 shen1 chu1 zuo4 yi2 ge4 qie1 kou3
cues.en: the proposal to make an incision on Xiao Mei's finger

cues.zh: 取样做检查的提议
cues.pinyin: qu3 yang4 zuo4 jian3 cha2 de5 ti2 yi4
cues.en: and take a sample for testing.

cues.zh: 因为如果这样的话
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ru2 guo3 zhe4 yang4 de5 hua4
cues.en: Because if they did that,

cues.zh: 会对小美的手指造成永久性伤害
cues.pinyin: hui4 dui4 xiao3 mei3 de5 shou3 zhi3 zao4 cheng2 yong3 jiu3 xing4 shang1 hai4
cues.en: it would cause permanent damage to Xiao Mei's finger.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 而就在俩人争执的时候
cues.pinyin: er2 jiu4 zai4 lia3 ren2 zheng1 zhi2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But just as the two of them were arguing,

cues.zh: 小美的体温上升到了 39 度
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 ti3 wen1 shang4 sheng1 dao4 le5 39 du4
cues.en: Xiao Mei's temperature rose to 39 degrees Celsius.

cues.zh: 就连摩根也不得不重视起来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 mo2 gen1 ye3 bu4 de2 bu4 zhong4 shi4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Even Morgan had to take it seriously then.

cues.zh: 同意给她做检测
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi4 gei3 ta1 zuo4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: She agreed to run the test.

cues.zh: 结果显示肖恩是对的
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4 xiao4 en1 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: The results showed Shaun was right.

cues.zh: 小美受伤的手指组织已经死亡
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 shou4 shang1 de5 shou3 zhi3 zu3 zhi1 yi3 jing1 si3 wang2
cues.en: The tissue in Xiao Mei's injured finger had already died.

cues.zh: 而且她的皮下脂肪和筋膜也开始坏死
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 de5 pi2 xia4 zhi1 fang2 he2 jin1 mo2 ye3 kai1 shi3 huai4 si3
cues.en: And her subcutaneous fat and fascia had also started to necrotize.

cues.zh: 现在她们能做的就是给她安排手术
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ta1 men5 neng2 zuo4 de5 jiu4 shi4 gei3 ta1 an1 pai2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Now all they could do was schedule her for surgery

cues.zh: 尽力挽救她的手
cues.pinyin: jin4 li4 wan3 jiu4 ta1 de5 shou3
cues.en: and try their best to save her hand.

cues.zh: 小美被送进来手术室情况不太好
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 bei4 song4 jin4 lai2 shou3 shu4 shi4 qing2 kuang4 bu4 tai4 hao3
cues.en: Xiao Mei was wheeled into the OR in bad condition.

cues.zh: 她的肌肉无力
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 ji1 rou4 wu2 li4
cues.en: Her muscles were weak.

cues.zh: 手术前根本夹不紧
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 qian2 gen1 ben3 jia1 bu4 jin3
cues.en: She couldn't even clench her hand tight before the surgery.

cues.zh: 而且她的组织产生了异味
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 de5 zu3 zhi1 chan3 sheng1 le5 yi4 wei4
cues.en: And her tissue had developed a foul smell,

cues.zh: 就像是臭鸡蛋一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 shi4 chou4 ji1 dan4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: just like rotten eggs.

cues.zh: 如果仔细地为她的手清创
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zi3 xi4 di4 wei4 ta1 de5 shou3 qing1 chuang4
cues.en: But so far they'd only found tissue damage.

cues.zh: 如果仔细地为她的手清闯
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zi3 xi4 di4 wei4 ta1 de5 shou3 qing1 chuang3
cues.en: If they carefully debrided her hand,

cues.zh: 手的活动功能和灵敏度还能保住一部分
cues.pinyin: shou3 de5 huo2 dong4 gong1 neng2 he2 ling2 min3 du4 hai2 neng2 bao3 zhu4 yi1 bu4 fen4
cues.en: some of its mobility and sensitivity could still be preserved.

cues.zh: 可是当手术结束当晚
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dang1 shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 dang4 wan3
cues.en: But the night after the surgery ended,

cues.zh: 小美的血压突然下降
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 xue4 ya1 tu1 ran2 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Xiao Mei's blood pressure suddenly dropped

cues.zh: 心率激增
cues.pinyin: xin1 lv4 ji1 zeng1
cues.en: and her heart rate spiked.

cues.zh: 留守的肖文和摩根
cues.pinyin: liu2 shou3 de5 xiao4 wen2 he2 mo2 gen1
cues.en: Shaun and Morgan, who stayed behind,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 他们谁都不能出去
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shei2 dou1 bu4 neng2 chu1 qu4
cues.en: neither of them could leave.

cues.zh: 摩根表面冷静
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 biao3 mian4 leng3 jing4
cues.en: Morgan looked calm on the surface,

cues.zh: 但却悄悄转过头
cues.pinyin: dan4 que4 qiao1 qiao1 zhuan3 guo4 tou2
cues.en: but she quietly turned her head away

cues.zh: 眼泪落了下来
cues.pinyin: yan3 lei4 la4 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: as tears fell.

cues.zh: 她当初为小美考虑的举动
cues.pinyin: ta1 dang1 chu1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 kao3 lv4 de5 ju3 dong4
cues.en: The decision she'd made for Xiao Mei's sake back then —

cues.zh: 真的错了吗
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 cuo4 le5 ma5
cues.en: was it really wrong?

cues.zh: 难道她要学着消痕那样
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 ta1 yao4 xue2 zhe5 xiao1 hen2 na4 yang4
cues.en: Does she really have to learn to be like Shaun,

cues.zh: 李知道近乎冷血吗
cues.pinyin: li3 zhi1 dao4 jin4 hu1 leng3 xue4 ma5
cues.en: becoming almost cold-blooded?

cues.zh: 另一边
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 小薇因为流了一个小时的鼻血
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 yin1 wei4 liu2 le5 yi2 ge4 xiao3 shi2 de5 bi2 xue4
cues.en: Xiao Wei was sent to the hospital

cues.zh: 而被送进了医院
cues.pinyin: er2 bei4 song4 jin4 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: after her nose bled for a whole hour.

cues.zh: 救护车上
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hu4 che1 shang4
cues.en: In the ambulance,

cues.zh: 救助人员已经进行了堵塞
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhu4 ren2 yuan2 yi3 jing1 jin4 xing2 le5 du3 se4
cues.en: the paramedics had already packed her nose,

cues.zh: 却依旧没用
cues.pinyin: que4 yi1 jiu4 mei2 yong4
cues.en: but it still didn't help.

cues.zh: 丽姆立刻让人给她用上轻孔仪
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 li4 ke4 rang4 ren2 gei3 ta1 yong4 shang4 qing1 kong3 yi2
cues.en: Rheme immediately had someone use a device on her

cues.zh: 擦拭本身上腺素溶液
cues.pinyin: ca1 shi4 ben3 shen1 shang4 xian4 su4 rong2 ye4
cues.en: and apply epinephrine solution

cues.zh: 增加外周血管阻力
cues.pinyin: zeng1 jia1 wai4 zhou1 xue4 guan3 zu3 li4
cues.en: to increase peripheral vascular resistance

cues.zh: 升高血压
cues.pinyin: sheng1 gao1 xue4 ya1
cues.en: and raise her blood pressure,

cues.zh: 然后进行灼伤止血
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jin4 xing2 zhuo2 shang1 zhi3 xue4
cues.en: then cauterize it to stop the bleeding.

cues.zh: 做了处理之后
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 chu3 li3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After they treated her,

cues.zh: 小薇的爸妈找到朴医生
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 ba4 ma1 zhao3 dao4 pu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Xiao Wei's parents went to find Dr. Park.

cues.zh: 说他们觉得女儿是装病
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ta1 men5 jue2 de5 nv3 er2 shi4 zhuang1 bing4
cues.en: They said they thought their daughter was faking it,

cues.zh: 这次鼻血应该是故意的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 bi2 xue4 ying1 gai1 shi4 gu4 yi4 de5
cues.en: and that this nosebleed was probably intentional.

cues.zh: 因为自从他们离婚之后
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zi4 cong2 ta1 men5 li2 hun1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Because ever since their divorce,

cues.zh: 小薇经常出现失眠
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 jing1 chang2 chu1 xian4 shi1 mian2
cues.en: Xiao Wei had often had insomnia,

cues.zh: 呼吸脚痛
cues.pinyin: hu1 xi1 jiao3 tong4
cues.en: rapid breathing, abdominal pain,

cues.zh: 等症状
cues.pinyin: deng3 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: and other symptoms.

cues.zh: 但是去做检查
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qu4 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: But when they ran tests,

cues.zh: 却什么都没有发现
cues.pinyin: que4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4
cues.en: they couldn't find anything.
