items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 后来心理医生告诉他们
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 xin1 li3 yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 ta1 men5
cues.en: Later, a psychiatrist told them

cues.zh: 试图挽救破碎的家庭
cues.pinyin: shi4 tu2 wan3 jiu4 po4 sui4 de5 jia1 ting2
cues.en: it might be that Xiao Wei was subconsciously

cues.zh: 试图挽救破罪的家庭
cues.pinyin: shi4 tu2 wan3 jiu4 po4 zui4 de5 jia1 ting2
cues.en: trying to save their broken family,

cues.zh: 所以才出现这些反应
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 chu1 xian4 zhe4 xie1 fan3 ying4
cues.en: which is why she was having these reactions.

cues.zh: 姚医生也接受了这个说法
cues.pinyin: yao2 yi1 sheng1 ye3 jie1 shou4 le5 zhe4 ge5 shuo1 fa3
cues.en: Dr. Yao accepted this explanation too.

cues.zh: 并且小薇还小
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 xiao3 wei1 hai2 xiao3
cues.en: Also, Xiao Wei was still young,

cues.zh: 肯定难以接受父母的离异
cues.pinyin: ken3 ding4 nan2 yi3 jie1 shou4 fu4 mu3 de5 li2 yi4
cues.en: so she must be finding it hard to accept her parents' divorce.

cues.zh: 再人回来之后
cues.pinyin: zai4 ren2 hui2 lai2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After the family members came back,

cues.zh: 布朗告诉他们
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 gao4 su4 ta1 men5
cues.en: Brown told them

cues.zh: 小薇的鼻孔黏膜非常的薄
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 bi2 kong3 nian2 mo2 fei1 chang2 de5 bao2
cues.en: that the mucous membrane in Xiao Wei's nostril was very thin,

cues.zh: 最好留意一下
cues.pinyin: zui4 hao3 liu2 yi4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: so they should keep an eye on it,

cues.zh: 未来可能复发
cues.pinyin: wei4 lai2 ke3 neng2 fu4 fa1
cues.en: since it might happen again in the future.

cues.zh: 询问得知是小薇最近
cues.pinyin: xun2 wen4 de2 zhi1 shi4 xiao3 wei1 zui4 jin4
cues.en: After asking around, they learned that Xiao Wei had recently

cues.zh: 在吸入一些药物
cues.pinyin: zai4 xi1 ru4 yi1 xie1 yao4 wu4
cues.en: been inhaling some kind of medication,

cues.zh: 因为她一直感到咳嗽和鼻塞
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 yi4 zhi2 gan3 dao4 ke2 sou4 he2 bi2 se4
cues.en: because she'd been feeling coughs and nasal congestion all along,

cues.zh: 爸妈又不怎么管她
cues.pinyin: ba4 ma1 you4 bu4 zen3 me5 guan3 ta1
cues.en: and since her parents barely looked after her,

cues.zh: 所以才自己查了资料买药汁
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 zi4 ji3 cha2 le5 zi1 liao4 mai3 yao4 zhi1
cues.en: she had looked things up herself and bought the medicine.

cues.zh: 那就得了
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 de2 le5
cues.en: That is,

cues.zh: 滥用某种喷雾类药物
cues.pinyin: lan4 yong4 mou3 zhong3 pen1 wu4 lei4 yao4 wu4
cues.en: misuse of a certain kind of nasal spray

cues.zh: 确实会使鼻黏膜病薄
cues.pinyin: que4 shi2 hui4 shi3 bi2 nian2 mo2 bing4 bao2
cues.en: really can make the nasal mucosa thin,

cues.zh: 导致严重流鼻血
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 yan2 zhong4 liu2 bi2 xue4
cues.en: leading to severe nosebleeds.

cues.zh: 只要停了就好
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ting2 le5 jiu4 hao3
cues.en: As long as she stopped using it, she'd be fine.

cues.zh: 这时小薇的父母又因为这次事情吵了起来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 xiao3 wei1 de5 fu4 mu3 you4 yin1 wei4 zhe4 ci4 shi4 qing2 chao3 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: At this point, Xiao Wei's parents started arguing again over this,

cues.zh: 根本不顾小薇的感受
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 bu4 gu4 xiao3 wei1 de5 gan3 shou4
cues.en: completely ignoring how Xiao Wei felt.

cues.zh: 小薇不想听他们争吵
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 bu4 xiang3 ting1 ta1 men5 zheng1 chao3
cues.en: Xiao Wei didn't want to listen to them fighting

cues.zh: 想要离开
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 li2 kai1
cues.en: and wanted to leave,

cues.zh: 却在起床的时候
cues.pinyin: que4 zai4 qi3 chuang2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: but just as she got up —

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 可是他们没在肺组织里找到异常之处
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 mei2 zai4 fei4 zu3 zhi1 li3 zhao3 dao4 yi4 chang2 zhi1 chu4
cues.en: But they didn't find anything abnormal in the lung tissue,

cues.zh: 而且遮气管看起来也很健康
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe1 qi4 guan3 kan4 qi3 lai2 ye3 hen3 jian4 kang1
cues.en: and the trachea looked healthy too.

cues.zh: 这时医生们翻动组织的动作直接切断了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 yi1 sheng1 men5 fan1 dong4 zu3 zhi1 de5 dong4 zuo4 zhi2 jie1 qie1 duan4 le5
cues.en: At that point, the doctors' handling of the tissue accidentally severed

cues.zh: 一处肺液动脉
cues.pinyin: yi1 chu4 fei4 ye4 dong4 mai4
cues.en: a pulmonary artery.

cues.zh: 小微立刻心理趋增陷入危险
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 li4 ke4 xin1 li3 qu1 zeng1 xian4 ru4 wei1 xian3
cues.en: Xiao Wei's heart rate suddenly spiked and she was in danger.

cues.zh: 为了应对
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 ying4 dui4
cues.en: To deal with it,

cues.zh: 医生立刻给小微开胸进行动脉管止血
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 li4 ke4 gei3 xiao3 wei1 kai1 xiong1 jin4 xing2 dong4 mai4 guan3 zhi3 xue4
cues.en: the doctors immediately opened her chest to stop the arterial bleeding.

cues.zh: 她的情况这才渐渐稳定
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 qing2 kuang4 zhe4 cai2 jian4 jian4 wen3 ding4
cues.en: Her condition then gradually stabilized.

cues.zh: 丽姆突然摇摇头
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 tu1 ran2 yao2 yao2 tou2
cues.en: Rheme suddenly shook her head.

cues.zh: 这是不对的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 bu2 dui4 de5
cues.en: This isn't right.

cues.zh: 小微的动脉密不应该这么脆弱
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 dong4 mai4 mi4 bu4 ying1 gai1 zhe4 me5 cui4 ruo4
cues.en: Xiao Wei's artery wall shouldn't be this fragile.

cues.zh: 肯定有什么原因让他的动脉壁变薄了
cues.pinyin: ken3 ding4 you3 shen2 me5 yuan2 yin1 rang4 ta1 de5 dong4 mai4 bi4 bian4 bao2 le5
cues.en: There must be some reason her artery wall had thinned.

cues.zh: 针对这个猜测
cues.pinyin: zhen1 dui4 zhe4 ge5 cai1 ce4
cues.en: Based on this suspicion,

cues.zh: 医生们继续翻找
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 ji4 xu4 fan1 zhao3
cues.en: the doctors kept searching.

cues.zh: 最终在右肺下液
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 zai4 you4 fei4 xia4 ye4
cues.en: Finally, in the lower lobe of the right lung,

cues.zh: 发现了一个局部肉芽种
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 le5 yi2 ge4 ju2 bu4 rou4 ya2 zhong3
cues.en: they found a localized granuloma.

cues.zh: 但这不是肿瘤
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 bu2 shi4 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: But this wasn't a tumor.

cues.zh: 当他们把肺液拉开
cues.pinyin: dang1 ta1 men5 ba3 fei4 ye4 la1 kai1
cues.en: When they pulled the lung lobe open,

cues.zh: 医生把肋骨碎片小心地取出
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ba3 lei4 gu3 sui4 pian4 xiao3 xin1 di4 qu3 chu1
cues.en: they found a piece of rib bone underneath.

cues.zh: 终于找到原因了
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 zhao3 dao4 yuan2 yin1 le5
cues.en: They had finally found the cause.

cues.zh: 医生把肋膏小心地取出
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ba3 le1 gao1 xiao3 xin1 di4 qu3 chu1
cues.en: The doctor carefully removed the rib fragment

cues.zh: 然后进行了缝合
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jin4 xing2 le5 feng2 he2
cues.en: and then stitched her up.

cues.zh: 等到小微醒后
cues.pinyin: deng3 dao4 xiao3 wei1 xing3 hou4
cues.en: After Xiao Wei woke up,

cues.zh: 丽姆把这块肋膏交给了他
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 ba3 zhe4 kuai4 le1 gao1 jiao1 gei3 le5 ta1
cues.en: Rheme handed her the piece of rib bone.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 动动脑时间4｜为什么两人卖苹果的钱会不够分呢？｜大大小小

cues.zh: 小明和小华各带 30 颗苹果到市场卖
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 he2 xiao3 hua2 ge4 dai4 30 ke1 ping2 guo3 dao4 shi4 chang3 mai4
cues.en: Xiaoming and Xiaohua each brought 30 apples to sell at the market.

cues.zh: 小明要卖 3 颗 100 元
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 yao4 mai4 3 ke1 100 yuan2
cues.en: Xiaoming wanted to sell 3 for 100 yuan.

cues.zh: 小华要卖 2 颗 100 元
cues.pinyin: xiao3 hua2 yao4 mai4 2 ke1 100 yuan2
cues.en: Xiaohua wanted to sell 2 for 100 yuan.

cues.zh: 他们正准备摆摊的时候想到两个人分开卖
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zheng4 zhun3 bei4 bai3 tan1 de5 shi2 hou4 xiang3 dao4 liang3 ge4 ren2 fen1 kai1 mai4
cues.en: Just as they were about to set up their stall, they thought that selling separately

cues.zh: 会互相抢生意
cues.pinyin: hui4 hu4 xiang1 qiang3 sheng1 yi4
cues.en: would mean they'd steal business from each other.

cues.zh: 所以就改把两个人的苹果一起卖
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 gai3 ba3 liang3 ge4 ren2 de5 ping2 guo3 yi4 qi3 mai4
cues.en: So they decided to sell both of their apples together instead.

cues.zh: 他们都想用自己原本的价格卖
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 xiang3 yong4 zi4 ji3 yuan2 ben3 de5 jia4 ge2 mai4
cues.en: They both still wanted to sell at their own original price.

cues.zh: 3 颗 100 元跟 2 颗 100 元合起来就是 5 颗 200 元
cues.pinyin: 3 ke1 100 yuan2 gen1 2 ke1 100 yuan2 he2 qi3 lai2 jiu4 shi4 5 ke1 200 yuan2
cues.en: 3 for 100 yuan plus 2 for 100 yuan combined makes 5 for 200 yuan.

cues.zh: 就这样把 60 颗苹果都卖光了卖得 24 00 元
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 yang4 ba3 60 ke1 ping2 guo3 dou1 mai4 guang1 le5 mai4 de2 24 00 yuan2
cues.en: That's how they sold all 60 apples and made 2400 yuan.

cues.zh: 但是等他们回家的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 deng3 ta1 men5 hui2 jia1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But when they got home,

cues.zh: 小明要分一千元
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 yao4 fen1 yi1 qian1 yuan2
cues.en: Xiaoming was supposed to get 1000 yuan,

cues.zh: 小华要分一千五百元
cues.pinyin: xiao3 hua2 yao4 fen1 yi1 qian1 wu3 bai3 yuan2
cues.en: and Xiaohua was supposed to get 1500 yuan.

cues.zh: 但钱不够分
cues.pinyin: dan4 qian2 bu4 gou4 fen1
cues.en: But there wasn't enough money to split that way.

cues.zh: 到底是哪里出了问题呢
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 na3 li3 chu1 le5 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: So where exactly did it go wrong?

cues.zh: 你知道答案吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 ma5
cues.en: Do you know the answer?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 动动脑时间4｜为什么两人卖苹果的钱会不够分呢？｜大大小小

cues.zh: 欢迎在下方留言告诉大家喔
cues.pinyin: huan1 ying2 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o1
cues.en: Feel free to leave a comment below and tell everyone.

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这喔
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o1
cues.en: The answer to the last episode's riddle is here.

cues.zh: 两个人在两天用两桶水
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 zai4 liang3 tian1 yong4 liang3 tong3 shui3
cues.en: Two people use two buckets of water in two days.

cues.zh: 那么两人一天就是用一桶水
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 liang3 ren2 yi1 tian1 jiu4 shi4 yong4 yi1 tong3 shui3
cues.en: So one person uses one bucket of water in one day.

cues.zh: 八个人一天就是用四桶水
cues.pinyin: ba1 ge4 ren2 yi1 tian1 jiu4 shi4 yong4 si4 tong3 shui3
cues.en: Eight people use four buckets of water in one day.

cues.zh: 八个人八天也就是用了三十二桶水
cues.pinyin: ba1 ge4 ren2 ba1 tian1 ye3 jiu4 shi4 yong4 le5 san1 shi2 er4 tong3 shui3
cues.en: Eight people over eight days use thirty-two buckets of water.

cues.zh: 另外还有一个脑筋急转弯的答案
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 nao3 jin1 ji2 zhuan3 wan1 de5 da2 an4
cues.en: There's also another answer to this brain teaser.

cues.zh: 两个人每个人都用了一天的水
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 yong4 le5 yi1 tian1 de5 shui3
cues.en: Each of the two people used one day's worth of water,

cues.zh: 总共用了两桶水
cues.pinyin: zong3 gong4 yong4 le5 liang3 tong3 shui3
cues.en: for a total of two buckets of water.

cues.zh: 总共花的时间
cues.pinyin: zong3 gong4 hua1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: As for the total time spent,

cues.zh: 一天加一天等于两天
cues.pinyin: yi1 tian1 jia1 yi1 tian1 deng3 yu2 liang3 tian1
cues.en: one day plus one day equals two days.

cues.zh: 也就是一人一天用一桶水
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ren2 yi1 tian1 yong4 yi1 tong3 shui3
cues.en: That means one person uses one bucket of water per day.

cues.zh: 那么八个人每个人用一天的水
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ba1 ge4 ren2 mei3 ge4 ren2 yong4 yi1 tian1 de5 shui3
cues.en: So for eight people, each using one day's worth of water,

cues.zh: 总共花了八天的时间
cues.pinyin: zong3 gong4 hua1 le5 ba1 tian1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: it took a total of eight days.

cues.zh: 所以答案就是八桶水
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 da2 an4 jiu4 shi4 ba1 tong3 shui3
cues.en: So the answer is eight buckets of water.

cues.zh: 你喜欢哪一个答案呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 xi3 huan1 na3 yi2 ge4 da2 an4 ne5
cues.en: Which answer do you like better?

cues.zh: 也可以在下方留言讨论哦
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 tao3 lun4 o2
cues.en: Feel free to discuss in the comments below too.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 今天由我继续为大家导读爱因
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 you2 wo3 ji4 xu4 wei4 da4 jia1 dao3 du2 ai4 yin1
cues.en: Today I'll continue guiding you through Einstein's

cues.zh: 斯坦的小册子
cues.pinyin: si1 tan3 de5 xiao3 ce4 zi5
cues.en: booklet,

cues.zh: 狭义与广义相对论浅说
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian3 shuo1
cues.en: "Relativity: The Special and General Theory, A Popular Exposition."

cues.zh: 在爱因斯坦年轻的时候特别喜欢读书
cues.pinyin: zai4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 nian2 qing1 de5 shi2 hou4 te4 bie2 xi3 huan1 du2 shu1
cues.en: When Einstein was young he especially loved reading.

cues.zh: 比如他阅读了很多庞加莱的著作
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ta1 yue4 du2 le5 hen3 duo1 pang2 jia1 lai2 de5 zhu4 zuo4
cues.en: For example, he read many works by Poincaré.

cues.zh: 庞加莱是继高斯和黎曼之后世界上最伟大
cues.pinyin: pang2 jia1 lai2 shi4 ji4 gao1 si1 he2 li2 man4 zhi1 hou4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 wei3 da4
cues.en: Poincaré was, after Gauss and Riemann, one of the greatest

cues.zh: 的数学家之一
cues.pinyin: de5 shu4 xue2 jia1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: mathematicians in the world.

cues.zh: 他的许多工作对相对论的提出产
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xu3 duo1 gong1 zuo4 dui4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 ti2 chu1 chan3
cues.en: Many of his works had an important

cues.zh: 生了重要影响
cues.pinyin: sheng1 le5 zhong4 yao4 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: influence on the development of relativity.

cues.zh: 甚至一度有人认为庞加莱才是相
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 yi2 du4 you3 ren2 ren4 wei2 pang2 jia1 lai2 cai2 shi4 xiang1
cues.en: Some even once thought Poincaré was actually the

cues.zh: 对论的提出者
cues.pinyin: dui4 lun4 de5 ti2 chu1 zhe3
cues.en: one who first proposed relativity.

cues.zh: 同时庞加莱也是一名科学哲学家
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 pang2 jia1 lai2 ye3 shi4 yi1 ming2 ke1 xue2 zhe2 xue2 jia1
cues.en: At the same time, Poincaré was also a philosopher of science.

cues.zh: 他曾经写过一本小册子科学与假设
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 jing1 xie3 guo4 yi1 ben3 xiao3 ce4 zi5 ke1 xue2 yu3 jia3 she4
cues.en: He once wrote a booklet called "Science and Hypothesis."

cues.zh: 在这本书中庞加莱提出
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ben3 shu1 zhong1 pang2 jia1 lai2 ti2 chu1
cues.en: In this book, Poincaré proposed that

cues.zh: 想把两个不在一起的时钟对齐
cues.pinyin: xiang3 ba3 liang3 ge4 bu4 zai4 yi4 qi3 de5 shi2 zhong1 dui4 qi2
cues.en: trying to synchronize two clocks that aren't together

cues.zh: 并不是一件容易的事
cues.pinyin: bing4 bu2 shi4 yi1 jian4 rong2 yi4 de5 shi4
cues.en: is not an easy thing to do.

cues.zh: 比如在北京有一个钟表
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zai4 bei3 jing1 you3 yi2 ge4 zhong1 biao3
cues.en: For example, there's a clock in Beijing,

cues.zh: 在上海有另外一个钟表
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang4 hai3 you3 ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 zhong1 biao3
cues.en: and another clock in Shanghai.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 我们通过什么方法能够把两个钟表对准呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 tong1 guo4 shen2 me5 fang1 fa3 neng2 gou4 ba3 liang3 ge4 zhong1 biao3 dui4 zhun3 ne5
cues.en: What method can we use to synchronize the two clocks?

cues.zh: 大家注意
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: Pay attention, everyone.

cues.zh: 你不能回答我说
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 neng2 hui2 da2 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: You can't answer by saying,

cues.zh: 打开电脑查询标准北京时间
cues.pinyin: da3 kai1 dian4 nao3 cha2 xun2 biao1 zhun3 bei3 jing1 shi2 jian1
cues.en: "Just check the standard Beijing time on a computer."

cues.zh: 因为能够用电脑查询标准北京
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 neng2 gou4 yong4 dian4 nao3 cha2 xun2 biao1 zhun3 bei3 jing1
cues.en: Because the premise for being able to check standard Beijing

cues.zh: 时间的前提是
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 de5 qian2 ti2 shi4
cues.en: time on a computer

cues.zh: 我们的确有方法对齐不同地点的时钟
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 que4 you3 fang1 fa3 dui4 qi2 bu4 tong2 di4 dian3 de5 shi2 zhong1
cues.en: is that we already have a way to synchronize clocks in different places.

cues.zh: 我们所问的就是这种对中的方法
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 suo3 wen4 de5 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 dui4 zhong1 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: What we're asking is exactly what this method of

cues.zh: 究竟是什么
cues.pinyin: jiu1 jing4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: synchronization actually is.

cues.zh: 你可能会想到
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 neng2 hui4 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: You might think of this:

cues.zh: 我们先在北京对好两个时钟
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 zai4 bei3 jing1 dui4 hao3 liang3 ge4 shi2 zhong1
cues.en: first synchronize the two clocks in Beijing,

cues.zh: 然后再把其中一个拿到上海去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 ba3 qi2 zhong1 yi2 ge4 na2 dao4 shang4 hai3 qu4
cues.en: then take one of them to Shanghai.

cues.zh: 这个不行吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bu4 xing2 ma5
cues.en: Wouldn't that work?

cues.zh: 可是在移动的过程之中
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 yi2 dong4 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: But during the process of moving,

cues.zh: 谁也不能保证时钟的走时
cues.pinyin: shui2 ye3 bu4 neng2 bao3 zheng4 shi2 zhong1 de5 zou3 shi2
cues.en: no one can guarantee that the clock's timekeeping

cues.zh: 不发生任何变化
cues.pinyin: bu4 fa1 sheng1 ren4 he2 bian4 hua4
cues.en: won't change at all.

cues.zh: 当它移动到上海的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 ta1 yi2 dong4 dao4 shang4 hai3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: By the time it's moved to Shanghai,

cues.zh: 未必能和北京的时钟保持同步
cues.pinyin: wei4 bi4 neng2 he2 bei3 jing1 de5 shi2 zhong1 bao3 chi2 tong2 bu4
cues.en: it might not stay in sync with the clock in Beijing.

cues.zh: 对于这个问题
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Regarding this problem,

cues.zh: 庞家来提出过一种猜想
cues.pinyin: pang2 jia1 lai2 ti2 chu1 guo4 yi1 zhong3 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: Poincaré proposed a conjecture.

cues.zh: 他认为应该通过一种约定
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 ying1 gai1 tong1 guo4 yi1 zhong3 yue1 ding4
cues.en: He thought it should be resolved through a convention

cues.zh: 来解决时钟的对齐问题
cues.pinyin: lai2 jie3 jue2 shi2 zhong1 de5 dui4 qi2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: to solve the problem of synchronizing clocks.

cues.zh: 最简单的约定
cues.pinyin: zui4 jian3 dan1 de5 yue1 ding4
cues.en: The simplest convention—

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦发展了庞加莱的理论
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 fa1 zhan3 le5 pang2 jia1 lai2 de5 li3 lun4
cues.en: Einstein developed Poincaré's theory.

cues.zh: 他说光速在任何惯性参考系中都保持不变
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 guang1 su4 zai4 ren4 he2 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 zhong1 du1 bao3 chi2 bu4 bian4
cues.en: He said the speed of light stays constant in every inertial reference frame.

cues.zh: 这就是光速不变假设
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 guang1 su4 bu4 bian4 jia3 she4
cues.en: This is the postulate of the constancy of the speed of light.

cues.zh: 根据这个假设
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 ge5 jia3 she4
cues.en: Based on this postulate,

cues.zh: 绝对的时间是不存在的
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 de5 shi2 jian1 shi4 bu4 cun2 zai4 de5
cues.en: absolute time does not exist.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦在本书中
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 ben3 shu1 zhong1
cues.en: In this book, Einstein

cues.zh: 用一个闪电劈火车的例子说明了这个道理
cues.pinyin: yong4 yi2 ge4 shan3 dian4 pi1 huo3 che1 de5 li4 zi5 shuo1 ming2 le5 zhe4 ge5 dao4 li3
cues.en: used an example of lightning striking a train to explain this principle.

cues.zh: 我们把这个例子修改一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 li4 zi5 xiu1 gai3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's modify this example a bit

cues.zh: 让它更加方便理解
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 geng4 jia1 fang1 bian4 li3 jie3
cues.en: to make it easier to understand.

cues.zh: 有一辆急迟的高铁中有一节餐车
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 liang4 ji2 chi2 de5 gao1 tie3 zhong1 you3 yi1 jie2 can1 che1
cues.en: A speeding high-speed train has a dining car.

cues.zh: 在餐车的头部和尾部各有一个
cues.pinyin: zai4 can1 che1 de5 tou2 bu4 he2 wei3 bu4 ge4 you3 yi2 ge4
cues.en: At the front and back of the dining car there is each

cues.zh: 乘客准备用餐
cues.pinyin: cheng2 ke4 zhun3 bei4 yong4 can1
cues.en: a passenger preparing to eat.

cues.zh: 逝者站在车厢正中央点亮了一盏灯
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhe3 zhan4 zai4 che1 xiang1 zheng4 zhong1 yang1 dian3 liang4 le5 yi1 zhan3 deng1
cues.en: The attendant stands right in the middle of the car and turns on a light.

cues.zh: 这盏灯会向前方和后方发出光线
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhan3 deng1 hui4 xiang4 qian2 fang1 he2 hou4 fang1 fa1 chu1 guang1 xian4
cues.en: This light sends out beams both forward and backward.

cues.zh: 这就是说火车上的侍者认为同时发生的事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 huo3 che1 shang4 de5 shi4 zhe3 ren4 wei2 tong2 shi2 fa1 sheng1 de5 shi4
cues.en: When the two passengers see the light, they start eating.

cues.zh: 因为两名乘客到逝者的距离是一样的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 liang3 ming2 cheng2 ke4 dao4 shi4 zhe3 de5 ju4 li2 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: Because the distance from each passenger to the attendant is the same,

cues.zh: 而光的传播速度也是一样的
cues.pinyin: er2 guang1 de5 chuan2 bo1 su4 du4 ye3 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: and the speed of light is also the same,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 这就是说火车上的逝者认为同时发生的事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 huo3 che1 shang4 de5 shi4 zhe3 ren4 wei2 tong2 shi2 fa1 sheng1 de5 shi4
cues.en: this means the attendant on the train thinks the two events happen at the same time,

cues.zh: 地面上的倒叉工却认为是一先一后发生的
cues.pinyin: di4 mian4 shang4 de5 dao4 cha1 gong1 que4 ren4 wei2 shi4 yi1 xian1 yi1 hou4 fa1 sheng1 de5
cues.en: but a switchman on the ground thinks they happen one after the other.

cues.zh: 同时是具有相对性的
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 shi4 ju4 you3 xiang1 dui4 xing4 de5
cues.en: Simultaneity is relative.

cues.zh: 在一个参考系下同时发生
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4 tong2 shi2 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: Events simultaneous in one reference frame

cues.zh: 换一个参考系就会一先一后
cues.pinyin: huan4 yi2 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4 jiu4 hui4 yi1 xian1 yi1 hou4
cues.en: become sequential in a different reference frame.

cues.zh: 所以宇宙中不存在一个统一的时间
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yu3 zhou4 zhong1 bu4 cun2 zai4 yi2 ge4 tong3 yi1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: So there's no single unified time in the universe

cues.zh: 永恒不变的流逝
cues.pinyin: yong3 heng2 bu4 bian4 de5 liu2 shi4
cues.en: flowing forever unchanged.

cues.zh: 紧跟着爱因斯坦指出
cues.pinyin: jin3 gen1 zhe5 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zhi3 chu1
cues.en: Right after this, Einstein points out

cues.zh: 既然时间具有相对性
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 shi2 jian1 ju4 you3 xiang1 dui4 xing4
cues.en: that since time is relative,

cues.zh: 那么空间尺寸也会具有相对性
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 kong1 jian1 chi3 cun4 ye3 hui4 ju4 you3 xiang1 dui4 xing4
cues.en: spatial dimensions must also be relative.

cues.zh: 像欧吉里德几何中那种刚性的
cues.pinyin: xiang4 ou1 ji2 li3 de2 ji3 he2 zhong1 na4 zhong3 gang1 xing4 de5
cues.en: A rigid, absolutely unchanging length like the kind in

cues.zh: 绝对不变的长度是不存在的
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 bu4 bian4 de5 chang2 du4 shi4 bu4 cun2 zai4 de5
cues.en: Euclidean geometry does not exist.

cues.zh: 你看啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 a5
cues.en: Look at it this way:

cues.zh: 如果你想测量一列火车的长度
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 ce4 liang2 yi1 lie4 huo3 che1 de5 chang2 du4
cues.en: if you want to measure the length of a train,

cues.zh: 你就需要一把尺子放在火车的旁边
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 xu1 yao4 yi1 ba3 chi3 zi5 fang4 zai4 huo3 che1 de5 pang2 bian1
cues.en: you need to place a ruler next to the train

cues.zh: 同时读出火车头部和尾部对齐的刻度
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 du2 chu1 huo3 che1 tou2 bu4 he2 wei3 bu4 dui4 qi2 de5 ke4 du4
cues.en: and simultaneously read the markings aligned with the train's front and back.

cues.zh: 然后把它们做差就得到了火车的长度
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 ta1 men5 zuo4 cha4 jiu4 de2 dao4 le5 huo3 che1 de5 chang2 du4
cues.en: Then subtract them to get the train's length.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 但是除非这把尺子跟火车相对静止
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 chu2 fei1 zhe4 ba3 chi3 zi5 gen1 huo3 che1 xiang1 dui4 jing4 zhi3
cues.en: But unless this ruler is at rest relative to the train,

cues.zh: 你读首尾两个刻度的时间才可以不一样
cues.pinyin: ni3 du2 shou3 wei3 liang3 ge4 ke4 du4 de5 shi2 jian1 cai2 ke3 yi3 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: the times at which you read the two end marks don't need to match.

cues.zh: 否则假如火车在地面上飞奔
cues.pinyin: fou3 ze2 jia3 ru2 huo3 che1 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 fei1 ben1
cues.en: Otherwise, if the train is speeding along the ground,

cues.zh: 你必须同时读出两个刻度
cues.pinyin: ni3 bi4 xu1 tong2 shi2 du2 chu1 liang3 ge4 ke4 du4
cues.en: you must read the two marks at the same time

cues.zh: 才能准确测出火车长度
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 zhun3 que4 ce4 chu1 huo3 che1 chang2 du4
cues.en: in order to accurately measure the train's length.

cues.zh: 可是我们知道同时是跟参考系有关的
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 tong2 shi2 shi4 gen1 can1 kao3 xi4 you3 guan1 de5
cues.en: But we know that simultaneity depends on the reference frame.

cues.zh: 在某个参考系上同时发生的事
cues.pinyin: zai4 mou3 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4 shang4 tong2 shi2 fa1 sheng1 de5 shi4
cues.en: Events that happen simultaneously in one reference frame

cues.zh: 换一个参考系就不是同时了
cues.pinyin: huan4 yi2 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4 jiu4 bu2 shi4 tong2 shi2 le5
cues.en: are no longer simultaneous in a different reference frame.

cues.zh: 这样一来火车的长度也就跟参考系有关了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 huo3 che1 de5 chang2 du4 ye3 jiu4 gen1 can1 kao3 xi4 you3 guan1 le5
cues.en: As a result, the train's length also depends on the reference frame.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦说麦克斯韦方程组计算出的
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shuo1 mai4 ke4 si1 wei2 fang1 cheng2 zu3 ji4 suan4 chu1 de5
cues.en: Einstein said the speed of light calculated from Maxwell's equations

cues.zh: 光速是恒定的
cues.pinyin: guang1 su4 shi4 heng2 ding4 de5
cues.en: is constant.

cues.zh: 我们又假设光速在所有参考系
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 you4 jia3 she4 guang1 su4 zai4 suo3 you3 can1 kao3 xi4
cues.en: We also assume the speed of light is the same

cues.zh: 下都是一样的
cues.pinyin: xia4 dou1 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: in every reference frame.

cues.zh: 所以我们当然应该认为麦克斯韦方程组
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 dang1 ran2 ying1 gai1 ren4 wei2 mai4 ke4 si1 wei2 fang1 cheng2 zu3
cues.en: So we should of course believe that Maxwell's equations

cues.zh: 在所有惯性参考系下都是成立的了
cues.pinyin: zai4 suo3 you3 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4 dou1 shi4 cheng2 li4 de5 le5
cues.en: hold true in every inertial reference frame.

cues.zh: 而伽利略早就告诉我们力学规律
cues.pinyin: er2 jia1 li4 lve4 zao3 jiu4 gao4 su4 wo3 men5 li4 xue2 gui1 lv4
cues.en: And Galileo had already told us the laws of mechanics (hold the same way).

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦导出了不同参考系下
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 dao3 chu1 le5 bu4 tong2 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4
cues.en: Einstein derived the laws governing how time and space

cues.zh: 时间和空间的变化规律
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 he2 kong1 jian1 de5 bian4 hua4 gui1 lv4
cues.en: change across different reference frames.

cues.zh: 这就是著名的洛伦兹变换
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 zhu4 ming2 de5 luo4 lun2 zi1 bian4 huan4
cues.en: This is the famous Lorentz transformation.

cues.zh: 之所以叫洛伦兹变换
cues.pinyin: zhi1 suo3 yi3 jiao4 luo4 lun2 zi1 bian4 huan4
cues.en: The reason it's called the Lorentz transformation

cues.zh: 是因为这个规律最早是洛伦兹提出的
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 gui1 lv4 zui4 zao3 shi4 luo4 lun2 zi1 ti2 chu1 de5
cues.en: is because this law was first proposed by Lorentz.

cues.zh: 他为了解释迈克尔索莫雷实验
cues.pinyin: ta1 wei4 le5 jie3 shi4 mai4 ke4 er3 suo3 mo4 lei2 shi2 yan4
cues.en: In order to explain the Michelson–Morley experiment,

cues.zh: 提出了物体在运动的方向上长度会收缩
cues.pinyin: ti2 chu1 le5 wu4 ti3 zai4 yun4 dong4 de5 fang1 xiang4 shang4 chang2 du4 hui4 shou1 suo1
cues.en: he proposed that an object's length contracts in its direction of motion,

cues.zh: 而且还得出了正确的公式
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 de2 chu1 le5 zheng4 que4 de5 gong1 shi4
cues.en: and he even derived the correct formula.

cues.zh: 只可惜洛伦兹认为的收缩
cues.pinyin: zhi3 ke3 xi1 luo4 lun2 zi1 ren4 wei2 de5 shou1 suo1
cues.en: It's just a shame that the contraction Lorentz imagined

cues.zh: 是物体在绝对空间中的实际收缩
cues.pinyin: shi4 wu4 ti3 zai4 jue2 dui4 kong1 jian1 zhong1 de5 shi2 ji4 shou1 suo1
cues.en: was an object's actual contraction in absolute space.

cues.zh: 他甚至还带着学生研究
cues.pinyin: ta1 shen4 zhi4 hai2 dai4 zhe5 xue2 sheng1 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: He even worked with students to study

cues.zh: 在收缩过程中
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou1 suo1 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: during the contraction process,

cues.zh: 电荷密度的变化会造成什么影响
cues.pinyin: dian4 he4 mi4 du4 de5 bian4 hua4 hui4 zao4 cheng2 shen2 me5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: what effect the change in charge density would cause.

cues.zh: 但是我们之后就会看到
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 hui4 kan4 dao4
cues.en: But as we'll see later,

cues.zh: 这种收缩并不是物体在时空中的收缩
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shou1 suo1 bing4 bu2 shi4 wu4 ti3 zai4 shi2 kong1 zhong1 de5 shou1 suo1
cues.en: this contraction isn't actually an object's contraction in spacetime,

cues.zh: 而只是因为观察者所在的时空
cues.pinyin: er2 zhi3 shi4 yin1 wei4 guan1 cha2 zhe3 suo3 zai4 de5 shi2 kong1
cues.en: it's just that the observer's spacetime

cues.zh: 角度不一样了
cues.pinyin: jiao3 du4 bu4 yi2 yang4 le5
cues.en: angle, or perspective, is different.

cues.zh: 如果我们总结一下
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 zong3 jie2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: To sum it up,

cues.zh: 牛顿时空观的问题究竟在哪里呢
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 shi2 kong1 guan1 de5 wen4 ti2 jiu1 jing4 zai4 na3 li3 ne5
cues.en: where exactly is the problem with Newton's view of space and time?

cues.zh: 它在于
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 yu2
cues.en: It lies in...

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 日本闷鸡大白菜食谱 Mie Okata【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 美食天堂做的第二道菜是闷鸡大白菜
cues.pinyin: mei3 shi2 tian1 tang2 zuo4 de5 di4 er4 dao4 cai4 shi4 men4 ji1 da4 bai2 cai4
cues.en: The second dish Meishi Tiantang made is braised chicken with Chinese cabbage.

cues.zh: 把白菜跟鸡肉加一点糖下去煮
cues.pinyin: ba3 bai2 cai4 gen1 ji1 rou4 jia1 yi4 dian3 tang2 xia4 qu4 zhu3
cues.en: Add the cabbage and chicken with a bit of sugar and cook.

cues.zh: 煮大约 50 分钟
cues.pinyin: zhu3 da4 yue1 50 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Cook for about 50 minutes.

cues.zh: 再加上几少的海带粉一点盐进去
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 shang4 ji3 shao3 de5 hai3 dai4 fen3 yi4 dian3 yan2 jin4 qu4
cues.en: Then add a little kelp powder and a bit of salt.

cues.zh: 起锅前加上一点黑胡椒
cues.pinyin: qi3 guo1 qian2 jia1 shang4 yi4 dian3 hei1 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: Before taking it off the heat, add a little black pepper.

cues.zh: 摆盘的时候再加入一些紫菜跟去籽的梅干
cues.pinyin: bai3 pan2 de5 shi2 hou4 zai4 jia1 ru4 yi1 xie1 zi3 cai4 gen1 qu4 zi3 de5 mei2 gan4
cues.en: When plating, add some seaweed and pitted dried plums.

cues.zh: 吃的时候可以把梅干融到汤内
cues.pinyin: chi1 de5 shi2 hou4 ke3 yi3 ba3 mei2 gan4 rong2 dao4 tang1 nei4
cues.en: When eating, you can let the dried plum dissolve into the soup.

cues.zh: 吃起来会有点甜甜咸咸酸酸的口感
cues.pinyin: chi1 qi3 lai2 hui4 you3 dian3 tian2 tian2 xian2 xian2 suan1 suan1 de5 kou3 gan3
cues.en: It tastes a bit sweet, salty, and sour.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 我们知道今天中国的股市又暴跌了一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 jin1 tian1 zhong1 guo2 de5 gu3 shi4 you4 bao4 die1 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: As we know, China's stock market crashed again today.

cues.zh: 这么多年以来无论国际形势如何变化
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 yi3 lai2 wu2 lun4 guo2 ji4 xing2 shi4 ru2 he2 bian4 hua4
cues.en: Over all these years, no matter how the international situation has changed,

cues.zh: 中国的股民总是不忘初心
cues.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 de5 gu3 min2 zong3 shi4 bu4 wang4 chu1 xin1
cues.en: Chinese retail investors always stay true to their original intention,

cues.zh: 被祖国提供的有动静
cues.pinyin: bei4 zu3 guo2 ti2 gong1 de5 you3 dong4 jing4
cues.en: staying unwavering even while trapped in losses.

cues.zh: 关于炒股赔钱这件事
cues.pinyin: guan1 yu2 chao3 gu3 pei2 qian2 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: When it comes to losing money in stocks,

cues.zh: 每个人都有不同的想法
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 you3 bu4 tong2 de5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: everyone has a different take on it.

cues.zh: 有的人想可能是我智商不够
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 ren2 xiang3 ke3 neng2 shi4 wo3 zhi4 shang1 bu4 gou4
cues.en: Some think maybe their IQ just isn't high enough.

cues.zh: 也有人想可能就是我运气不好
cues.pinyin: ye3 you3 ren2 xiang3 ke3 neng2 jiu4 shi4 wo3 yun4 qi4 bu4 hao3
cues.en: Others think maybe they just have bad luck,

cues.zh: 总是踩不上点
cues.pinyin: zong3 shi4 cai3 bu4 shang4 dian3
cues.en: always missing the right timing.

cues.zh: 但是大家会发现大部分股民都是赔钱的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 da4 jia1 hui4 fa1 xian4 da4 bu4 fen4 gu3 min2 dou1 shi4 pei2 qian2 de5
cues.en: But you'll notice most retail investors end up losing money.

cues.zh: 那么这里有没有什么深刻的数学内涵呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 li3 you3 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 shen1 ke4 de5 shu4 xue2 nei4 han2 ne5
cues.en: So is there some deep mathematical reason behind this?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来给大家举一个例子
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1 ju3 yi2 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Today let's look at an example.

cues.zh: 这个例子称之为美女与男人的游戏
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li4 zi5 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 mei3 nv3 yu3 nan2 ren2 de5 you2 xi4
cues.en: This example is called the game between a beautiful woman and a man—

cues.zh: 游戏
cues.pinyin: you2 xi4
cues.en: the game.

cues.zh: 最后一个男人他都在酒吧里独自喝酒
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi2 ge4 nan2 ren2 ta1 dou1 zai4 jiu3 ba1 li3 du2 zi4 he1 jiu3
cues.en: Say, a man is drinking alone at a bar.

cues.zh: 这个时候走过来一个美女
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 zou3 guo4 lai2 yi2 ge4 mei3 nv3
cues.en: At this moment a beautiful woman walks up to him.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 这个美女跟他说咱们玩一个游戏
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 mei3 nv3 gen1 ta1 shuo1 zan2 men5 wan2 yi2 ge4 you2 xi4
cues.en: She says, let's play a game.

cues.zh: 男人说怎么玩
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 shuo1 zen3 me5 wan2
cues.en: The man asks, how do we play?

cues.zh: 美女说这样
cues.pinyin: mei3 nv3 shuo1 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: She says, like this:

cues.zh: 咱们每个人拿一个硬币
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 mei3 ge4 ren2 na2 yi2 ge4 ying4 bi4
cues.en: Each of us takes a coin.

cues.zh: 咱们两个人把硬币出一面
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 liang3 ge4 ren2 ba3 ying4 bi4 chu1 yi2 mian4
cues.en: The two of us each show one side of our coin.

cues.zh: 你出一面我出一面
cues.pinyin: ni3 chu1 yi2 mian4 wo3 chu1 yi2 mian4
cues.en: You show one side, I show one side.

cues.zh: 咱们看一看
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 kan4 yi1 kan4
cues.en: Let's see what happens.

cues.zh: 如果这两个硬币都是正面的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhe4 liang3 ge4 ying4 bi4 dou1 shi4 zheng4 mian4 de5
cues.en: If both coins come up heads,

cues.zh: 那我就给你三块钱
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 gei3 ni3 san1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: then I'll give you three dollars.

cues.zh: 男人的收益就三块钱
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 de5 shou1 yi4 jiu4 san1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: The man's payoff is three dollars.

cues.zh: 如果都是反面的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 dou1 shi4 fan3 mian4 de5
cues.en: If both are tails,

cues.zh: 那我就给你一块钱
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 gei3 ni3 yi1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: then I'll give you one dollar.

cues.zh: 男人收益就一块钱
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 shou1 yi4 jiu4 yi1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: The man's payoff is one dollar.

cues.zh: 但是如果咱们两个硬币一正一反
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 zan2 men5 liang3 ge4 ying4 bi4 yi1 zheng4 yi1 fan3
cues.en: But if our two coins are one heads and one tails,

cues.zh: 你随便出
cues.pinyin: ni3 sui2 bian4 chu1
cues.en: you can show whichever you like—

cues.zh: 你出正也可以反也可以
cues.pinyin: ni3 chu1 zheng4 ye3 ke3 yi3 fan3 ye3 ke3 yi3
cues.en: heads or tails, either is fine.

cues.zh: 我也是
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 shi4
cues.en: Same for me.

cues.zh: 咱们两个如果一正一反的话
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 liang3 ge4 ru2 guo3 yi1 zheng4 yi1 fan3 de5 hua4
cues.en: If between the two of us it's one heads and one tails,

cues.zh: 那你就给我两块钱
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 jiu4 gei3 wo3 liang3 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: then you give me two dollars.

cues.zh: 所以就输了两块
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 shu1 le5 liang3 kuai4
cues.en: So he loses two dollars.

cues.zh: 这样男人的收益就是这样的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 nan2 ren2 de5 shou1 yi4 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: So that's how the man's payoff works.

cues.zh: 于是美女哥你玩不玩
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 mei3 nv3 ge1 ni3 wan2 bu4 wan2
cues.en: So the woman asks, 'Hey, are you in?'

cues.zh: 男人说他肯定玩
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 shuo1 ta1 ken3 ding4 wan2
cues.en: The man says of course he'll play.

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 首先因为你是个美女对吧
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 yin1 wei4 ni3 shi4 ge4 mei3 nv3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: First of all, because you're a beautiful woman, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 这个男人她也是可以出正面也
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2 ta1 ye3 shi4 ke3 yi3 chu1 zheng4 mian4 ye3
cues.en: The man can also choose to show heads

cues.zh: 可以出反面的
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 chu1 fan3 mian4 de5
cues.en: or tails.

cues.zh: 如果他们两个都出正面的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ta1 men5 liang3 ge4 dou1 chu1 zheng4 mian4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If they both show heads,

cues.zh: 男人的收益就是三
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 de5 shou1 yi4 jiu4 shi4 san1
cues.en: the man's payoff is three.

cues.zh: 都出反面的话男人收益就是一
cues.pinyin: dou1 chu1 fan3 mian4 de5 hua4 nan2 ren2 shou1 yi4 jiu4 shi4 yi1
cues.en: If both show tails, the man's payoff is one.

cues.zh: 如果一正义反男人收益是负二
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi1 zheng4 yi4 fan3 nan2 ren2 shou1 yi4 shi4 fu4 er4
cues.en: If it's one heads and one tails, the man's payoff is negative two.

cues.zh: 是吧这样一件事
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5 zhe4 yang4 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: Right, that's the setup.

cues.zh: 于是男人就可以采用一定的策略
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 nan2 ren2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 cai3 yong4 yi2 ding4 de5 ce4 lve4
cues.en: So the man can adopt a certain strategy,

cues.zh: 比如说我多少次出正面
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 duo1 shao3 ci4 chu1 zheng4 mian4
cues.en: say, playing heads a certain number of times,

cues.zh: 多少次出反面
cues.pinyin: duo1 shao3 ci4 chu1 fan3 mian4
cues.en: and tails a certain number of times.

cues.zh: 女人也是一样
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 ye3 shi4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Same for the woman.

cues.zh: 我也要采取一个策略
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 yao4 cai3 qu3 yi2 ge4 ce4 lve4
cues.en: She also needs a strategy.

cues.zh: 比如说女人一直出正面
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 nv3 ren2 yi4 zhi2 chu1 zheng4 mian4
cues.en: For instance, if the woman always plays heads,

cues.zh: 那肯定输得很惨
cues.pinyin: na4 ken3 ding4 shu1 de2 hen3 can3
cues.en: she'll definitely lose badly.

cues.zh: 女人一直出反面也不行
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 yi4 zhi2 chu1 fan3 mian4 ye3 bu4 xing2
cues.en: Always playing tails doesn't work either,

cues.zh: 这样男人过到规律的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 nan2 ren2 guo4 dao4 gui1 lv4 de5
cues.en: because the man would catch on to the pattern,

cues.zh: 他也会一直出反面
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 hui4 yi4 zhi2 chu1 fan3 mian4
cues.en: and he'd also always play tails,

cues.zh: 所以他还是赢钱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 hai2 shi4 ying2 qian2
cues.en: so he'd still come out ahead.

cues.zh: 这个时候他们两个都要一定的概率
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ta1 men5 liang3 ge4 dou1 yao4 yi2 ding4 de5 gai4 lv4
cues.en: So both of them need to play with certain probabilities,

cues.zh: 去出正面或反面
cues.pinyin: qu4 chu1 zheng4 mian4 huo4 fan3 mian4
cues.en: choosing heads or tails.

cues.zh: 咱们假设
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 jia3 she4
cues.en: Let's assume—

cues.zh: 咱们假设这个男人
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 jia3 she4 zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: let's assume the man

cues.zh: 他出正面的概率是 x
cues.pinyin: ta1 chu1 zheng4 mian4 de5 gai4 lv4 shi4 x
cues.en: plays heads with probability x.

cues.zh: 正面的概率是 x
cues.pinyin: zheng4 mian4 de5 gai4 lv4 shi4 x
cues.en: The probability of heads is x.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 男人赚 1 块钱
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 zhuan4 1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: The man earns one dollar

cues.zh: 他的概率是 1 X
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 gai4 lv4 shi4 1 X
cues.en: with probability (1-x).

cues.zh: 女人的概率是 1 Y
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 de5 gai4 lv4 shi4 1 Y
cues.en: The woman's probability is (1-y).

cues.zh: 这就两个都是反面的时候赚的钱
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 liang3 ge4 dou1 shi4 fan3 mian4 de5 shi2 hou4 zhuan4 de5 qian2
cues.en: That's the money earned when both show tails.

cues.zh: 但是你不要忘了还有一正义法的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 bu2 yao4 wang4 le5 hai2 you3 yi1 zheng4 yi4 fa3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But don't forget there's also the one-heads-one-tails case.

cues.zh: 一正义法的时候就是减去 2
cues.pinyin: yi1 zheng4 yi4 fa3 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 shi4 jian3 qu4 2
cues.en: In that case, it's minus two.

cues.zh: 减去 2 再乘以相应概率
cues.pinyin: jian3 qu4 2 zai4 cheng2 yi3 xiang1 ying4 gai4 lv4
cues.en: Minus two, multiplied by the corresponding probability.

cues.zh: 男人是正面女人是反面这是一种情况
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 shi4 zheng4 mian4 nv3 ren2 shi4 fan3 mian4 zhe4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Man heads, woman tails — that's one case.

cues.zh: 还有一种情况是女人是正面男人是反面
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 shi4 nv3 ren2 shi4 zheng4 mian4 nan2 ren2 shi4 fan3 mian4
cues.en: The other case is woman heads, man tails.

cues.zh: 好这个就是你玩一把之后的数学期望
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 ni3 wan2 yi1 ba3 zhi1 hou4 de5 shu4 xue2 qi1 wang4
cues.en: Okay, this is the mathematical expectation after one round.

cues.zh: 那么这个值是多少呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 zhi2 shi4 duo1 shao3 ne5
cues.en: So what is this value?

cues.zh: 我们把它展开就可以了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 ta1 zhan3 kai1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: We just need to expand it.

cues.zh: 展开之后的结果是 8 xy 3 x 3 y 再加 1
cues.pinyin: zhan3 kai1 zhi1 hou4 de5 jie2 guo3 shi4 8 xy 3 x 3 y zai4 jia1 1
cues.en: After expanding, the result is 8xy - 3x - 3y + 1.

cues.zh: 这是它的数学期望
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ta1 de5 shu4 xue2 qi1 wang4
cues.en: That's its mathematical expectation.

cues.zh: 而且这里面的 X 和 Y
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe4 li3 mian4 de5 X he2 Y
cues.en: And here, x and y
