items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 它都是在 0 和 1 之间的一个数
cues.pinyin: ta1 dou1 shi4 zai4 0 he2 1 zhi1 jian1 de5 yi2 ge4 shu4
cues.en: are both numbers between 0 and 1,

cues.zh: 对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 0 和 1 之间的一个数
cues.pinyin: 0 he2 1 zhi1 jian1 de5 yi2 ge4 shu4
cues.en: A number between 0 and 1,

cues.zh: 因为它是一个概率
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 gai4 lv4
cues.en: because it's a probability.

cues.zh: 好现在我们来看一看策略
cues.pinyin: hao3 xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 lai2 kan4 yi1 kan4 ce4 lve4
cues.en: Okay, now let's look at the strategies.

cues.zh: 男人是希望自己的希望借量大
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 shi4 xi1 wang4 zi4 ji3 de5 xi1 wang4 jie4 liang4 da4
cues.en: The man wants his expected value to be large,

cues.zh: 至少是正的不要赔钱
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 shi4 zheng4 de5 bu2 yao4 pei2 qian2
cues.en: at least positive, so he doesn't lose money.

cues.zh: 而女人就希望你一直赔钱
cues.pinyin: er2 nv3 ren2 jiu4 xi1 wang4 ni3 yi4 zhi2 pei2 qian2
cues.en: The woman wants him to keep losing money,

cues.zh: 这样我才能赚钱
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 wo3 cai2 neng2 zhuan4 qian2
cues.en: so that she can make money.

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 她希望你一直赔钱
cues.pinyin: ta1 xi1 wang4 ni3 yi4 zhi2 pei2 qian2
cues.en: She wants him to always be losing.

cues.zh: 他们唯一的做法是调整概率
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 wei2 yi1 de5 zuo4 fa3 shi4 tiao2 zheng3 gai4 lv4
cues.en: The only thing they can do is adjust the probabilities,

cues.zh: 就是 X 和 Y
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 X he2 Y
cues.en: that is, x and y.

cues.zh: 女人就在想
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 jiu4 zai4 xiang3
cues.en: So the woman thinks,

cues.zh: 有没有那么一种可能
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 na4 me5 yi1 zhong3 ke3 neng2
cues.en: is there a possibility

cues.zh: 当我一某一个 Y 出牌的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 wo3 yi1 mou3 yi2 ge4 Y chu1 pai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: that once I pick a certain value of y to play,

cues.zh: 男人无论他的概率是多大
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 wu2 lun4 ta1 de5 gai4 lv4 shi4 duo1 da4
cues.en: no matter what probability the man chooses,

cues.zh: 他的期望都是负的
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 qi1 wang4 dou1 shi4 fu4 de5
cues.en: his expectation is always negative?

cues.zh: 如果他的期望一直都是负的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ta1 de5 qi1 wang4 yi4 zhi2 dou1 shi4 fu4 de5
cues.en: If his expectation is always negative,

cues.zh: 那就说明什么
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shuo1 ming2 shen2 me5
cues.en: what does that mean?

cues.zh: 那就说明你一直是在输钱
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shuo1 ming2 ni3 yi4 zhi2 shi4 zai4 shu1 qian2
cues.en: It means he's always losing money.

cues.zh: 那我们干脆就令这个数一小于零
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 gan1 cui4 jiu4 ling4 zhe4 ge5 shu4 yi1 xiao3 yu2 ling2
cues.en: So let's just set this expression to be less than zero.

cues.zh: 为了让一小于零
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 rang4 yi1 xiao3 yu2 ling2
cues.en: To make this expression less than zero,

cues.zh: 因为女人要研究自己的策略
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 nv3 ren2 yao4 yan2 jiu1 zi4 ji3 de5 ce4 lve4
cues.en: since the woman needs to work out her own strategy,

cues.zh: 所以我们把这个 y 提出来
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 y ti2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: we factor out y.

cues.zh: 它要小于 3x 减 1
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 xiao3 yu2 3x jian3 1
cues.en: This is the woman's strategy.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 它要小于 3 x 1
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 xiao3 yu2 3 x 1
cues.en: It needs to be less than 3x - 1.

cues.zh: 我们在初中学习不等式的时候知道
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 chu1 zhong1 xue2 xi2 bu4 deng3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: We learned in middle school when studying inequalities,

cues.zh: 不等式的这一根要除过去
cues.pinyin: bu4 deng3 shi4 de5 zhe4 yi1 gen1 yao4 chu2 guo4 qu4
cues.en: that when you divide this term over to the other side,

cues.zh: 必须要考虑是正的还是负的问题
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 yao4 kao3 lv4 shi4 zheng4 de5 hai2 shi4 fu4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: you must consider whether it's positive or negative.

cues.zh: 也就是 x 大于 8 分之 3
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 x da4 yu2 8 fen1 zhi1 3
cues.en: If 8x - 3 is greater than 0,

cues.zh: 也就是 x 大于 3 8 分之 3
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 x da4 yu2 3 8 fen1 zhi1 3
cues.en: that is, x > 3/8,

cues.zh: 在这种情况下这个数是正的
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 xia4 zhe4 ge5 shu4 shi4 zheng4 de5
cues.en: in this case this number is positive,

cues.zh: 我们摸过去不变号
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 mo1 guo4 qu4 bu4 bian4 hao4
cues.en: and dividing it over doesn't flip the inequality sign.

cues.zh: y 就要小于 3 x 1 除以 8 x 3
cues.pinyin: y jiu4 yao4 xiao3 yu2 3 x 1 chu2 yi3 8 x 3
cues.en: y must be less than (3x - 1)/(8x - 3).

cues.zh: 也就是说女人的这个 y
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 nv3 ren2 de5 zhe4 ge5 y
cues.en: In other words, the woman's y

cues.zh: 她只要能够小于这个数
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 yao4 neng2 gou4 xiao3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 shu4
cues.en: just needs to be less than this value,

cues.zh: 就可以保证男人的期望是负的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 bao3 zheng4 nan2 ren2 de5 qi1 wang4 shi4 fu4 de5
cues.en: and she can guarantee the man's expectation is negative.

cues.zh: 那么这个函数是一个什么函数呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 shen2 me5 han2 shu4 ne5
cues.en: So what kind of function is this?

cues.zh: 如果我画出图像就知道了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 hua4 chu1 tu2 xiang4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: If I plot its graph, we'll see.

cues.zh: 它是一个减函数
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 jian3 han2 shu4
cues.en: It's a decreasing function.

cues.zh: 所谓减函数的意思就是 x 越大这个值越小
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 jian3 han2 shu4 de5 yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 x yue4 da4 zhe4 ge5 zhi2 yue4 xiao3
cues.en: A decreasing function means the larger x is, the smaller this value becomes.

cues.zh: 那我要是让 y 一直小于这个函数的话
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 yao4 shi4 rang4 y yi4 zhi2 xiao3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: So if I want y to always be less than this function,

cues.zh: 就要小于这个函数的最小值
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 xiao3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 de5 zui4 xiao3 zhi2
cues.en: it needs to be less than the minimum value of this function.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 1000万人参与这支纪录片，在路上找答案

cues.zh: 你敢去抛弃一些东西去做你想做的事吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 gan3 qu4 pao1 qi4 yi1 xie1 dong1 xi1 qu4 zuo4 ni3 xiang3 zuo4 de5 shi4 ma5
cues.en: Do you dare give up certain things to do what you really want to do?

cues.zh: 没有想过放弃不想被别人看别人
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 xiang3 guo4 fang4 qi4 bu4 xiang3 bei4 bie2 ren2 kan4 bie2 ren2
cues.en: I never thought about giving up — I didn't want to be looked down on by others.

cues.zh: 我用这种方式也可以成为我的方向
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong4 zhe4 zhong3 fang1 shi4 ye3 ke3 yi3 cheng2 wei2 wo3 de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: This way, I can also become my own direction.

cues.zh: 就是需要很大的勇气
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xu1 yao4 hen3 da4 de5 yong3 qi4
cues.en: It just takes a lot of courage.

cues.zh: 走出来了以后懂得了应该怎么
cues.pinyin: zou3 chu1 lai2 le5 yi3 hou4 dong3 de5 le5 ying1 gai1 zen3 me5
cues.en: After I came out of it, I understood how

cues.zh: 样去热爱生活
cues.pinyin: yang4 qu4 re4 ai4 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: to love life.

cues.zh: 热爱一定有在家
cues.pinyin: re4 ai4 yi2 ding4 you3 zai4 jia1
cues.en: Loving life definitely isn't just about staying home.

cues.zh: 对别人可能一文不值
cues.pinyin: dui4 bie2 ren2 ke3 neng2 yi1 wen2 bu4 zhi2
cues.en: To others it might be worthless,

cues.zh: 但是对你来说这就是全部
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dui4 ni3 lai2 shuo1 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 quan2 bu4
cues.en: but to you, this is everything.

cues.zh: 感觉干聊天呆你真的还在继续干
cues.pinyin: gan3 jue2 gan4 liao2 tian1 dai1 ni3 zhen1 de5 hai2 zai4 ji4 xu4 gan4
cues.en: It feels like after doing this for so many years, are you really still going to keep doing it?

cues.zh: 永远永远热泪一样
cues.pinyin: yong3 yuan3 yong3 yuan3 re4 lei4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Forever and ever, loving it just the same.

cues.zh: 你无法不得去做
cues.pinyin: ni3 wu2 fa3 bu4 de2 qu4 zuo4
cues.en: You can't help but do it.

cues.zh: 方向在路上
cues.pinyin: fang1 xiang4 zai4 lu4 shang4
cues.en: The direction is out there on the road.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 你能想象吗一个连阎王爷见了都得躲着
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 xiang3 xiang4 ma5 yi2 ge4 lian2 yan2 wang2 ye2 jian4 le5 dou1 de2 duo3 zhe5
cues.en: Can you imagine — a top hitman so feared

cues.zh: 走的顶级杀手
cues.pinyin: zou3 de5 ding3 ji2 sha1 shou3
cues.en: that even the God of Death would avoid him

cues.zh: 就因为老婆一句话
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yin1 wei4 lao3 po2 yi1 ju4 hua4
cues.en: just because of one thing his wife said

cues.zh: 居然乖乖去给一个 17 岁的小姑
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 guai1 guai1 qu4 gei3 yi2 ge4 17 sui4 de5 xiao3 gu1
cues.en: he obediently agreed to be a bodyguard for a 17-year-old girl

cues.zh: 娘当起了保镖
cues.pinyin: niang2 dang1 qi3 le5 bao3 biao1
cues.en: and took on the job of protecting her

cues.zh: 他谁也没想到这场看起来挺简单的活儿
cues.pinyin: ta1 shui2 ye3 mei2 xiang3 dao4 zhe4 chang3 kan4 qi3 lai2 ting3 jian3 dan1 de5 huo2 er5
cues.en: He never expected that this seemingly simple job

cues.zh: 竟然牵扯出了一桩非法交易的黑幕
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 qian1 che3 chu1 le5 yi1 zhuang1 fei1 fa3 jiao1 yi4 de5 hei1 mu4
cues.en: would actually expose a dark illegal trafficking scheme

cues.zh: 把他又重新拉回了那种刀光剑影的江湖里
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 you4 chong2 xin1 la1 hui2 le5 na4 zhong3 dao1 guang1 jian4 ying3 de5 jiang1 hu2 li3
cues.en: dragging him right back into that world of blades and bloodshed

cues.zh: 今天要说的就是这部韩国犯罪
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 yao4 shuo1 de5 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 bu4 han2 guo2 fan4 zui4
cues.en: Today we're talking about this Korean crime

cues.zh: 爽片悲传杀手
cues.pinyin: shuang3 pian4 bei1 chuan2 sha1 shou3
cues.en: action thriller, a hitman's tale

cues.zh: 深夜的大酒店里
cues.pinyin: shen1 ye4 de5 da4 jiu3 dian4 li3
cues.en: Late at night in a large hotel

cues.zh: 杀手阿江轻巧地躲过了迎面飞来的斧头
cues.pinyin: sha1 shou3 a1 jiang1 qing1 qiao3 di4 duo3 guo4 le5 ying2 mian4 fei1 lai2 de5 fu3 tou2
cues.en: hitman A Jiang nimbly dodges an axe flying straight at him

cues.zh: 紧接着就和一群大伴的花里胡哨的
cues.pinyin: jin3 jie1 zhe5 jiu4 he2 yi1 qun2 da4 ban4 de5 hua1 li3 hu2 shao4 de5
cues.en: and immediately starts fighting a flashily dressed group

cues.zh: 混混干了起来
cues.pinyin: hun4 hun4 gan4 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: of thugs

cues.zh: 对面的混混不仅没伤着阿江
cues.pinyin: dui4 mian4 de5 hun4 hun4 bu4 jin3 mei2 shang1 zhe5 a1 jiang1
cues.en: The thugs not only fail to land a hit on A Jiang

cues.zh: 反倒被阿江一斧头给解决了
cues.pinyin: fan3 dao4 bei4 a1 jiang1 yi1 fu3 tou2 gei3 jie3 jue2 le5
cues.en: but instead get taken out by his own axe

cues.zh: 剩下的混混想跑
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 hun4 hun4 xiang3 pao3
cues.en: The remaining thug tries to run

cues.zh: 却被阿江一脚踩住
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 a1 jiang1 yi1 jiao3 cai3 zhu4
cues.en: but A Jiang pins him down with one foot

cues.zh: 动弹不得
cues.pinyin: dong4 tan2 bu4 de2
cues.en: unable to move

cues.zh: 这时电梯到了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 dian4 ti1 dao4 le5
cues.en: Just then the elevator arrives

cues.zh: 里面的混混看着满地狼藉
cues.pinyin: li3 mian4 de5 hun4 hun4 kan4 zhe5 man3 di4 lang2 ji2
cues.en: The thugs inside see the wreckage everywhere

cues.zh: 全都吓得缩成一团
cues.pinyin: quan2 dou1 xia4 de2 suo1 cheng2 yi1 tuan2
cues.en: and all cower in fear

cues.zh: 大气都不敢出
cues.pinyin: da4 qi4 dou1 bu4 gan3 chu1
cues.en: not daring to even breathe loudly

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 就在这时候阿江的电话响了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 hou4 a1 jiang1 de5 dian4 hua4 xiang3 le5
cues.en: Right then, A Jiang's phone rings

cues.zh: 是老婆发来的短信
cues.pinyin: shi4 lao3 po2 fa1 lai2 de5 duan3 xin4
cues.en: It's a text from his wife

cues.zh: 问他照看的孩子有没有事
cues.pinyin: wen4 ta1 zhao4 kan4 de5 hai2 zi5 you3 mei2 you3 shi4
cues.en: asking if the kid he's watching is okay

cues.zh: 看到短信
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 duan3 xin4
cues.en: Seeing the message

cues.zh: 阿江脸上满是无奈
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 lian3 shang4 man3 shi4 wu2 nai4
cues.en: A Jiang's face fills with exasperation

cues.zh: 原来不久前
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 bu4 jiu3 qian2
cues.en: It turns out that not long ago

cues.zh: 阿江的老婆和他的好友白夫人去旅行
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 de5 lao3 po2 he2 ta1 de5 hao3 you3 bai2 fu1 ren2 qu4 lv3 xing2
cues.en: A Jiang's wife went traveling with her friend, Mrs. Bai

cues.zh: 临走前特意叮嘱阿江
cues.pinyin: lin2 zou3 qian2 te4 yi4 ding1 zhu3 a1 jiang1
cues.en: Before leaving, she specifically told A Jiang

cues.zh: 让他照看好白夫人 17 岁的女儿
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 zhao4 kan4 hao3 bai2 fu1 ren2 17 sui4 de5 nv3 er2
cues.en: to take good care of Mrs. Bai's 17-year-old daughter

cues.zh: 那小姑娘还在上高中
cues.pinyin: na4 xiao3 gu1 niang2 hai2 zai4 shang4 gao1 zhong1
cues.en: The girl is still in high school

cues.zh: 虽然阿江不喜欢看孩子
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 a1 jiang1 bu4 xi3 huan1 kan4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Although A Jiang hates babysitting

cues.zh: 可他是出了名的怕老婆
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 shi4 chu1 le5 ming2 de5 pa4 lao3 po2
cues.en: he's famously terrified of his wife

cues.zh: 把老婆送到机场后
cues.pinyin: ba3 lao3 po2 song4 dao4 ji1 chang3 hou4
cues.en: After dropping his wife off at the airport

cues.zh: 就去女孩辅导班楼下等着了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 qu4 nv3 hai2 fu3 dao3 ban1 lou2 xia4 deng3 zhe5 le5
cues.en: he went to wait outside the girl's cram school

cues.zh: 阿江在车里打盹
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zai4 che1 li3 da3 dun3
cues.en: A Jiang dozes off in the car

cues.zh: 突然有人敲车窗
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 you3 ren2 qiao1 che1 chuang1
cues.en: Suddenly someone knocks on the window

cues.zh: 阿江一看是个漂亮的女孩
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 yi1 kan4 shi4 ge4 piao4 liang4 de5 nv3 hai2
cues.en: He looks up to see a pretty girl

cues.zh: 见女孩喊出了他的名字
cues.pinyin: jian4 nv3 hai2 han3 chu1 le5 ta1 de5 ming2 zi4
cues.en: She calls out his name

cues.zh: 还说出了街头暗号
cues.pinyin: hai2 shuo1 chu1 le5 jie1 tou2 an4 hao4
cues.en: and even gives the street code phrase

cues.zh: 阿江摆了摆手让她上车
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 bai3 le5 bai3 shou3 rang4 ta1 shang4 che1
cues.en: A Jiang waves her into the car

cues.zh: 女孩自报家门说叫小芝
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 zi4 bao4 jia1 men2 shuo1 jiao4 xiao3 zhi1
cues.en: The girl introduces herself as Xiaozhi

cues.zh: 阿江没耐心听她多说
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 mei2 nai4 xin1 ting1 ta1 duo1 shuo1
cues.en: A Jiang has no patience to hear more

cues.zh: 正想打断
cues.pinyin: zheng4 xiang3 da3 duan4
cues.en: and is about to cut her off

cues.zh: 却发现小芝还带了个闺蜜上车
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 xiao3 zhi1 hai2 dai4 le5 ge4 gui1 mi4 shang4 che1
cues.en: when he notices Xiaozhi brought a friend along too

cues.zh: 没办法阿江只能先送她闺蜜回家
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3 a1 jiang1 zhi3 neng2 xian1 song4 ta1 gui1 mi4 hui2 jia1
cues.en: With no choice, A Jiang drives the friend home first

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 有事打电话
cues.pinyin: you3 shi4 da3 dian4 hua4
cues.en: telling them to call if anything comes up

cues.zh: 刚想立让眼接着睡
cues.pinyin: gang1 xiang3 li4 rang4 yan3 jie1 zhe5 shui4
cues.en: He's about to go right back to sleep

cues.zh: 又想起老婆临走时的叮嘱
cues.pinyin: you4 xiang3 qi3 lao3 po2 lin2 zou3 shi2 de5 ding1 zhu3
cues.en: when he remembers his wife's instructions

cues.zh: 他穿好衣服
cues.pinyin: ta1 chuan1 hao3 yi1 fu2
cues.en: He gets dressed

cues.zh: 开车到了小芝说的地方
cues.pinyin: kai1 che1 dao4 le5 xiao3 zhi1 shuo1 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: and drives to the place Xiaozhi mentioned

cues.zh: 发现是间餐厅
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 shi4 jian1 can1 ting1
cues.en: only to find it's a restaurant

cues.zh: 而腰壳肚子疼的小芝
cues.pinyin: er2 yao1 ke2 du3 zi5 teng2 de5 xiao3 zhi1
cues.en: and Xiaozhi, who'd claimed to have a stomachache

cues.zh: 竟然在和一个男生约会
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 zai4 he2 yi2 ge4 nan2 sheng1 yue1 hui4
cues.en: is actually on a date with a boy

cues.zh: 见状阿姜的火气不打一出来
cues.pinyin: jian4 zhuang4 a1 jiang1 de5 huo3 qi4 bu4 da3 yi1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Seeing this, A Jiang's temper flares instantly

cues.zh: 更过分的是
cues.pinyin: geng4 guo4 fen4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Even more outrageous

cues.zh: 小芝还让他将送男生回家
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhi1 hai2 rang4 ta1 jiang1 song4 nan2 sheng1 hui2 jia1
cues.en: Xiaozhi asks him to drive the boy home too

cues.zh: 还好男孩察觉到了阿姜身上的怨气
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 nan2 hai2 cha2 jue2 dao4 le5 a1 jiang1 shen1 shang4 de5 yuan4 qi4
cues.en: Luckily the boy senses A Jiang's hostility

cues.zh: 忙说自己大车走
cues.pinyin: mang2 shuo1 zi4 ji3 da4 che1 zou3
cues.en: and quickly says he'll just grab a taxi

cues.zh: 阿江问小芝怎么回事
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 wen4 xiao3 zhi1 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: then slinks away

cues.zh: 阿姜问小芝怎么回事
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 wen4 xiao3 zhi1 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: A Jiang asks Xiaozhi what's going on

cues.zh: 小芝不说话
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhi1 bu4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: Xiaozhi says nothing

cues.zh: 低着头自不玩着手机
cues.pinyin: di1 zhe5 tou2 zi4 bu4 wan2 zhuo2 shou3 ji1
cues.en: just keeps her head down, playing on her phone

cues.zh: 随后对阿姜说用不到他的
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 dui4 a1 jiang1 shuo1 yong4 bu2 dao4 ta1 de5
cues.en: then tells A Jiang she doesn't need him

cues.zh: 阿姜都气笑了
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 dou1 qi4 xiao4 le5
cues.en: A Jiang almost laughs out of anger

cues.zh: 大半夜叫他过来
cues.pinyin: da4 ban4 ye4 jiao4 ta1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Calling him over in the middle of the night

cues.zh: 转头又赶人
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 tou2 you4 gan3 ren2
cues.en: then immediately trying to get rid of him

cues.zh: 顶级杀手就不要面子吗
cues.pinyin: ding3 ji2 sha1 shou3 jiu4 bu2 yao4 mian4 zi5 ma5
cues.en: Does a top hitman have no pride at all?

cues.zh: 再三确认小芝不需要帮助后
cues.pinyin: zai4 san1 que4 ren4 xiao3 zhi1 bu4 xu1 yao4 bang1 zhu4 hou4
cues.en: After repeatedly confirming Xiaozhi doesn't need help

cues.zh: 他牛头就走
cues.pinyin: ta1 niu2 tou2 jiu4 zou3
cues.en: he turns and leaves

cues.zh: 从后视镜里看到小芝上了一辆摩托车
cues.pinyin: cong2 hou4 shi4 jing4 li3 kan4 dao4 xiao3 zhi1 shang4 le5 yi1 liang4 mo2 tuo1 che1
cues.en: In the rearview mirror he sees Xiaozhi get on a motorcycle

cues.zh: 跟着一群看着不三不色的人走了
cues.pinyin: gen1 zhe5 yi1 qun2 kan4 zhe5 bu4 san1 bu4 se4 de5 ren2 zou3 le5
cues.en: and ride off with a shady-looking group

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 第二天一早
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 yi1 zao3
cues.en: Early the next morning

cues.zh: 阿江便被小智缠着聊天
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 bian4 bei4 xiao3 zhi4 chan2 zhe5 liao2 tian1
cues.en: Xiaozhi keeps pestering A Jiang to chat

cues.zh: 无奈之下出去玩了一天
cues.pinyin: wu2 nai4 zhi1 xia4 chu1 qu4 wan2 le5 yi1 tian1
cues.en: Left with no choice, he spends the whole day out with her

cues.zh: 晚上回家途中
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 hui2 jia1 tu2 zhong1
cues.en: On the way home that evening

cues.zh: 经过花冰场才知道出了人命
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 hua1 bing1 chang3 cai2 zhi1 dao4 chu1 le5 ren2 ming4
cues.en: passing by a skating rink, he learns someone has died

cues.zh: 面对刑警老李的询问
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 xing2 jing3 lao3 li3 de5 xun2 wen4
cues.en: Facing questioning from detective Old Li

cues.zh: 小芝神色略显慌张
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhi1 shen2 se4 lve4 xian3 huang1 zhang1
cues.en: Xiaozhi looks noticeably nervous

cues.zh: 然而第二天早晨
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 di4 er4 tian1 zao3 chen2
cues.en: But the next morning

cues.zh: 老李便来到阿姜家中
cues.pinyin: lao3 li3 bian4 lai2 dao4 a1 jiang1 jia1 zhong1
cues.en: Old Li shows up at A Jiang's home

cues.zh: 便拿出手机播放了一段视频
cues.pinyin: bian4 na2 chu1 shou3 ji1 bo1 fang4 le5 yi1 duan4 shi4 pin2
cues.en: and pulls out his phone to play a video

cues.zh: 老李质疑命案与阿姜有关
cues.pinyin: lao3 li3 zhi4 yi2 ming4 an4 yu3 a1 jiang1 you3 guan1
cues.en: Old Li suspects A Jiang is connected to the murder

cues.zh: 而一番交谈下来
cues.pinyin: er2 yi1 fan1 jiao1 tan2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: But after questioning him

cues.zh: 并没有得到任何线索
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 de2 dao4 ren4 he2 xian4 suo3
cues.en: he gets no useful leads at all

cues.zh: 还被阿姜奚落一顿
cues.pinyin: hai2 bei4 a1 jiang1 xi1 luo4 yi1 dun4
cues.en: and even gets mocked by A Jiang

cues.zh: 只得兴兴离开
cues.pinyin: zhi3 de2 xing1 xing1 li2 kai1
cues.en: leaving in frustration

cues.zh: 庞间内
cues.pinyin: pang2 jian1 nei4
cues.en: Back in the room

cues.zh: 阿姜正想安抚一下受伤的小芝
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zheng4 xiang3 an1 fu3 yi1 xia4 shou4 shang1 de5 xiao3 zhi1
cues.en: A Jiang is about to comfort the hurt Xiaozhi

cues.zh: 一通电话的到来
cues.pinyin: yi2 tong4 dian4 hua4 de5 dao4 lai2
cues.en: when a phone call comes in

cues.zh: 将整个事件推向了高潮
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zheng3 ge4 shi4 jian4 tui1 xiang4 le5 gao1 chao2
cues.en: pushing the whole situation to a climax

cues.zh: 电话那头是之前的小太妹
cues.pinyin: dian4 hua4 na4 tou2 shi4 zhi1 qian2 de5 xiao3 tai4 mei4
cues.en: On the line is the delinquent girl from before

cues.zh: 原来她在阿姜走后
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 zai4 a1 jiang1 zou3 hou4
cues.en: It turns out that after A Jiang left

cues.zh: 用带有阿姜指纹的匕首
cues.pinyin: yong4 dai4 you3 a1 jiang1 zhi3 wen2 de5 bi3 shou3
cues.en: she used a dagger with A Jiang's fingerprints on it

cues.zh: 将几个男生杀害
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ji3 ge4 nan2 sheng1 sha1 hai4
cues.en: to kill several boys

cues.zh: 此刻他正用这事威胁阿将取他指定的地址
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 ta1 zheng4 yong4 zhe4 shi4 wei1 xie2 a1 jiang1 qu3 ta1 zhi3 ding4 de5 di4 zhi3
cues.en: and now she's using it to blackmail A Jiang into coming to a place she names

cues.zh: 临走前弟弟小致一个定位手环
cues.pinyin: lin2 zou3 qian2 di4 di5 xiao3 zhi4 yi2 ge4 ding4 wei4 shou3 huan2
cues.en: Before leaving she'd given Xiaozhi a tracking bracelet

cues.zh: 随后来到指定地边
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 lai2 dao4 zhi3 ding4 di4 bian1
cues.en: A Jiang then heads to the designated location

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 眼见阿将手段如此残忍
cues.pinyin: yan3 jian4 a1 jiang1 shou3 duan4 ru2 ci3 can2 ren3
cues.en: Seeing how ruthless A Jiang is

cues.zh: 吓破胆的大哥急忙将匕首扔下阿将
cues.pinyin: xia4 po4 dan3 de5 da4 ge1 ji2 mang2 jiang1 bi3 shou3 reng1 xia4 a1 jiang1
cues.en: the terrified gang leader hastily drops the dagger in front of him

cues.zh: 随后却又掏枪指向阿将
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 que4 you4 tao1 qiang1 zhi3 xiang4 a1 jiang1
cues.en: then pulls out a gun and points it at A Jiang instead

cues.zh: 只是觉得真理在熟
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 jue2 de5 zhen1 li3 zai4 shu2
cues.en: clearly thinking he has the upper hand

cues.zh: 天下窝友的男人低估了阿江的实力
cues.pinyin: tian1 xia4 wo1 you3 de5 nan2 ren2 di1 gu1 le5 a1 jiang1 de5 shi2 li4
cues.en: little does he know he's underestimated A Jiang's skill

cues.zh: 只能在慌乱中从后门逃跑了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 zai4 huang1 luan4 zhong1 cong2 hou4 men2 tao2 pao3 le5
cues.en: and ends up fleeing out the back door in a panic

cues.zh: 阿江追着男人走进一条长廊
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zhui1 zhe5 nan2 ren2 zou3 jin4 yi1 tiao2 chang2 lang2
cues.en: A Jiang chases him into a corridor

cues.zh: 停着职业的警觉性
cues.pinyin: ting2 zhe5 zhi2 ye4 de5 jing3 jue2 xing4
cues.en: Relying on his professional instincts

cues.zh: 随即与这个突然出现的黄毛
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 yu3 zhe4 ge5 tu1 ran2 chu1 xian4 de5 huang2 mao2
cues.en: he dodges several steel nails fired from the shadows

cues.zh: 随即与这个突然出现的荒毛
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 yu3 zhe4 ge5 tu1 ran2 chu1 xian4 de5 huang1 mao2
cues.en: then immediately clashes with this suddenly appearing yellow-haired thug

cues.zh: 交起手来
cues.pinyin: jiao1 qi3 shou3 lai2
cues.en: trading blows

cues.zh: 阿江找了个机会推出战斗折回家中
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zhao3 le5 ge4 ji1 hui4 tui1 chu1 zhan4 dou4 zhe2 hui2 jia1 zhong1
cues.en: A Jiang finds a chance to break off the fight and head back home

cues.zh: 望着家中凌乱的脚印与血迹
cues.pinyin: wang4 zhe5 jia1 zhong1 ling2 luan4 de5 jiao3 yin4 yu3 xue4 ji4
cues.en: Looking at the messy footprints and bloodstains in the house

cues.zh: 猜测小只应该被人趁机绑架了
cues.pinyin: cai1 ce4 xiao3 zhi3 ying1 gai1 bei4 ren2 chen4 ji1 bang3 jia4 le5
cues.en: he guesses Xiaozhi must have been kidnapped in the chaos

cues.zh: 追着手环的位置
cues.pinyin: zhui1 zhuo2 shou3 huan2 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: Tracking the bracelet's location

cues.zh: 阿江来到一片破旧的居民楼下
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 lai2 dao4 yi1 pian4 po4 jiu4 de5 ju1 min2 lou2 xia4
cues.en: A Jiang arrives at a run-down residential building

cues.zh: 闯门进去发现被欺负的并不是小只
cues.pinyin: chuang3 men2 jin4 qu4 fa1 xian4 bei4 qi1 fu4 de5 bing4 bu2 shi4 xiao3 zhi3
cues.en: He breaks in and finds that the one being hurt isn't Xiaozhi

cues.zh: 而小太妹发现阿江的到来
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 tai4 mei4 fa1 xian4 a1 jiang1 de5 dao4 lai2
cues.en: but the friend she'd brought along earlier

cues.zh: 而小太妹发现阿姜的到来
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 tai4 mei4 fa1 xian4 a1 jiang1 de5 dao4 lai2
cues.en: When the delinquent girl notices A Jiang has arrived

cues.zh: 慌不择路的逃产中
cues.pinyin: huang1 bu4 ze2 lu4 de5 tao2 chan3 zhong1
cues.en: she flees in a blind panic

cues.zh: 随即嘲笑阿江中计了
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 chao2 xiao4 a1 jiang1 zhong4 ji4 le5
cues.en: but A Jiang pins her to the ground

cues.zh: 随即嘲笑阿姜中计了
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 chao2 xiao4 a1 jiang1 zhong4 ji4 le5
cues.en: She mocks him, saying he's fallen for her trap

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 得到地址的阿姜立即前往女孩口中的酒店
cues.pinyin: de2 dao4 di4 zhi3 de5 a1 jiang1 li4 ji2 qian2 wang3 nv3 hai2 kou3 zhong1 de5 jiu3 dian4
cues.en: Having gotten the address, A Jiang heads straight to the hotel the girl mentioned

cues.zh: 刚转身
cues.pinyin: gang1 zhuan3 shen1
cues.en: The moment he turns around

cues.zh: 达到一楼的小怪兽
cues.pinyin: da2 dao4 yi1 lou2 de5 xiao3 guai4 shou4
cues.en: he takes down the thugs on the first floor

cues.zh: 阿江直接来到顶楼
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zhi2 jie1 lai2 dao4 ding3 lou2
cues.en: then goes straight up to the top floor

cues.zh: 插手的极致就是一击之命
cues.pinyin: cha1 shou3 de5 ji2 zhi4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ji1 zhi1 ming4
cues.en: For a hitman, the ultimate skill is a one-hit kill

cues.zh: 每人一颗花生米
cues.pinyin: mei3 ren2 yi1 ke1 hua1 sheng1 mi3
cues.en: one bullet for each man

cues.zh: 不到一分钟便解决了所有人
cues.pinyin: bu2 dao4 yi4 fen1 zhong1 bian4 jie3 jue2 le5 suo3 you3 ren2
cues.en: taking out everyone in under a minute

cues.zh: 这时之前的黄毛慢悠悠走了出来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 zhi1 qian2 de5 huang2 mao2 man4 you1 you1 zou3 le5 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Just then, the yellow-haired thug from before strolls out

cues.zh: 话不投机半句多
cues.pinyin: hua4 bu4 tou2 ji1 ban4 ju4 duo1
cues.en: With nothing worth saying between them

cues.zh: 两人也没有惺惺相惜
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3 xing1 xing1 xiang1 xi1
cues.en: there's no mutual respect here

cues.zh: 直接战斗在一起
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 zhan4 dou4 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: they go straight into a fight

cues.zh: 然而阿江的首要目标
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 a1 jiang1 de5 shou3 yao4 mu4 biao1
cues.en: But A Jiang's main priority

cues.zh: 还是找到小芝
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 zhao3 dao4 xiao3 zhi1
cues.en: is still finding Xiaozhi

cues.zh: 将黄毛缠住后
cues.pinyin: jiang1 huang2 mao2 chan2 zhu4 hou4
cues.en: After tying up the yellow-haired thug

cues.zh: 直接破窗跳了下来
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 po4 chuang1 tiao4 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: he smashes through a window and jumps down

cues.zh: 结果被赶来的警察老李抓个正着
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 bei4 gan3 lai2 de5 jing3 cha2 lao3 li3 zhua1 ge4 zheng4 zhe5
cues.en: only to get caught red-handed by detective Old Li, who's just arrived

cues.zh: 将千里松人头的老李靠着后
cues.pinyin: jiang1 qian1 li3 song1 ren2 tou2 de5 lao3 li3 kao4 zhe5 hou4
cues.en: After explaining everything to Old Li

cues.zh: 二人来到码头
cues.pinyin: er4 ren2 lai2 dao4 ma3 tou2
cues.en: the two of them head to the docks

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 欢迎来到美食天堂！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 哈喽你好各位美食家
cues.pinyin: ha1 lou2 ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 mei3 shi2 jia1
cues.en: Hello, dear food lovers.

cues.zh: 各位爱做饭的人们
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 ai4 zuo4 fan4 de5 ren2 men5
cues.en: Everyone who loves cooking,

cues.zh: 我们又见面了我是 C iss i
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 you4 jian4 mian4 le5 wo3 shi4 C iss i
cues.en: We meet again, I'm Cissy.

cues.zh: 欢迎来到美食天堂
cues.pinyin: huan1 ying2 lai2 dao4 mei3 shi2 tian1 tang2
cues.en: Welcome to Food Paradise.

cues.zh: 进入我的厨房
cues.pinyin: jin4 ru4 wo3 de5 chu2 fang2
cues.en: Come into my kitchen,

cues.zh: 跟我一起探索亚洲家庭菜的无穷美味
cues.pinyin: gen1 wo3 yi4 qi3 tan4 suo3 ya4 zhou1 jia1 ting2 cai4 de5 wu2 qiong2 mei3 wei4
cues.en: Explore the endless deliciousness of Asian home cooking with me,

cues.zh: 赶快一起动手做
cues.pinyin: gan3 kuai4 yi4 qi3 dong4 shou3 zuo4
cues.en: And let's get cooking right away!

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 做体育运动的时候受伤很常见
cues.pinyin: zuo4 ti3 yu4 yun4 dong4 de5 shi2 hou4 shou4 shang1 hen3 chang2 jian4
cues.en: Getting hurt during sports is common.

cues.zh: 但举重举到差点瘫痪的你见过吗
cues.pinyin: dan4 ju3 zhong4 ju3 dao4 cha4 dian3 tan1 huan4 de5 ni3 jian4 guo4 ma5
cues.en: But have you ever seen someone almost paralyzed from weightlifting?

cues.zh: 大壮是个橄榄球运动员为了增强臂力
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 shi4 ge4 gan3 lan3 qiu2 yun4 dong4 yuan2 wei4 le5 zeng1 qiang2 bi4 li4
cues.en: Dazhuang is a football player, and to build arm strength,

cues.zh: 他今天来到健身王练习举重
cues.pinyin: ta1 jin1 tian1 lai2 dao4 jian4 shen1 wang2 lian4 xi2 ju3 zhong4
cues.en: he came to Fitness King today to practice weightlifting.

cues.zh: 同在健身王锻炼的布朗在一旁看呆了
cues.pinyin: tong2 zai4 jian4 shen1 wang2 duan4 lian4 de5 bu4 lang3 zai4 yi1 pang2 kan4 dai1 le5
cues.en: Brown, who was also working out at Fitness King, watched in shock.

cues.zh: 因为他举的杠铃足足有 300 多斤
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 ju3 de5 gang4 ling2 zu2 zu2 you3 300 duo1 jin1
cues.en: because the barbell he was lifting weighed over 300 jin.

cues.zh: 这力气也太大了吧不怕出什么问题吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li4 qi4 ye3 tai4 da4 le5 ba5 bu4 pa4 chu1 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 ma5
cues.en: That's so much weight—aren't you afraid something will go wrong?

cues.zh: 没过多久布朗担心的事情就发生了
cues.pinyin: mo4 guo4 duo1 jiu3 bu4 lang3 dan1 xin1 de5 shi4 qing2 jiu4 fa1 sheng1 le5
cues.en: Not long after, what Brown feared happened.

cues.zh: 大壮突然脱力倒在地上
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 tu1 ran2 tuo1 li4 dao3 zai4 di4 shang4
cues.en: Dazhuang suddenly lost strength and collapsed.

cues.zh: 他和梅主管赶紧跑过去查看情况
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 mei2 zhu3 guan3 gan3 jin3 pao3 guo4 qu4 cha2 kan4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: He and Supervisor Mei rushed over to check on him.

cues.zh: 大壮一个劲的说自己的腿没知觉了
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 yi2 ge4 jin4 de5 shuo1 zi4 ji3 de5 tui3 mei2 zhi1 jue2 le5
cues.en: Dazhuang kept saying he couldn't feel his legs.

cues.zh: 梅主管让他别乱动
cues.pinyin: mei2 zhu3 guan3 rang4 ta1 bie2 luan4 dong4
cues.en: Supervisor Mei told him not to move.

cues.zh: 然后布朗立刻打了 9 11
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 bu4 lang3 li4 ke4 da3 le5 9 11
cues.en: Then Brown immediately called 911.

cues.zh: 大壮到医院后就做了核磁共振
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 dao4 yi1 yuan4 hou4 jiu4 zuo4 le5 he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4
cues.en: After Dazhuang got to the hospital, he had an MRI.

cues.zh: 可结果并不乐观
cues.pinyin: ke3 jie2 guo3 bing4 bu4 le4 guan1
cues.en: But the results weren't good.

cues.zh: 他脊椎破裂
cues.pinyin: ta1 ji3 zhui1 po4 lie4
cues.en: His spine was fractured.

cues.zh: 小关节骨折
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guan1 jie2 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: The small joints were broken.

cues.zh: 而且后移的骨骼碎片进入了椎管
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hou4 yi2 de5 gu3 ge2 sui4 pian4 jin4 ru4 le5 chui2 guan3
cues.en: And bone fragments that shifted backward had entered the spinal canal.

cues.zh: 但脊椎里面并没有横贯性的瘀伤
cues.pinyin: dan4 ji3 zhui1 li3 mian4 bing4 mei2 you3 heng2 guan4 xing4 de5 yu1 shang1
cues.en: But there was no transverse bruising inside the spine.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 医生们决定把骨折稳定住
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 jue2 ding4 ba3 gu3 zhe2 wen3 ding4 zhu4
cues.en: The doctors decided to stabilize the fracture

cues.zh: 减轻脊椎的压力
cues.pinyin: jian3 qing1 ji3 zhui1 de5 ya1 li4
cues.en: to relieve pressure on the spine.

cues.zh: 这样大概率可以治好大壮的麻痹
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 da4 gai4 lv4 ke3 yi3 zhi4 hao3 da4 zhuang4 de5 ma2 bi4
cues.en: This would likely cure Dazhuang's paralysis.

cues.zh: 梅主管把这个想法告诉大壮的父亲后
cues.pinyin: mei2 zhu3 guan3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 xiang3 fa3 gao4 su4 da4 zhuang4 de5 fu4 qin1 hou4
cues.en: After Supervisor Mei told Dazhuang's father this plan,

cues.zh: 却遭到了反对
cues.pinyin: que4 zao1 dao4 le5 fan3 dui4
cues.en: he objected.

cues.zh: 大壮的父亲要求使用治疗肌萎缩
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 de5 fu4 qin1 yao1 qiu2 shi3 yong4 zhi4 liao2 ji1 wei1 suo1
cues.en: Dazhuang's father demanded they use medication for treating

cues.zh: 厕所硬化的药物
cues.pinyin: ce4 suo3 ying4 hua4 de5 yao4 wu4
cues.en: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) instead.

cues.zh: 这种药物能减少运动神经的损伤
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 yao4 wu4 neng2 jian3 shao3 yun4 dong4 shen2 jing1 de5 sun3 shang1
cues.en: This medication can reduce damage to motor neurons,

cues.zh: 但是不能逆转已经对运动神经
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bu4 neng2 ni4 zhuan3 yi3 jing1 dui4 yun4 dong4 shen2 jing1
cues.en: but it can't reverse damage

cues.zh: 元造成的损害
cues.pinyin: yuan2 zao4 cheng2 de5 sun3 hai4
cues.en: already done to the motor neurons.

cues.zh: 黄姐立刻拒绝
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 li4 ke4 ju4 jue2
cues.en: Dr. Huang immediately refused.

cues.zh: 提议有一种实验性的低体温疗法
cues.pinyin: ti2 yi4 you3 yi1 zhong3 shi2 yan4 xing4 de5 di1 ti3 wen1 liao2 fa3
cues.en: She proposed an experimental hypothermia therapy

cues.zh: 在术前可以减少脊髓水肿和细胞死亡
cues.pinyin: zai4 shu4 qian2 ke3 yi3 jian3 shao3 ji2 sui3 shui3 zhong3 he2 xi4 bao1 si3 wang2
cues.en: that could reduce spinal cord swelling and cell death before surgery.

cues.zh: 但是这个方法会造成心动过缓心率不齐
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 fang1 fa3 hui4 zao4 cheng2 xin1 dong4 guo4 huan3 xin1 lv4 bu4 qi2
cues.en: But this method also carries a high risk of bradycardia

cues.zh: 的几率也很高
cues.pinyin: de5 ji1 lv4 ye3 hen3 gao1
cues.en: and irregular heartbeat.

cues.zh: 两方都是什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: liang3 fang1 dou1 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What did the two sides actually mean?

cues.zh: 其实就是父亲希望在不危及大壮
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 fu4 qin1 xi1 wang4 zai4 bu4 wei1 ji2 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: In fact, the father hoped that, without endangering

cues.zh: 生命的前期下
cues.pinyin: sheng1 ming4 de5 qian2 qi1 xia4
cues.en: Dazhuang's life,

cues.zh: 要确定手术方法不会对他今后的
cues.pinyin: yao4 que4 ding4 shou3 shu4 fang1 fa3 bu2 hui4 dui4 ta1 jin1 hou4 de5
cues.en: they would choose a surgical method that wouldn't affect

cues.zh: 事业造成影响
cues.pinyin: shi4 ye4 zao4 cheng2 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: his future career.

cues.zh: 但医生要做的是尽大可能修复大壮的损伤
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi1 sheng1 yao4 zuo4 de5 shi4 jin3 da4 ke3 neng2 xiu1 fu4 da4 zhuang4 de5 sun3 shang1
cues.en: But what the doctors wanted to do was repair Dazhuang's injury as fully as possible.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 围观的父亲松了口气
cues.pinyin: wei2 guan1 de5 fu4 qin1 song1 le5 kou3 qi4
cues.en: The father, who was present, let out a sigh of relief.

cues.zh: 情况稳定后
cues.pinyin: qing2 kuang4 wen3 ding4 hou4
cues.en: After his condition stabilized,

cues.zh: 这个小手术就结束了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao3 shou3 shu4 jiu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: this minor surgery was over.

cues.zh: 但医生们还要检查一下大壮的情况
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi1 sheng1 men5 hai2 yao4 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4 da4 zhuang4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: But the doctors still needed to check on Dazhuang's condition

cues.zh: 保证明天的正式手术顺利开展
cues.pinyin: bao3 zheng4 ming2 tian1 de5 zheng4 shi4 shou3 shu4 shun4 li4 kai1 zhan3
cues.en: to make sure tomorrow's main surgery would go smoothly.

cues.zh: 手术开始前
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 kai1 shi3 qian2
cues.en: Before the surgery began,

cues.zh: 黄姐安慰大壮
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 an1 wei4 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: Dr. Huang comforted Dazhuang,

cues.zh: 以后也许还有机会重回赛场
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 ye3 xu3 hai2 you3 ji1 hui4 zhong4 hui2 sai4 chang3
cues.en: saying he might still have a chance to return to the field someday.

cues.zh: 听此大壮忍不住坦白
cues.pinyin: ting1 ci3 da4 zhuang4 ren3 bu2 zhu4 tan3 bai2
cues.en: Hearing this, Dazhuang couldn't help but confess.

cues.zh: 他之所以选择医生的方案
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 suo3 yi3 xuan3 ze2 yi1 sheng1 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: The reason he chose the doctors' plan

cues.zh: 是因为他一直很讨厌橄榄球
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 yi4 zhi2 hen3 tao3 yan4 gan3 lan3 qiu2
cues.en: was that he had always hated football.

cues.zh: 中学是因为身材的优势被选上球队
cues.pinyin: zhong1 xue2 shi4 yin1 wei4 shen1 cai2 de5 you1 shi4 bei4 xuan3 shang4 qiu2 dui4
cues.en: In middle school he was picked for the team because of his build,

cues.zh: 但并没有人问过他的意见
cues.pinyin: dan4 bing4 mei2 you3 ren2 wen4 guo4 ta1 de5 yi4 jian4
cues.en: but no one ever asked for his opinion.

cues.zh: 从第一次训练开始
cues.pinyin: cong2 di4 yi1 ci4 xun4 lian4 kai1 shi3
cues.en: From the very first practice,

cues.zh: 他就失去了自我
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shi1 qu4 le5 zi4 wo3
cues.en: he lost himself.

cues.zh: 大壮想过放弃
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 xiang3 guo4 fang4 qi4
cues.en: Dazhuang had thought about quitting,

cues.zh: 但是面对全家人以及亲戚朋友的期盼
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mian4 dui4 quan2 jia1 ren2 yi3 ji2 qin1 qi1 peng2 you3 de5 qi1 pan4
cues.en: but faced with the whole family's and relatives' expectations,

cues.zh: 他只能继续坚持
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 neng2 ji4 xu4 jian1 chi2
cues.en: he could only keep pushing through.

cues.zh: 他一直希望自己受伤
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zhi2 xi1 wang4 zi4 ji3 shou4 shang1
cues.en: He had always wished he'd get injured.

cues.zh: 就连去举重房也是故意的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 qu4 ju3 zhong4 fang2 ye3 shi4 gu4 yi4 de5
cues.en: Even going to the weight room was intentional—

cues.zh: 想要弄破膝盖
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 nong4 po4 xi1 gai4
cues.en: he wanted to hurt his knee.

cues.zh: 但没想到出了这样的意外
cues.pinyin: dan4 mei2 xiang3 dao4 chu1 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: But he never expected this kind of accident.

cues.zh: 不管怎样手术很顺利
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 zen3 yang4 shou3 shu4 hen3 shun4 li4
cues.en: Regardless, the surgery went smoothly.

cues.zh: 医生连接上大壮断裂的脊椎
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 lian2 jie1 shang4 da4 zhuang4 duan4 lie4 de5 ji3 zhui1
cues.en: The doctors reconnected Dazhuang's broken spine.

cues.zh: 大壮想来后不朗去找他
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 xiang3 lai2 hou4 bu4 lang3 qu4 zhao3 ta1
cues.en: After Dazhuang woke up, Brown went to see him.

cues.zh: 告诉大壮
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: He told Dazhuang

cues.zh: 他得把自己的想法告诉父母
cues.pinyin: ta1 de2 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 xiang3 fa3 gao4 su4 fu4 mu3
cues.en: that he had to tell his parents how he really felt.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 但是要求必须带上室友
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yao1 qiu2 bi4 xu1 dai4 shang4 shi4 you3
cues.en: But he asked that they bring along his roommate

cues.zh: 兼好友丽雅
cues.pinyin: jian1 hao3 you3 li4 ya3
cues.en: and good friend, Liya.

cues.zh: 虽然伦叔觉得不太合适
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 lun2 shu1 jue2 de5 bu4 tai4 he2 shi4
cues.en: Although Uncle Lun felt it wasn't quite appropriate,

cues.zh: 但是肖恩好不容易同意了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao4 en1 hao3 bu4 rong2 yi4 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: Shaun had finally agreed,

cues.zh: 就没有要求那么多
cues.pinyin: jiu4 mei2 you3 yao1 qiu2 na4 me5 duo1
cues.en: so he didn't ask for anything more.

cues.zh: 他们要前往另一个城市
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yao4 qian2 wang3 ling4 yi2 ge4 cheng2 shi4
cues.en: They were going to head to another city.

cues.zh: 收拾东西后
cues.pinyin: shou1 shi2 dong1 xi1 hou4
cues.en: After packing their things,

cues.zh: 尽快坐上了飞机
cues.pinyin: jin3 kuai4 zuo4 shang4 le5 fei1 ji1
cues.en: they got on a plane as soon as possible.

cues.zh: 下飞机后三人驱车去了萧恩家
cues.pinyin: xia4 fei1 ji1 hou4 san1 ren2 qu1 che1 qu4 le5 xiao1 en1 jia1
cues.en: After landing, the three drove to Shaun's house.

cues.zh: 到达后萧恩突然却反悔了
cues.pinyin: dao4 da2 hou4 xiao1 en1 tu1 ran2 que4 fan3 hui3 le5
cues.en: But once they arrived, Shaun suddenly changed his mind.

cues.zh: 此时萧恩妈妈看到有人来
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 xiao1 en1 ma1 ma1 kan4 dao4 you3 ren2 lai2
cues.en: At that moment, Shaun's mother saw someone had come

cues.zh: 便出门查看
cues.pinyin: bian4 chu1 men2 cha2 kan4
cues.en: and went out to check.

cues.zh: 看到了伦叔和萧恩
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 le5 lun2 shu1 he2 xiao1 en1
cues.en: She saw Uncle Lun and Shaun,

cues.zh: 但又不敢直接上前
cues.pinyin: dan4 you4 bu4 gan3 zhi2 jie1 shang4 qian2
cues.en: but didn't dare approach directly.

cues.zh: 只能小心翼翼的往车边挪
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4 de5 wang3 che1 bian1 nuo2
cues.en: She could only inch carefully toward the car.

cues.zh: 萧恩这时突然情绪失控
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 zhe4 shi2 tu1 ran2 qing2 xu4 shi1 kong4
cues.en: Shaun suddenly lost control of his emotions,

cues.zh: 大叫着让伦叔开车离开
cues.pinyin: da4 jiao4 zhe5 rang4 lun2 shu1 kai1 che1 li2 kai1
cues.en: shouting at Uncle Lun to drive away.

cues.zh: 不断强调自己想走
cues.pinyin: bu4 duan4 qiang2 diao4 zi4 ji3 xiang3 zou3
cues.en: He kept insisting he wanted to leave.

cues.zh: 伦叔不敢再刺激他
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 bu4 gan3 zai4 ci4 ji1 ta1
cues.en: Uncle Lun didn't dare upset him further.

cues.zh: 匆忙和萧恩妈妈打了个招呼
cues.pinyin: cong1 mang2 he2 xiao1 en1 ma1 ma1 da3 le5 ge4 zhao1 hu1
cues.en: He hurriedly greeted Shaun's mother

cues.zh: 就驱车离开
cues.pinyin: jiu4 qu1 che1 li2 kai1
cues.en: and then drove off.

cues.zh: 三人在一所旅馆住下
cues.pinyin: san1 ren2 zai4 yi1 suo3 lv3 guan3 zhu4 xia4
cues.en: The three of them checked into an inn.

cues.zh: 萧恩一个人坐在屋里
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zai4 wu1 li3
cues.en: Shaun sat alone in his room.

cues.zh: 丽雅过来安慰他
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 guo4 lai2 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: Liya came to comfort him,

cues.zh: 告诉他没事的
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 ta1 mei2 shi4 de5
cues.en: telling him it would be okay.

cues.zh: 虽然父亲快死了
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 fu4 qin1 kuai4 si3 le5
cues.en: Even though his father was dying,

cues.zh: 但肖恩没有必要
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 mei2 you3 bi4 yao4
cues.en: Shaun didn't have to

cues.zh: 因此就原谅他的所作所为
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 jiu4 yuan2 liang4 ta1 de5 suo3 zuo4 suo3 wei2
cues.en: forgive him for everything he'd done just because of that.

cues.zh: 肖恩终于说话了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhong1 yu2 shuo1 hua4 le5
cues.en: Shaun finally spoke.

cues.zh: 他要去看望哥哥
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 qu4 kan4 wang4 ge1 ge1
cues.en: He said he wanted to visit his brother.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 两人和伦叔一起来到肖恩哥哥的墓地
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 he2 lun2 shu1 yi4 qi3 lai2 dao4 xiao4 en1 ge1 ge1 de5 mu4 di4
cues.en: The two of them, with Uncle Lun, went to Shaun's brother's grave.

cues.zh: 当初哥哥下葬时
cues.pinyin: dang1 chu1 ge1 ge1 xia4 zang4 shi2
cues.en: Back when his brother was buried,

cues.zh: 父亲亲戚还有伦叔都在场
cues.pinyin: fu4 qin1 qin1 qi1 hai2 you3 lun2 shu1 dou1 zai4 chang3
cues.en: his father, relatives, and Uncle Lun had all been there.

cues.zh: 肖恩当众拒绝随同父亲回去
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 dang1 zhong4 ju4 jue2 sui2 tong2 fu4 qin1 hui2 qu4
cues.en: Shaun had refused in front of everyone to go back with his father.

cues.zh: 两人无法达成和解
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 wu2 fa3 da2 cheng2 he2 jie3
cues.en: The two of them had never reconciled,

cues.zh: 直到今日
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 jin1 ri4
cues.en: right up until today.

cues.zh: 伦叔看出肖恩的难过
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 kan4 chu1 xiao4 en1 de5 nan2 guo4
cues.en: Uncle Lun saw how sad Shaun was

cues.zh: 努力安慰他
cues.pinyin: nu3 li4 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: and tried hard to comfort him,

cues.zh: 但还是不忘让他回去看看父亲
cues.pinyin: dan4 hai2 shi4 bu4 wang4 rang4 ta1 hui2 qu4 kan4 kan4 fu4 qin1
cues.en: but still didn't forget to urge him to go see his father.

cues.zh: 丽雅告诉他
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Liya told him

cues.zh: 如果是勉强的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 mian3 qiang3 de5
cues.en: that if he was just forcing himself,

cues.zh: 那就不干是你做的
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 bu4 gan4 shi4 ni3 zuo4 de5
cues.en: then it wasn't something he truly wanted to do.

cues.zh: 肖恩最终还是回去了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zui4 zhong1 hai2 shi4 hui2 qu4 le5
cues.en: In the end, Shaun went back anyway.

cues.zh: 安静的坐在床前听父亲讲话
cues.pinyin: an1 jing4 de5 zuo4 zai4 chuang2 qian2 ting1 fu4 qin1 jiang3 hua4
cues.en: He sat quietly by the bed listening to his father speak,

cues.zh: 并不去看他
cues.pinyin: bing4 bu4 qu4 kan4 ta1
cues.en: without looking at him.

cues.zh: 小恩对不起
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 dui4 bu4 qi3
cues.en: "Xiao En, I'm sorry.

cues.zh: 只是我一直想要个儿子
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 wo3 yi4 zhi2 xiang3 yao4 ge4 er2 zi5
cues.en: It's just that I always wanted a son—

cues.zh: 我是说一个我能教他打猎钓鱼的孩子
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 shuo1 yi2 ge4 wo3 neng2 jiao4 ta1 da3 lie4 diao4 yu2 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: I mean, a kid I could teach to hunt and fish,

cues.zh: 能一起捉迷藏
cues.pinyin: neng2 yi4 qi3 zhuo1 mi2 cang2
cues.en: someone to play hide-and-seek with,

cues.zh: 一起喝啤酒
cues.pinyin: yi4 qi3 he1 pi2 jiu3
cues.en: to drink beer with,

cues.zh: 一个可以扛在肩上的小孩
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ke3 yi3 kang2 zai4 jian1 shang4 de5 xiao3 hai2
cues.en: a kid I could carry on my shoulders.

cues.zh: 我很愤怒
cues.pinyin: wo3 hen3 fen4 nu4
cues.en: I was angry,

cues.zh: 不是对你
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 dui4 ni3
cues.en: not at you,

cues.zh: 而是对我自己
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 dui4 wo3 zi4 ji3
cues.en: but at myself.

cues.zh: 我对自己很恼火
cues.pinyin: wo3 dui4 zi4 ji3 hen3 nao3 huo3
cues.en: I was furious at myself

cues.zh: 因为我帮不了我的儿子
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 bang1 bu4 liao3 wo3 de5 er2 zi5
cues.en: because I couldn't help my son.

cues.zh: 不管多么努力
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 duo1 me5 nu3 li4
cues.en: No matter how hard I tried,

cues.zh: 我总是失败了
cues.pinyin: wo3 zong3 shi4 shi1 bai4 le5
cues.en: I always failed.

cues.zh: 但你是个好孩子
cues.pinyin: dan4 ni3 shi4 ge4 hao3 hai2 zi5
cues.en: But you're a good kid."

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 长时间没上来
cues.pinyin: zhang3 shi2 jian1 mei2 shang4 lai2
cues.en: She hadn't come back up for a long time.

cues.zh: 肖恩有些慌
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 you3 xie1 huang1
cues.en: Shaun started to panic.

cues.zh: 脱了鞋袜想去看看
cues.pinyin: tuo1 le5 xie2 wa4 xiang3 qu4 kan4 kan4
cues.en: He took off his shoes and socks to go look.

cues.zh: 但丽雅又突然浮上来了
cues.pinyin: dan4 li4 ya3 you4 tu1 ran2 fu2 shang4 lai2 le5
cues.en: But Liya suddenly resurfaced.

cues.zh: 肖恩感觉自己被欺骗了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 gan3 jue2 zi4 ji3 bei4 qi1 pian4 le5
cues.en: Shaun felt like he'd been tricked.

cues.zh: 生气的离开
cues.pinyin: sheng1 qi4 de5 li2 kai1
cues.en: He left angrily.

cues.zh: 肖恩回到旅馆
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 hui2 dao4 lv3 guan3
cues.en: Shaun went back to the inn,

cues.zh: 坐到床上
cues.pinyin: zuo4 dao4 chuang2 shang4
cues.en: sat down on the bed,

cues.zh: 看着自己沾满泥的脚
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 zi4 ji3 zhan1 man3 ni2 de5 jiao3
cues.en: and looked at his own mud-covered feet.

cues.zh: 记忆一下拉回小时候
cues.pinyin: ji4 yi4 yi1 xia4 la1 hui2 xiao3 shi2 hou4
cues.en: His memory suddenly pulled him back to his childhood.

cues.zh: 当时她和哥哥父亲一起去爬山
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 ta1 he2 ge1 ge1 fu4 qin1 yi4 qi3 qu4 pa2 shan1
cues.en: Back then, he, his brother, and his father went hiking together,

cues.zh: 要蹚过一条小河
cues.pinyin: yao4 tang1 guo4 yi1 tiao2 xiao3 he2
cues.en: and had to wade across a small stream.

cues.zh: 但肖恩不想沾上泥
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 bu4 xiang3 zhan1 shang4 ni2
cues.en: But Shaun didn't want to get muddy

cues.zh: 也不愿让爸爸背过去
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 yuan4 rang4 ba4 ba4 bei4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: and refused to let his dad carry him across.

cues.zh: 僵持之下
cues.pinyin: jiang1 chi2 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: In the standoff,

cues.zh: 爸爸趁他不注意
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 chen4 ta1 bu4 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: his dad caught him off guard

cues.zh: 把他强制的抱过去了
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 qiang2 zhi4 de5 bao4 guo4 qu4 le5
cues.en: and forcibly carried him across.

cues.zh: 肖恩挣扎中
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zheng1 zha2 zhong1
cues.en: As Shaun struggled,

cues.zh: 把爸爸的脸抓烂了
cues.pinyin: ba3 ba4 ba4 de5 lian3 zhua1 lan4 le5
cues.en: he scratched up his dad's face,

cues.zh: 但是他没怪自己
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 mei2 guai4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: but his dad never blamed him for it.

cues.zh: 第二天
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1
cues.en: The next day,

cues.zh: 肖恩他们正在吃饭
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ta1 men5 zheng4 zai4 chi1 fan4
cues.en: while Shaun and the others were eating,

cues.zh: 妈妈主动来找肖恩
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 zhu3 dong4 lai2 zhao3 xiao4 en1
cues.en: his mother came to find him on her own,

cues.zh: 近乎哀求的请求他
cues.pinyin: jin4 hu1 ai1 qiu2 de5 qing3 qiu2 ta1
cues.en: almost begging him

cues.zh: 能再去看看爸爸
cues.pinyin: neng2 zai4 qu4 kan4 kan4 ba4 ba4
cues.en: to go see his dad again.

cues.zh: 妈妈真情流露
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 zhen1 qing2 liu2 lu4
cues.en: Seeing his mother's genuine emotion

cues.zh: 或许让肖恩有一些动容
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 rang4 xiao4 en1 you3 yi1 xie1 dong4 rong2
cues.en: may have moved Shaun a little.

cues.zh: 在他想要抱住自己时
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 xiang3 yao4 bao4 zhu4 zi4 ji3 shi2
cues.en: When she tried to hug him,

cues.zh: 还主动站了起来
cues.pinyin: hai2 zhu3 dong4 zhan4 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: he even stood up on his own.

cues.zh: 他决定再和父亲好好谈一谈
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 ding4 zai4 he2 fu4 qin1 hao3 hao3 tan2 yi1 tan2
cues.en: He decided to have a real talk with his father again.

cues.zh: 可这次父亲和上一次判诺了两人
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 ci4 fu4 qin1 he2 shang4 yi1 ci4 pan4 nuo4 le5 liang3 ren2
cues.en: But this time, his father seemed like a completely different person compared to before.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 从今天开始我想为大家导读爱因斯坦
cues.pinyin: cong2 jin1 tian1 kai1 shi3 wo3 xiang3 wei4 da4 jia1 dao3 du2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3
cues.en: Starting today, I want to guide everyone through Einstein's

cues.zh: 的一本小册子
cues.pinyin: de5 yi1 ben3 xiao3 ce4 zi5
cues.en: booklet

cues.zh: 侠义与广义相对论浅说
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian3 shuo1
cues.en: "Relativity: The Special and the General Theory"

cues.zh: 和大家一起聊一聊相对论
cues.pinyin: he2 da4 jia1 yi4 qi3 liao2 yi1 liao2 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: and discuss relativity together with you.

cues.zh: 相对论的书很多
cues.pinyin: xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 shu1 hen3 duo1
cues.en: There are many books about relativity.

cues.zh: 为什么我要选择这一本书呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 yao4 xuan3 ze2 zhe4 yi1 ben3 shu1 ne5
cues.en: Why did I choose this particular book?

cues.zh: 因为在这本书的前沿之中
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 zhe4 ben3 shu1 de5 qian2 yan2 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: Because in the preface of this book,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦写道
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 xie3 dao4
cues.en: Einstein wrote:

cues.zh: 本书只在让那些对相对论感兴趣
cues.pinyin: ben3 shu1 zhi3 zai4 rang4 na4 xie1 dui4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 gan3 xing4 qu4
cues.en: this book is meant only to let those interested in relativity

cues.zh: 但是理论物理和数学又不太好的读者
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 li3 lun4 wu4 li3 he2 shu4 xue2 you4 bu4 tai4 hao3 de5 du2 zhe3
cues.en: but not so good at theoretical physics and math

cues.zh: 能够尽可能准确地理解相对论
cues.pinyin: neng2 gou4 jin3 ke3 neng2 zhun3 que4 di4 li3 jie3 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: understand relativity as accurately as possible.

cues.zh: 那我想这本书刚好适合我的知识水平
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 xiang3 zhe4 ben3 shu1 gang1 hao3 shi4 he2 wo3 de5 zhi1 shi2 shui3 ping2
cues.en: So I thought this book just suits my level of knowledge.

cues.zh: 我想无论你是中学生还是大学生
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 wu2 lun4 ni3 shi4 zhong1 xue2 sheng1 huan2 shi4 da4 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: I think whether you're a middle school student or a college student,

cues.zh: 无论是文科生还是理科生
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 shi4 wen2 ke1 sheng1 huan2 shi4 li3 ke1 sheng1
cues.en: whether you're in humanities or sciences,

cues.zh: 都一定听说过相对论这三个字吧
cues.pinyin: dou1 yi2 ding4 ting1 shuo1 guo4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhe4 san1 ge4 zi4 ba5
cues.en: you must have heard the term "theory of relativity," right?

cues.zh: 可是对于大多数人来说
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dui4 yu2 da4 duo1 shu4 ren2 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: But for most people,

cues.zh: 相对论又实在太难了
cues.pinyin: xiang1 dui4 lun4 you4 shi2 zai4 tai4 nan2 le5
cues.en: relativity is really too difficult.

cues.zh: 这里还有一个小故事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 gu4 shi4
cues.en: There's also a little story here.

cues.zh: 全世界只有两个人懂相对论
cues.pinyin: quan2 shi4 jie4 zhi3 you3 liang3 ge4 ren2 dong3 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: Only two people in the world understood relativity.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 这个故事具体是这样的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gu4 shi4 ju4 ti3 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: The story goes like this:

cues.zh: 在 19 19 年英国皇家学会的会议上
cues.pinyin: zai4 19 19 nian2 ying1 guo2 huang2 jia1 xue2 hui4 de5 hui4 yi4 shang4
cues.en: At a 1919 meeting of the Royal Society in Britain,

cues.zh: 爱丁顿爵士宣布了他测量的星光偏角
cues.pinyin: ai4 ding1 dun4 jue2 shi4 xuan1 bu4 le5 ta1 ce4 liang2 de5 xing1 guang1 pian1 jiao3
cues.en: Sir Eddington announced the deflection angle of starlight he had measured,

cues.zh: 与爱因斯坦在 19 15 年广义相对论
cues.pinyin: yu3 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 19 15 nian2 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: which matched Einstein's 1915 general relativity

cues.zh: 的预测相符合
cues.pinyin: de5 yu4 ce4 xiang1 fu2 he2
cues.en: prediction.

cues.zh: 那么会后自认为是相对论专家的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 hui4 hou4 zi4 ren4 wei2 shi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhuan1 jia1 de5
cues.en: After the meeting, an American physicist who considered himself a relativity expert,

cues.zh: 美国物理学家希尔伯斯坦
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1 xi1 er3 bo2 si1 tan3
cues.en: Silberstein,

cues.zh: 与他闲聊的时候说
cues.pinyin: yu3 ta1 xian2 liao2 de5 shi2 hou4 shuo1
cues.en: chatted with him and said,

cues.zh: 爱丁顿教授
cues.pinyin: ai4 ding1 dun4 jiao4 shou4
cues.en: "Professor Eddington,

cues.zh: 您应该是世界上最了解相对论的
cues.pinyin: nin2 ying1 gai1 shi4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 liao3 jie3 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5
cues.en: you must be one of the three people in the world

cues.zh: 三个人之一了
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 ren2 zhi1 yi1 liao3
cues.en: who understand relativity best."

cues.zh: 当爱丁顿还在迟疑该如何回答的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 ai4 ding1 dun4 hai2 zai4 chi2 yi2 gai1 ru2 he2 hui2 da2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While Eddington was still hesitating how to respond,

cues.zh: 希尔伯斯坦接着说
cues.pinyin: xi1 er3 bo2 si1 tan3 jie1 zhe5 shuo1
cues.en: Silberstein went on to say,

cues.zh: 不要太谦虚了
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 tai4 qian1 xu1 le5
cues.en: "Don't be so modest."

cues.zh: 爱丁顿终于回答说
cues.pinyin: ai4 ding1 dun4 zhong1 yu2 hui2 da2 shuo1
cues.en: Eddington finally replied,

cues.zh: 哦不
cues.pinyin: o2 bu4
cues.en: "Oh no,

cues.zh: 我是在想第三个人可能是谁
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 zai4 xiang3 di4 san1 ge4 ren2 ke3 neng2 shi4 shui2
cues.en: I was just wondering who the third person might be."

cues.zh: 的确
cues.pinyin: di2 que4
cues.en: Indeed,

cues.zh: 在爱因斯坦刚刚提出相对论的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 gang1 gang1 ti2 chu1 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: when Einstein first proposed relativity,

cues.zh: 科学界一片哗然
cues.pinyin: ke1 xue2 jie4 yi1 pian4 hua2 ran2
cues.en: the scientific community was in uproar.

cues.zh: 许多科学家既没有弄懂
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 ke1 xue2 jia1 ji4 mei2 you3 nong4 dong3
cues.en: Many scientists neither understood it

cues.zh: 也不相信爱因斯坦
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 xiang1 xin4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3
cues.en: nor believed Einstein.

cues.zh: 而且爱因斯坦获得诺贝尔奖
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 huo4 de2 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3
cues.en: And Einstein won the Nobel Prize

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 不过在德国读书的时候
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zai4 de2 guo2 du2 shu1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: However, while studying in Germany,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦并没有表现出自己的天才
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 bing4 mei2 you3 biao3 xian4 chu1 zi4 ji3 de5 tian1 cai2
cues.en: Einstein didn't show any sign of being a genius.

cues.zh: 甚至因为德国的教育的严格
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 yin1 wei4 de2 guo2 de5 jiao4 yu4 de5 yan2 ge2
cues.en: In fact, the strictness of German education

cues.zh: 让爱因斯坦非常不舒服
cues.pinyin: rang4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 fei1 chang2 bu4 shu1 fu2
cues.en: made Einstein very uncomfortable.

cues.zh: 在 18 95 年爱因斯坦来到了瑞士
cues.pinyin: zai4 18 95 nian2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 lai2 dao4 le5 rui4 shi4
cues.en: In 1895, Einstein came to Switzerland

cues.zh: 参加了瑞士的高考
cues.pinyin: can1 jia1 le5 rui4 shi4 de5 gao1 kao3
cues.en: and took Switzerland's college entrance exam.

cues.zh: 但是因为文科部分考得不好
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yin1 wei4 wen2 ke1 bu4 fen4 kao3 de2 bu4 hao3
cues.en: But because he did poorly on the humanities section,

cues.zh: 没有考上
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 kao3 shang4
cues.en: he didn't get in.

cues.zh: 于是就在瑞士的阿劳中学复读了一年
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 zai4 rui4 shi4 de5 a1 lao2 zhong1 xue2 fu4 du2 le5 yi1 nian2
cues.en: So he repeated a year at Aarau Cantonal School in Switzerland.

cues.zh: 阿劳中学宽松的学风
cues.pinyin: a1 lao2 zhong1 xue2 kuan1 song1 de5 xue2 feng1
cues.en: The relaxed academic atmosphere at Aarau

cues.zh: 给了爱因斯坦很多独立思考的机会
cues.pinyin: gei3 le5 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 hen3 duo1 du2 li4 si1 kao3 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: gave Einstein many opportunities for independent thinking.

cues.zh: 比如他曾经想过这样一个问题
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ta1 ceng2 jing1 xiang3 guo4 zhe4 yang4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: For example, he once pondered a question like this:

cues.zh: 如果一个人跑得跟光一样快
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi2 ge4 ren2 pao3 de2 gen1 guang1 yi1 yang4 kuai4
cues.en: if a person ran as fast as light,

cues.zh: 他会看到什么情景呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 kan4 dao4 shen2 me5 qing2 jing3 ne5
cues.en: what would he see?

cues.zh: 直到十年之后
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 shi2 nian2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: It wasn't until ten years later

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦自己回答了自己的问题
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zi4 ji3 hui2 da2 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: that Einstein answered his own question.

cues.zh: 在第二年爱因斯坦高中毕业
cues.pinyin: zai4 di4 er4 nian2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 gao1 zhong1 bi4 ye4
cues.en: The following year, Einstein graduated from high school.

cues.zh: 他的数学和物理考试都得了六分
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 shu4 xue2 he2 wu4 li3 kao3 shi4 dou1 de2 le5 liu4 fen1
cues.en: He scored a 6 in both math and physics.

cues.zh: 有人据此说爱因斯坦学习不好
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 ju4 ci3 shuo1 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 xue2 xi2 bu4 hao3
cues.en: Some people use this to claim Einstein wasn't good at school.

cues.zh: 我还考了 60 分
cues.pinyin: wo3 hai2 kao3 le5 60 fen1
cues.en: "I even scored 60."

cues.zh: 要知道瑞士高中毕业的时候
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhi1 dao4 rui4 shi4 gao1 zhong1 bi4 ye4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: You should know that when graduating from Swiss high school,

cues.zh: 6 分就是满分了
cues.pinyin: 6 fen1 jiu4 shi4 man3 fen1 le5
cues.en: a 6 was a perfect score.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 从 19 00 年到 19 05 年爱因斯坦没有博士学位
cues.pinyin: cong2 19 00 nian2 dao4 19 05 nian2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 mei2 you3 bo2 shi4 xue2 wei4
cues.en: From 1900 to 1905, Einstein had no doctoral degree.

cues.zh: 最初几年也没有工作狼狈至极
cues.pinyin: zui4 chu1 ji3 nian2 ye3 mei2 you3 gong1 zuo4 lang2 bei4 zhi4 ji2
cues.en: In the early years he had no job either, living in dire straits.

cues.zh: 后来在他的同学格罗斯曼的父亲的帮助下
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zai4 ta1 de5 tong2 xue2 ge2 luo2 si1 man4 de5 fu4 qin1 de5 bang1 zhu4 xia4
cues.en: Later, with the help of his classmate Grossmann's father,

cues.zh: 在博尔尼瑞士专利局当了一名小职员
cues.pinyin: zai4 bo2 er3 ni2 rui4 shi4 zhuan1 li4 ju2 dang1 le5 yi1 ming2 xiao3 zhi2 yuan2
cues.en: he became a minor clerk at the Swiss Patent Office in Bern.

cues.zh: 为了贴补家用
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 tie1 bu3 jia1 yong4
cues.en: To help support the family,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦还在当地的报纸
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 hai2 zai4 dang1 di4 de5 bao4 zhi3
cues.en: Einstein even placed an ad in the local newspaper,

cues.zh: 博尔尼市公告报上刊登广告
cues.pinyin: bo2 er3 ni2 shi4 gong1 gao4 bao4 shang4 kan1 deng1 guang3 gao4
cues.en: the Bern City Gazette:

cues.zh: 阿尔伯特爱因斯坦
cues.pinyin: a1 er3 bo2 te4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3
cues.en: "Albert Einstein

cues.zh: 愿意私人为大学生或者中学生
cues.pinyin: yuan4 yi4 si1 ren2 wei2 da4 xue2 sheng1 huo4 zhe3 zhong1 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: is willing to privately teach college or high school students

cues.zh: 彻底讲授数学和物理学
cues.pinyin: che4 di3 jiang3 shou4 shu4 xue2 he2 wu4 li3 xue2
cues.en: mathematics and physics thoroughly.

cues.zh: 本人持有苏黎世联邦工学院的
cues.pinyin: ben3 ren2 chi2 you3 su1 li2 shi4 lian2 bang1 gong1 xue2 yuan4 de5
cues.en: I hold a teaching qualification certificate from

cues.zh: 教师资格证书
cues.pinyin: jiao4 shi1 zi1 ge2 zheng4 shu1
cues.en: the Swiss Federal Polytechnic in Zurich.

cues.zh: 驻正义街 32 号一楼
cues.pinyin: zhu4 zheng4 yi4 jie1 32 hao4 yi1 lou2
cues.en: Located at No. 32 Justice Street, first floor.

cues.zh: 试听免费
cues.pinyin: shi4 ting1 mian3 fei4
cues.en: Trial lesson free."

cues.zh: 广告还真的招来了几个学生
cues.pinyin: guang3 gao4 hai2 zhen1 de5 zhao1 lai2 le5 ji3 ge4 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: The ad really did attract a few students.

cues.pinyin: zai4 19 02 nian2

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦有了第一个学生索洛文
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 you3 le5 di4 yi2 ge4 xue2 sheng1 suo3 luo4 wen2
cues.en: Einstein got his first student, Solovine,

cues.zh: 当时正在博尔尼大学学习物理和哲学
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 zheng4 zai4 bo2 er3 ni2 da4 xue2 xue2 xi2 wu4 li3 he2 zhe2 xue2
cues.en: who was studying physics and philosophy at the University of Bern at the time.

cues.zh: 他觉得课堂内容太简单了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 ke4 tang2 nei4 rong2 tai4 jian3 dan1 le5
cues.en: He found the classroom content too simple,

cues.zh: 就来听爱因斯坦的课
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lai2 ting1 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 de5 ke4
cues.en: so he came to attend Einstein's lessons.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 收费课程结束之后
cues.pinyin: shou1 fei4 ke4 cheng2 jie2 shu4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After the paid lessons ended,

cues.zh: 二人又开始随心所欲地讨论物理和哲学
cues.pinyin: er4 ren2 you4 kai1 shi3 sui2 xin1 suo3 yu4 di4 tao3 lun4 wu4 li3 he2 zhe2 xue2
cues.en: the two of them started discussing physics and philosophy freely, as they pleased.

cues.zh: 后来又加入了在博尔尼大学学习数
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 you4 jia1 ru4 le5 zai4 bo2 er3 ni2 da4 xue2 xue2 xi2 shu4
cues.en: Later, Habicht, who was studying mathematics

cues.zh: 学的哈比克特
cues.pinyin: xue2 de5 ha1 bi3 ke4 te4
cues.en: at the University of Bern, also joined them.

cues.zh: 再后来邮电局的雇员沙旺
cues.pinyin: zai4 hou4 lai2 you2 dian4 ju2 de5 gu4 yuan2 sha1 wang4
cues.en: Then later, a postal-service clerk named Shawang also joined,

cues.zh: 专利局的同事贝索也加入了进来
cues.pinyin: zhuan1 li4 ju2 de5 tong2 shi4 bei4 suo3 ye3 jia1 ru4 le5 jin4 lai2
cues.en: and Besso, a colleague from the patent office, joined in too.

cues.zh: 很快收费的课程变成了次要的
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 shou1 fei4 de5 ke4 cheng2 bian4 cheng2 le5 ci4 yao4 de5
cues.en: Soon the paid lessons became secondary;

cues.zh: 热烈的课后讨论才是他们想要的
cues.pinyin: re4 lie4 de5 ke4 hou4 tao3 lun4 cai2 shi4 ta1 men5 xiang3 yao4 de5
cues.en: the heated after-class discussions were what they really wanted.

cues.zh: 因为在家里影响了妻子米列娃的休息
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 jia1 li3 ying3 xiang3 le5 qi1 zi3 mi3 lie4 wa2 de5 xiu1 xi1
cues.en: Because it disturbed his wife Mileva's rest at home,

cues.zh: 几个人转移到了一个叫做奥林匹
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 ren2 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 jiao4 zuo4 ao4 lin2 pi3
cues.en: the group moved to a café called

cues.zh: 亚的咖啡馆里
cues.pinyin: ya4 de5 ka1 fei1 guan3 li3
cues.en: "Olympia."

cues.zh: 几个年轻人还给这个小团体起了个名字
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 nian2 qing1 ren2 huan2 gei3 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 tuan2 ti3 qi3 le5 ge4 ming2 zi4
cues.en: The young men even gave this little group a name:

cues.zh: 奥林匹亚科学院
cues.pinyin: ao4 lin2 pi3 ya4 ke1 xue2 yuan4
cues.en: the "Olympia Academy."

cues.zh: 他们会先吃一点东西
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hui4 xian1 chi1 yi4 dian3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: They would first eat a little something,

cues.zh: 然后阅读一些与数学物理哲学有关的书
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yue4 du2 yi1 xie1 yu3 shu4 xue2 wu4 li3 zhe2 xue2 you3 guan1 de5 shu1
cues.en: then read some books related to math, physics, and philosophy,

cues.zh: 然后进行讨论
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jin4 xing2 tao3 lun4
cues.en: and then discuss them.

cues.zh: 他们读过休默柏拉图
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 du2 guo4 xiu1 mo4 bo2 la1 tu2
cues.en: They read classic works by Hume, Plato,

cues.zh: 莱布尼茨庞加莱的经典著作
cues.pinyin: lai2 bu4 ni2 ci2 pang2 jia1 lai2 de5 jing1 dian3 zhu4 zuo4
cues.en: Leibniz, and Poincaré.

cues.zh: 提出了光的波粒二象性学说
cues.pinyin: ti2 chu1 le5 guang1 de5 bo1 li4 er4 xiang4 xing4 xue2 shuo1
cues.en: They'd read a page and then start discussing.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 几乎没有什么参考文献
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 can1 kao3 wen2 xian4
cues.en: They had almost no reference materials,

cues.zh: 却唯独对贝索表示了感谢
cues.pinyin: que4 wei2 du2 dui4 bei4 suo3 biao3 shi4 le5 gan3 xie4
cues.en: yet they specifically expressed gratitude to Besso alone.

cues.zh: 贝索激动地对爱因斯坦说
cues.pinyin: bei4 suo3 ji1 dong4 di4 dui4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shuo1
cues.en: Besso excitedly said to Einstein,

cues.zh: 阿尔伯特你把我拉进了历史
cues.pinyin: a1 er3 bo2 te4 ni3 ba3 wo3 la1 jin4 le5 li4 shi3
cues.en: "Albert, you've pulled me into history."

cues.zh: 在那一年爱因斯坦宛如被雅典娜附体
cues.pinyin: zai4 na4 yi1 nian2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 wan3 ru2 bei4 ya3 dian3 na4 fu4 ti3
cues.en: That year, Einstein seemed possessed by Athena.

cues.zh: 一年之内连续发表了数篇论文
cues.pinyin: yi1 nian2 zhi1 nei4 lian2 xu4 fa1 biao3 le5 shu4 pian1 lun4 wen2
cues.en: Within a single year he published several papers in a row,

cues.zh: 每一篇论文都是诺贝尔奖的水平
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 pian1 lun4 wen2 dou1 shi4 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3 de5 shui3 ping2
cues.en: each one of Nobel Prize caliber.

cues.zh: 比如爱因斯坦解释了光电效应
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 jie3 shi4 le5 guang1 dian4 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: For instance, Einstein explained the photoelectric effect,

cues.zh: 提出了光的玻璃二象性学说
cues.pinyin: ti2 chu1 le5 guang1 de5 bo1 li2 er4 xiang4 xing4 xue2 shuo1
cues.en: and proposed the theory of wave-particle duality of light.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦通过对布朗运动的解释
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 tong1 guo4 dui4 bu4 lang3 yun4 dong4 de5 jie3 shi4
cues.en: Through his explanation of Brownian motion,

cues.zh: 证实了原子的存在
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shi2 le5 yuan2 zi5 de5 cun2 zai4

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦提出了时间和空间的新的看法
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 ti2 chu1 le5 shi2 jian1 he2 kong1 jian1 de5 xin1 de5 kan4 fa3
cues.en: Einstein proposed a new view of time and space,

cues.zh: 并且提出智能方程
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 ti2 chu1 zhi4 neng2 fang1 cheng2
cues.en: and put forward the mass-energy equation.

cues.zh: 19 05 年被称之为爱因斯坦奇迹年
cues.pinyin: 19 05 nian2 bei4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 qi2 ji4 nian2
cues.en: 1905 is known as Einstein's "miracle year."

cues.zh: 人们难以想象一个 26 岁的年轻人

cues.zh: 就像人们不明白

cues.en: just as people can't understand

cues.pinyin: wo3 fang4 qi4 diao4 le5 yi2 ge4 yi3 jing1 shi4 wu2 xian4 qi1 he2 tong2 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: I gave up an opportunity that was already a permanent contract.

cues.zh: 我想把自己的未来掌握在自己手里
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 wei4 lai2 zhang3 wo4 zai4 zi4 ji3 shou3 li3
cues.en: I wanted to take my future into my own hands.

cues.zh: 当你进入这种状态的时候个人是享受的
cues.pinyin: dang1 ni3 jin4 ru4 zhe4 zhong3 zhuang4 tai4 de5 shi2 hou4 ge4 ren2 shi4 xiang3 shou4 de5
cues.en: When you enter that state, you personally enjoy it.

cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 che1 ye3 shi4 yi1 ba3 yao4 shi5

cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 kai1 qi3 ni3 bu4 tong2 de5 yi2 ge4 jing1 li4 he2 lv3 cheng2
cues.en: It opens up a different experience and journey for you.

cues.en: There's definitely a price to pay — to others it might be worthless.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 动动脑时间2｜谁能最快举手猜对自己帽子的颜色呢？｜大大小小

cues.zh: A BC D 四位小朋友在上体育课
cues.pinyin: A BC D si4 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 zai4 shang4 ti3 yu4 ke4
cues.en: Four kids, A, B, C, and D, are in P.E. class.

cues.zh: 老师让他们站在阶梯
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 rang4 ta1 men5 zhan4 zai4 jie1 ti1
cues.en: The teacher has them stand on steps.

cues.zh: D 小朋友的前方被墙挡着
cues.pinyin: D xiao3 peng2 you3 de5 qian2 fang1 bei4 qiang2 dang3 zhe5
cues.en: A wall blocks D's view in front.

cues.zh: 老师从后面帮小朋友戴上帽子
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 cong2 hou4 mian4 bang1 xiao3 peng2 you3 dai4 shang4 mao4 zi5
cues.en: The teacher puts hats on them from behind.

cues.zh: 而且不能回头看
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 neng2 hui2 tou2 kan4
cues.en: And they're not allowed to look back.

cues.zh: 因此四位小朋友都不知道自己头上的帽
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 si4 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 dou1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 tou2 shang4 de5 mao4
cues.en: So none of the four kids know what color

cues.zh: 子是什么颜色
cues.pinyin: zi5 shi4 shen2 me5 yan2 se4
cues.en: the hat on their own head is.

cues.zh: 但 AB 却可以看到前方小朋友的帽子
cues.pinyin: dan4 AB que4 ke3 yi3 kan4 dao4 qian2 fang1 xiao3 peng2 you3 de5 mao4 zi5
cues.en: But A and B can see the hats of the kids in front of them.

cues.zh: 老师告诉他们
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 gao4 su4 ta1 men5
cues.en: The teacher tells them,

cues.zh: 大家的帽子中有两顶是黄色两顶是蓝色
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 de5 mao4 zi5 zhong1 you3 liang3 ding3 shi4 huang2 se4 liang3 ding3 shi4 lan2 se4
cues.en: "Among everyone's hats, two are yellow and two are blue.

cues.zh: 谁能最快举手猜对自己帽子的颜色
cues.pinyin: shui2 neng2 zui4 kuai4 ju3 shou3 cai1 dui4 zi4 ji3 mao4 zi5 de5 yan2 se4
cues.en: Whoever raises their hand fastest and correctly guesses their own hat color

cues.zh: 就可以得到一个奖品
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 de2 dao4 yi2 ge4 jiang3 pin3
cues.en: gets a prize."

cues.zh: 结果有一位小朋友猜对了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 you3 yi1 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 cai1 dui4 le5
cues.en: In the end, one kid guessed correctly.

cues.zh: 请问是 A BC D 中谁呢
cues.pinyin: qing3 wen4 shi4 A BC D zhong1 shui2 ne5
cues.en: So who was it — A, B, C, or D?

cues.zh: 知道答案的可在下方留言哦
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 de5 ke3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 o2
cues.en: If you know the answer, leave a comment below!

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这哦
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o2
cues.en: The answer to the last episode is here!

items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好

cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 yue4 qing1 hua2 da4 xue2 200 9 jie4 de5 bi4 ye4 sheng1

cues.pinyin: wo3 bi4 ye4 yu2 qing1 hua2 da4 xue2 dian4 zi5 gong1 cheng2 xi4

cues.zh: 导师叫郝志彪
