cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 wo3 de5 jing1 li4 neng2 gou4 gei3 da4 jia1 yi4 dian3 qi3 shi4
cues.en: I hope my experience can give you some inspiration

cues.zh: 我也非常非常的希望能够和在座的
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 de5 xi1 wang4 neng2 gou4 he2 zai4 zuo4 de5
cues.en: I also very, very much hope to

cues.zh: 各位成为同事
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 cheng2 wei2 tong2 shi4
cues.en: become colleagues with everyone here

cues.zh: 在十年以前我即将从清华大学毕业的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 shi2 nian2 yi3 qian2 wo3 ji2 jiang1 cong2 qing1 hua2 da4 xue2 bi4 ye4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Ten years ago, when I was about to graduate from Tsinghua

cues.zh: 我去过很多公司面试
cues.pinyin: wo3 qu4 guo4 hen3 duo1 gong1 si1 mian4 shi4
cues.en: I interviewed at many companies

cues.zh: 比如说我去过索尼北京总部
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 qu4 guo4 suo3 ni2 bei3 jing1 zong3 bu4
cues.en: For example, I went to Sony's Beijing headquarters

cues.zh: 当我来到索尼的北京总部的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 wo3 lai2 dao4 suo3 ni2 de5 bei3 jing1 zong3 bu4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I arrived at Sony's Beijing headquarters

cues.zh: 我看到那富丽堂皇的建筑瞠目结舌
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 dao4 na4 fu4 li4 tang2 huang2 de5 jian4 zhu4 cheng1 mu4 jie2 she2
cues.en: I was stunned by how grand and luxurious the building was

cues.zh: 因为我到北京这么多年一直在中
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 dao4 bei3 jing1 zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 yi4 zhi2 zai4 zhong1
cues.en: Because in all my years in Beijing, I'd always been

cues.zh: 关村附近活动
cues.pinyin: guan1 cun1 fu4 jin4 huo2 dong4
cues.en: active around the Zhongguancun area

cues.zh: 我从来没有见过那么辉煌的建筑
cues.pinyin: wo3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 jian4 guo4 na4 me5 hui1 huang2 de5 jian4 zhu4
cues.en: I had never seen such a magnificent building

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 面试到最后的时候面试官问了我一个问题
cues.pinyin: mian4 shi4 dao4 zui4 hou4 de5 shi2 hou4 mian4 shi4 guan1 wen4 le5 wo3 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Near the end of the interview, the interviewer asked me a question

cues.zh: 他说你对工作有什么要求
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 dui4 gong1 zuo4 you3 shen2 me5 yao1 qiu2
cues.en: He said, "What do you want from a job?"

cues.zh: 然后我说了三个字不加班
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 shuo1 le5 san1 ge4 zi4 bu4 jia1 ban1
cues.en: I said three words: "No overtime"

cues.zh: 然后就没有然后了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 mei2 you3 ran2 hou4 le5
cues.en: And that was the end of that

cues.zh: 后来我又去了雷曼兄弟面试
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 you4 qu4 le5 lei2 man4 xiong1 di4 mian4 shi4
cues.en: Later I also interviewed at Lehman Brothers

cues.zh: 在雷曼兄弟面试的时候面试官
cues.pinyin: zai4 lei2 man4 xiong1 di4 mian4 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 mian4 shi4 guan1
cues.en: During the Lehman Brothers interview, the interviewer

cues.zh: 问我一个问题
cues.pinyin: wen4 wo3 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: asked me a question

cues.zh: 你怎么处理你自己的零花钱
cues.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 chu3 li3 ni3 zi4 ji3 de5 ling2 hua1 qian2
cues.en: "How do you handle your own pocket money?"

cues.zh: 我说我买股票了
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 mai3 gu3 piao4 le5
cues.en: I said, "I bought stocks"

cues.zh: 他说那你是怎么选择股票的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 na4 ni3 shi4 zen3 me5 xuan3 ze2 gu3 piao4 de5
cues.en: He said, "So how do you pick stocks?"

cues.zh: 我说我是瞎选的
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 shi4 xia1 xuan3 de5
cues.en: I said, "I just pick randomly"

cues.zh: 然后就没有然后了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 mei2 you3 ran2 hou4 le5
cues.en: And that was the end of that too

cues.zh: 其实当时我也很迷惘
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 dang1 shi2 wo3 ye3 hen3 mi2 wang3
cues.en: Actually, I was pretty lost back then

cues.zh: 我不知道自己到底要从事一个
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 dao4 di3 yao4 cong2 shi4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: I didn't know what kind of

cues.zh: 什么样的行业
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yang4 de5 hang2 ye4
cues.en: industry I wanted to go into

cues.zh: 偶然的机会我到海淀黄庄去路过
cues.pinyin: ou3 ran2 de5 ji1 hui4 wo3 dao4 hai3 dian4 huang2 zhuang1 qu4 lu4 guo4
cues.en: By chance, I happened to pass through Haidian Huangzhuang

cues.zh: 我走到人大附中的门口
cues.pinyin: wo3 zou3 dao4 ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 de5 men2 kou3
cues.en: I walked up to the gate of RDFZ (the High School Affiliated to Renmin University)

cues.zh: 看到许多同学在穿着校服
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 xu3 duo1 tong2 xue2 zai4 chuan1 zhe5 xiao4 fu2
cues.en: and saw many students wearing their school uniforms

cues.zh: 在门口走来走去
cues.pinyin: zai4 men2 kou3 zou3 lai2 zou3 qu4
cues.en: walking around in front of the gate

cues.zh: 我知道这是北京最好的高中
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi4 bei3 jing1 zui4 hao3 de5 gao1 zhong1
cues.en: I knew this was the best high school in Beijing

cues.zh: 同学们要是逛街也要相约穿着校服
cues.pinyin: tong2 xue2 men5 yao4 shi4 guang4 jie1 ye3 yao4 xiang1 yue1 chuan1 zhe5 xiao4 fu2
cues.en: Even when going out shopping, students would agree to wear their uniforms

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 还参加过国际大争辩论赛
cues.pinyin: hai2 can1 jia1 guo4 guo2 ji4 da4 zheng1 bian4 lun4 sai4
cues.en: I had also competed in the International College Debate Competition

cues.zh: 是中国队的变手
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhong1 guo2 dui4 de5 bian4 shou3
cues.en: as a debater on the Chinese team

cues.zh: 所以我有优秀的表达能力
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 you3 you1 xiu4 de5 biao3 da2 neng2 li4
cues.en: So I had strong public speaking skills

cues.zh: 可以在很多小朋友们前讲话
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zai4 hen3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 men5 qian2 jiang3 hua4
cues.en: I could speak in front of many kids

cues.zh: 而且不怯场
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 qie4 chang3
cues.en: and not get stage fright

cues.zh: 这些都是我的优势
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 dou1 shi4 wo3 de5 you1 shi4
cues.en: These were all my strengths

cues.zh: 但最重要的是
cues.pinyin: dan4 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But most importantly

cues.zh: 我是一个不善于与人打交道的人
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 yi2 ge4 bu4 shan4 yu2 yu3 ren2 da3 jiao1 dao4 de5 ren2
cues.en: I'm not someone who's good at dealing with people

cues.zh: 也许有人很奇怪
cues.pinyin: ye3 xu3 you3 ren2 hen3 qi2 guai4
cues.en: Some might find this strange

cues.zh: 你说你善于表达
cues.pinyin: ni3 shuo1 ni3 shan4 yu2 biao3 da2
cues.en: You say you're good at speaking

cues.zh: 你又不善于与人打交道
cues.pinyin: ni3 you4 bu4 shan4 yu2 yu3 ren2 da3 jiao1 dao4
cues.en: but not good at dealing with people

cues.zh: 这不矛盾吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 mao2 dun4 ma5
cues.en: Isn't that a contradiction?

cues.zh: 但是这其实就是事实
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 shi4 shi2
cues.en: But that's actually just the truth

cues.zh: 我曾经跟我的同学争论一个问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 ceng2 jing1 gen1 wo3 de5 tong2 xue2 zheng1 lun4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: I once argued with a classmate over an issue

cues.zh: 争论的面红耳赤
cues.pinyin: zheng1 lun4 de5 mian4 hong2 er3 chi4
cues.en: We argued until our faces turned red

cues.zh: 后来其他同学跟我说
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 qi2 ta1 tong2 xue2 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Afterward another classmate told me

cues.zh: 在成人的世界里是没有对错的
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 ren2 de5 shi4 jie4 li3 shi4 mei2 you3 dui4 cuo4 de5
cues.en: "In the adult world, there's no right or wrong

cues.zh: 只有利弊
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 li4 bi4
cues.en: only advantages and disadvantages"

cues.zh: 我明白他的意思
cues.pinyin: wo3 ming2 bai2 ta1 de5 yi4 si5
cues.en: I understood what he meant

cues.zh: 但是如果你让我在职场上左右逢源
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 ni3 rang4 wo3 zai4 zhi2 chang3 shang4 zuo3 you4 feng2 yuan2
cues.en: But if you asked me to be smooth and tactful in the workplace

cues.zh: 魅上七下
cues.pinyin: mei4 shang4 qi1 xia4
cues.en: flattering superiors while bullying subordinates

cues.zh: 见风使舵
cues.pinyin: jian4 feng1 shi3 duo4
cues.en: and going with the flow depending on which way the wind blows

cues.zh: 我真的做不到
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhen1 de5 zuo4 bu2 dao4
cues.en: I really couldn't do it

cues.zh: 于是有人跟我说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 you3 ren2 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: So someone told me

cues.zh: 你这种性格可能只能当一个中学老师了
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 zhong3 xing4 ge2 ke3 neng2 zhi3 neng2 dang1 yi2 ge4 zhong1 xue2 lao3 shi1 le5
cues.en: "With your personality, maybe you can only be a middle school teacher"

cues.zh: 你当一个中学老师
cues.pinyin: ni3 dang1 yi2 ge4 zhong1 xue2 lao3 shi1
cues.en: "As a middle school teacher

cues.zh: 讲究对错就够了
cues.pinyin: jiang3 jiu1 dui4 cuo4 jiu4 gou4 le5
cues.en: caring about right and wrong is enough"

cues.zh: 我想通了
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 tong1 le5
cues.en: That got me thinking it through

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 如果我说我看中的是北京户口
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 shuo1 wo3 kan4 zhong4 de5 shi4 bei3 jing1 hu4 kou3
cues.en: If I said I was after a Beijing residency permit (hukou)

cues.zh: 而且有寒暑假
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 you3 han2 shu3 jia4
cues.en: and the winter and summer vacations

cues.zh: 然后我再偷着出去坐家教
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 zai4 tou1 zhe5 chu1 qu4 zuo4 jia1 jiao4
cues.en: and planned to secretly tutor on the side

cues.zh: 这样就可以挣钱了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zheng4 qian2 le5
cues.en: to make extra money

cues.zh: 这就显得很庸俗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 xian3 de5 hen3 yong1 su2
cues.en: that would sound rather vulgar

cues.zh: 那如果我说我不在乎工作辛苦
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 wo3 shuo1 wo3 bu4 zai4 hu1 gong1 zuo4 xin1 ku3
cues.en: But if I said I didn't care about hard work

cues.zh: 我也不在乎工资低
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 bu4 zai4 hu1 gong1 zi1 di1
cues.en: and didn't care about low pay

cues.zh: 我就是要做人类灵魂的工程师
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 shi4 yao4 zuo4 ren2 lei4 ling2 hun2 de5 gong1 cheng2 shi1
cues.en: and just wanted to be an "engineer of the human soul"

cues.zh: 这显得很虚伪
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xian3 de5 hen3 xu1 wei3
cues.en: that would sound rather hypocritical

cues.zh: 所以这个问题究竟该怎么回答呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 jiu1 jing4 gai1 zen3 me5 hui2 da2 ne5
cues.en: So how should I actually answer this question?

cues.zh: 当时我的脑子里闪现出法拉第的故事
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 wo3 de5 nao3 zi5 li3 shan3 xian4 chu1 fa3 la1 di4 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: At the time, Faraday's story flashed through my mind

cues.zh: 只上过两年小学的科学家法拉第
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shang4 guo4 liang3 nian2 xiao3 xue2 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1 fa3 la1 di4
cues.en: Faraday, the scientist who only had two years of elementary school

cues.zh: 年轻的时候自己在家里看书做实验
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 de5 shi2 hou4 zi4 ji3 zai4 jia1 li3 kan4 shu1 zuo4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: read books and did experiments at home when he was young

cues.zh: 后来他看到报纸上大化学家戴维
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 kan4 dao4 bao4 zhi3 shang4 da4 hua4 xue2 jia1 dai4 wei2
cues.en: Later he saw in the newspaper that the great chemist Davy

cues.zh: 招实验室助手
cues.pinyin: zhao1 shi2 yan4 shi4 zhu4 shou3
cues.en: was recruiting a lab assistant

cues.zh: 于是就来到了戴维的实验室
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 lai2 dao4 le5 dai4 wei2 de5 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: So he went to work in Davy's lab

cues.zh: 戴维问他我告诉你啊年轻人
cues.pinyin: dai4 wei2 wen4 ta1 wo3 gao4 su4 ni3 a5 nian2 qing1 ren2
cues.en: Davy asked him, "Let me tell you, young man

cues.zh: 科学是很辛苦的而且没有多少回报
cues.pinyin: ke1 xue2 shi4 hen3 xin1 ku3 de5 er2 qie3 mei2 you3 duo1 shao3 hui2 bao4
cues.en: science is very hard work and doesn't pay much

cues.zh: 你还愿意来吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 huan2 yuan4 yi4 lai2 ma5
cues.en: are you still willing to come?"

cues.zh: 法拉第当时是怎么回答的呢
cues.pinyin: fa3 la1 di4 dang1 shi2 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 da2 de5 ne5
cues.en: How did Faraday answer?

cues.zh: 他说我觉得科学本身就是一种回报
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 jue2 de5 ke1 xue2 ben3 shen1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 hui2 bao4
cues.en: He said, "I think science itself is a reward"

cues.zh: 法拉第是这么说的也是这么做的
cues.pinyin: fa3 la1 di4 shi4 zhe4 me5 shuo1 de5 ye3 shi4 zhe4 me5 zuo4 de5
cues.en: Faraday said this, and he lived by it too

cues.zh: 他把自己的全部都献给了科学
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 quan2 bu4 dou1 xian4 gei3 le5 ke1 xue2
cues.en: He devoted his entire self to science

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 终于通过自己的努力
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 tong1 guo4 zi4 ji3 de5 nu3 li4
cues.en: and eventually, through his own effort

cues.zh: 成了那个时代最伟大的科学家
cues.pinyin: cheng2 le5 na4 ge5 shi2 dai4 zui4 wei3 da4 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1
cues.en: became the greatest scientist of his era

cues.zh: 于是我对校长说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 dui4 xiao4 zhang3 shuo1
cues.en: So I said to the principal

cues.zh: 年轻人不应该把钱看得太重
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 ren2 bu4 ying1 gai1 ba3 qian2 kan4 de2 tai4 zhong4
cues.en: "Young people shouldn't value money too much

cues.zh: 更应该注重学习
cues.pinyin: geng4 ying1 gai1 zhu4 zhong4 xue2 xi2
cues.en: they should focus more on learning"

cues.zh: 人大附中能给我一个很好的学习平台
cues.pinyin: ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 neng2 gei3 wo3 yi2 ge4 hen3 hao3 de5 xue2 xi2 ping2 tai2
cues.en: "RDFZ can give me a great platform for learning

cues.zh: 在这里我可以快速地成长
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 ke3 yi3 kuai4 su4 di4 cheng2 zhang3
cues.en: Here I can grow quickly"

cues.zh: 这是我当时的心理化
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 dang1 shi2 de5 xin1 li3 hua4
cues.en: That was what was really on my mind at the time

cues.zh: 很荣幸
cues.pinyin: hen3 rong2 xing4
cues.en: It was an honor

cues.zh: 从此之后我就成为了一名人大附中的教师
cues.pinyin: cong2 ci3 zhi1 hou4 wo3 jiu4 cheng2 wei2 le5 yi1 ming2 ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 de5 jiao4 shi1
cues.en: From then on, I became a teacher at RDFZ

cues.zh: 我发现面试的时候校长对我说的话
cues.pinyin: wo3 fa1 xian4 mian4 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 xiao4 zhang3 dui4 wo3 shuo1 de5 hua4
cues.en: I found that what the principal told me at the interview

cues.zh: 他没有骗我
cues.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 pian4 wo3
cues.en: he hadn't lied to me

cues.zh: 在附中的工作非常辛苦
cues.pinyin: zai4 fu4 zhong1 de5 gong1 zuo4 fei1 chang2 xin1 ku3
cues.en: Working at RDFZ was extremely hard

cues.zh: 尤其是新老师
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 xin1 lao3 shi1
cues.en: especially for new teachers

cues.zh: 你需要不停地备课上课批改作业
cues.pinyin: ni3 xu1 yao4 bu4 ting2 di4 bei4 ke4 shang4 ke4 pi1 gai3 zuo4 ye4
cues.en: You constantly have to prepare lessons, teach, and grade homework

cues.zh: 找学生谈话
cues.pinyin: zhao3 xue2 sheng1 tan2 hua4
cues.en: and have talks with students

cues.zh: 还要经常上公开课
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 jing1 chang2 shang4 gong1 kai1 ke4
cues.en: and often give open/demonstration classes

cues.zh: 我在人大附中的前几年
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 de5 qian2 ji3 nian2
cues.en: In my first few years at RDFZ

cues.zh: 几乎都是每天备课到 12 点以后
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 dou1 shi4 mei3 tian1 bei4 ke4 dao4 12 dian3 yi3 hou4
cues.en: I prepared lessons almost every day until after midnight

cues.zh: 几年以后
cues.pinyin: ji3 nian2 yi3 hou4
cues.en: A few years later

cues.zh: 我的备课量就稍微小了一点
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 bei4 ke4 liang4 jiu4 shao1 wei1 xiao3 le5 yi4 dian3
cues.en: my lesson-prep workload got a bit lighter

cues.zh: 因为熟练了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shu2 lian4 le5
cues.en: because I'd gotten more skilled

cues.zh: 结果学校又给我安排了竞赛的任务
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 xue2 xiao4 you4 gei3 wo3 an1 pai2 le5 jing4 sai4 de5 ren4 wu4
cues.en: As a result, the school assigned me competition coaching duties

cues.zh: 被竞赛课更是辛苦
cues.pinyin: bei4 jing4 sai4 ke4 geng4 shi4 xin1 ku3
cues.en: Teaching competition classes was even more exhausting

cues.zh: 你经常备出一节课
cues.pinyin: ni3 jing1 chang2 bei4 chu1 yi1 jie2 ke4
cues.en: Often, preparing a single class

cues.zh: 就要花两三天的时间
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 hua1 liang3 san1 tian1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: would take two or three days

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 他们实现了我当初没有实现的理想
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi2 xian4 le5 wo3 dang1 chu1 mei2 you3 shi2 xian4 de5 li3 xiang3
cues.en: They achieved the dream I never got to achieve myself

cues.zh: 他们的未来比我更加辉煌
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 wei4 lai2 bi3 wo3 geng4 jia1 hui1 huang2
cues.en: Their future is even brighter than mine

cues.zh: 而且他们还记得我
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 men5 hai2 ji4 de5 wo3
cues.en: And they still remember me

cues.zh: 每当他们回到人大服中的时候
cues.pinyin: mei3 dang1 ta1 men5 hui2 dao4 ren2 da4 fu2 zhong1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Whenever they come back to visit RDFZ

cues.zh: 会给我讲他自己的所见所闻
cues.pinyin: hui4 gei3 wo3 jiang3 ta1 zi4 ji3 de5 suo3 jian4 suo3 wen2
cues.en: they tell me about what they've seen and experienced

cues.zh: 会给我带了一些小礼物
cues.pinyin: hui4 gei3 wo3 dai4 le5 yi1 xie1 xiao3 li3 wu4
cues.en: and bring me little gifts

cues.zh: 谁说做一个中学教师是没有回报的呢
cues.pinyin: shui2 shuo1 zuo4 yi2 ge4 zhong1 xue2 jiao4 shi1 shi4 mei2 you3 hui2 bao4 de5 ne5
cues.en: Who says being a middle school teacher has no reward?

cues.zh: 教师最大的财富就是学生
cues.pinyin: jiao4 shi1 zui4 da4 de5 cai2 fu4 jiu4 shi4 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: A teacher's greatest wealth is their students

cues.zh: 从这个角度上讲
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 ge5 jiao3 du4 shang4 jiang3
cues.en: From that perspective

cues.zh: 人大服中让我成了一名亿万富翁
cues.pinyin: ren2 da4 fu2 zhong1 rang4 wo3 cheng2 le5 yi1 ming2 yi4 wan4 fu4 weng1
cues.en: RDFZ made me a billionaire

cues.zh: 而且人大服中不是一所普通的中学
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ren2 da4 fu2 zhong1 bu2 shi4 yi1 suo3 pu3 tong1 de5 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: And RDFZ isn't an ordinary middle school

cues.zh: 他汇集了全北京市最好的学生
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 ji2 le5 quan2 bei3 jing1 shi4 zui4 hao3 de5 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: It gathers the best students in all of Beijing

cues.zh: 你永远不用担心自己的努力白费
cues.pinyin: ni3 yong3 yuan3 bu4 yong4 dan1 xin1 zi4 ji3 de5 nu3 li4 bai2 fei4
cues.en: You never have to worry that your hard work is wasted

cues.zh: 精心准备的课程学生听不懂
cues.pinyin: jing1 xin1 zhun3 bei4 de5 ke4 cheng2 xue2 sheng1 ting1 bu4 dong3
cues.en: on students who can't understand your carefully prepared lessons

cues.zh: 许多孩子的思维能力创造能力都比我强
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 hai2 zi5 de5 si1 wei2 neng2 li4 chuang4 zao4 neng2 li4 dou1 bi3 wo3 qiang2
cues.en: Many kids' thinking and creativity are stronger than mine

cues.zh: 人大附中也是一所开放包容的学校
cues.pinyin: ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 ye3 shi4 yi1 suo3 kai1 fang4 bao1 rong2 de5 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: RDFZ is also an open and inclusive school

cues.zh: 你不需要在学校里过多地考虑如
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 xu1 yao4 zai4 xue2 xiao4 li3 guo4 duo1 di4 kao3 lv4 ru2
cues.en: You don't need to spend much time at school thinking about

cues.zh: 何去讨好领导
cues.pinyin: he2 qu4 tao3 hao3 ling3 dao3
cues.en: how to flatter your leaders

cues.zh: 只要你的教学工作被人认可
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ni3 de5 jiao4 xue2 gong1 zuo4 bei4 ren2 ren4 ke3
cues.en: As long as your teaching work is recognized

cues.zh: 不会有任何人刁难你
cues.pinyin: bu2 hui4 you3 ren4 he2 ren2 diao1 nan4 ni3
cues.en: no one will ever make things difficult for you

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 给一个哑巴喉咙里按上两片骨头
cues.pinyin: gei3 yi2 ge4 ya3 ba5 hou2 long2 li3 an4 shang4 liang3 pian4 gu3 tou5
cues.en: Two pieces of bone were implanted in a mute boy's throat,

cues.zh: 他就能说话你敢相信吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 neng2 shuo1 hua4 ni3 gan3 xiang1 xin4 ma5
cues.en: and then he could talk — can you believe that?

cues.zh: 这个小男孩的上气管在子宫内
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao3 nan2 hai2 de5 shang4 qi4 guan3 zai4 zi5 gong1 nei4
cues.en: This boy's upper airway was already

cues.zh: 就被发育完全
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bei4 fa1 yu4 wan2 quan2
cues.en: fully formed while he was still in the womb.

cues.zh: 上呼吸道被完全阻塞导致他完全没有喉部
cues.pinyin: shang4 hu1 xi1 dao4 bei4 wan2 quan2 zu3 se4 dao3 zhi4 ta1 wan2 quan2 mei2 you3 hou2 bu4
cues.en: His upper airway was completely blocked, leaving him with no larynx at all.

cues.zh: 是在脖子里插一根气管他才能呼吸
cues.pinyin: shi4 zai4 bo2 zi5 li3 cha1 yi1 gen1 qi4 guan3 ta1 cai2 neng2 hu1 xi1
cues.en: A tube had to be inserted into his neck just for him to breathe.

cues.zh: 不过这会反复引起感染和肺炎
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zhe4 hui4 fan3 fu4 yin3 qi3 gan3 ran3 he2 fei4 yan2
cues.en: But this kept causing repeated infections and pneumonia.

cues.zh: 今天小男孩来医院就是来检查看看
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 xiao3 nan2 hai2 lai2 yi1 yuan4 jiu4 shi4 lai2 jian3 cha2 kan4 kan4
cues.en: Today the boy came to the hospital just for a checkup,

cues.zh: 有没有感染的
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 gan3 ran3 de5
cues.en: to see if he had any infection.

cues.zh: 医生给他的父母带来了一个好消息
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gei3 ta1 de5 fu4 mu3 dai4 lai2 le5 yi2 ge4 hao3 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: The doctor brought his parents some good news.

cues.zh: 他不仅没有感染
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 jin3 mei2 you3 gan3 ran3
cues.en: Not only did he have no infection,

cues.zh: 而且还十分符合他们的一个实验手术
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 shi2 fen1 fu2 he2 ta1 men5 de5 yi2 ge4 shi2 yan4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: he was also a great match for an experimental surgery they were doing.

cues.zh: 他们可以帮助小男孩切除伤疤组织
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 bang1 zhu4 xiao3 nan2 hai2 qie1 chu2 shang1 ba1 zu3 zhi1
cues.en: They could help the boy remove the scar tissue

cues.zh: 并打开气道
cues.pinyin: bing4 da3 kai1 qi4 dao4
cues.en: and open up his airway.

cues.zh: 虽然不能让他说话
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 bu4 neng2 rang4 ta1 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: Although it wouldn't let him speak,

cues.zh: 但是可以不借助气管就正常呼吸
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ke3 yi3 bu4 jie4 zhu4 qi4 guan3 jiu4 zheng4 chang2 hu1 xi1
cues.en: he could breathe normally without needing a tracheostomy tube.

cues.zh: 虽然这个手术很复杂
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 hen3 fu4 za2
cues.en: Although the surgery was very complex,

cues.zh: 但是鉴于小男孩长期以来面对的感染风险
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jian4 yu2 xiao3 nan2 hai2 chang2 qi1 yi3 lai2 mian4 dui4 de5 gan3 ran3 feng1 xian3
cues.en: given the long-term infection risk the boy faced,

cues.zh: 这绝对是最好的选择
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jue2 dui4 shi4 zui4 hao3 de5 xuan3 ze2
cues.en: this was definitely the best option.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 小男孩和他的父母心动了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nan2 hai2 he2 ta1 de5 fu4 mu3 xin1 dong4 le5
cues.en: The boy and his parents were swayed.

cues.zh: 同意做这个手术
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi4 zuo4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: They agreed to have the surgery.

cues.zh: 医生们先把小男孩清理阻塞物
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 xian1 ba3 xiao3 nan2 hai2 qing1 li3 zu3 se4 wu4
cues.en: The doctors first cleared out the blockage,

cues.zh: 不过实际操作中发现阻塞程度
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 shi2 ji4 cao1 zuo4 zhong1 fa1 xian4 zu3 se4 cheng2 du4
cues.en: but during the actual operation they found the blockage

cues.zh: 要比影像中的大
cues.pinyin: yao4 bi3 ying3 xiang4 zhong1 de5 da4
cues.en: was worse than what the imaging had shown.

cues.zh: 但并没有多大影响
cues.pinyin: dan4 bing4 mei2 you3 duo1 da4 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: But it didn't make much difference.

cues.zh: 做了缝合之后
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 feng2 he2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After they finished the sutures,

cues.zh: 手术就结束了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jiu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: the surgery was over.

cues.zh: 医生用手指堵住气管
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 yong4 shou3 zhi3 du3 zhu4 qi4 guan3
cues.en: The doctor blocked the tube opening with his finger,

cues.zh: 小男孩尝试着呼吸
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nan2 hai2 chang2 shi4 zhe5 hu1 xi1
cues.en: and the boy tried to breathe.

cues.zh: 成功了
cues.pinyin: cheng2 gong1 le5
cues.en: It worked.

cues.zh: 小男孩可以不用再借助气管呼吸了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nan2 hai2 ke3 yi3 bu4 yong4 zai4 jie4 zhu4 qi4 guan3 hu1 xi1 le5
cues.en: The boy no longer needed the tube to breathe.

cues.zh: 他用手语告诉大家
cues.pinyin: ta1 yong4 shou3 yu3 gao4 su4 da4 jia1
cues.en: He told everyone in sign language

cues.zh: 虽然有点疼
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 you3 dian3 teng2
cues.en: that although it hurt a little,

cues.zh: 但是从未感觉这么好
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 cong2 wei4 gan3 jue2 zhe4 me5 hao3
cues.en: he'd never felt this good before.

cues.zh: 所有人都为他高兴
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 ren2 dou1 wei4 ta1 gao1 xing4
cues.en: Everyone was happy for him,

cues.zh: 但是肖恩除外
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao4 en1 chu2 wai4
cues.en: except for Shaun.

cues.zh: 他从男孩身上看到了自己
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 nan2 hai2 shen1 shang4 kan4 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: He saw himself in the boy —

cues.zh: 那个因为自闭症
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 yin1 wei4 zi4 bi4 zheng4
cues.en: the self who, because of autism,

cues.zh: 无法正常交流的自己
cues.pinyin: wu2 fa3 zheng4 chang2 jiao1 liu2 de5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: couldn't communicate normally.

cues.zh: 肖恩并不满足于小男孩能正常呼吸
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 bing4 bu4 man3 zu2 yu2 xiao3 nan2 hai2 neng2 zheng4 chang2 hu1 xi1
cues.en: Shaun wasn't satisfied with just the boy breathing normally;

cues.zh: 更想让他开口说话
cues.pinyin: geng4 xiang3 rang4 ta1 kai1 kou3 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: he wanted the boy to be able to speak.

cues.zh: 他连饭都不吃了
cues.pinyin: ta1 lian2 fan4 dou1 bu4 chi1 le5
cues.en: He stopped eating

cues.zh: 去找资料
cues.pinyin: qu4 zhao3 zi1 liao4
cues.en: and went off to research it.

cues.zh: 终于在第二天中午的时候
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 zai4 di4 er4 tian1 zhong1 wu3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Finally, around noon the next day,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 可父母依旧不同意
cues.pinyin: ke3 fu4 mu3 yi1 jiu4 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: the parents still wouldn't agree.

cues.zh: 他们可以通过手语交流
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 tong1 guo4 shou3 yu3 jiao1 liu2
cues.en: They could communicate through sign language,

cues.zh: 你们是大错特错
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 shi4 da4 cuo4 te4 cuo4
cues.en: [Shaun said] you are completely wrong —

cues.zh: 他会永远受到限制
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 yong3 yuan3 shou4 dao4 xian4 zhi4
cues.en: he'll always be limited.

cues.zh: 他很难交朋友
cues.pinyin: ta1 hen3 nan2 jiao1 peng2 you3
cues.en: He'll have a hard time making friends

cues.zh: 很难和陌生人沟通
cues.pinyin: hen3 nan2 he2 mo4 sheng1 ren2 gou1 tong1
cues.en: and a hard time talking to strangers.

cues.zh: 肖恩这番话说的没错
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhe4 fan1 hua4 shuo1 de5 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: What Shaun said turned out to be right.

cues.zh: 男孩告诉父母
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 gao4 su4 fu4 mu3
cues.en: The boy told his parents

cues.zh: 他在学校确实很难和同学们交流
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 xue2 xiao4 que4 shi2 hen3 nan2 he2 tong2 xue2 men5 jiao1 liu2
cues.en: that he really did struggle to talk with classmates at school

cues.zh: 也很难交朋友
cues.pinyin: ye3 hen3 nan2 jiao1 peng2 you3
cues.en: and struggled to make friends.

cues.zh: 他并不想被人忽视
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 bu4 xiang3 bei4 ren2 hu1 shi4
cues.en: He didn't want to be overlooked.

cues.zh: 他想能说话
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 neng2 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: He wanted to be able to speak.

cues.zh: 这些事情他在此之前从来没说过
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 shi4 qing2 ta1 zai4 ci3 zhi1 qian2 cong2 lai2 mei2 shuo1 guo4
cues.en: He had never said any of this before.

cues.zh: 而现在父母因为他的遭遇犹豫了
cues.pinyin: er2 xian4 zai4 fu4 mu3 yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 zao1 yu4 you2 yu4 le5
cues.en: Now, because of what he'd been through, his parents hesitated,

cues.zh: 最终决定给男孩做手术
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 jue2 ding4 gei3 nan2 hai2 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and finally decided to let the boy have the surgery.

cues.zh: 医生们将男孩软肋骨的一部分取出
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 jiang1 nan2 hai2 ruan3 lei4 gu3 de5 yi1 bu4 fen4 qu3 chu1
cues.en: The doctors removed part of the boy's rib cartilage,

cues.zh: 然后将他们打磨成合适的形状和大
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiang1 ta1 men5 da3 mo2 cheng2 he2 shi4 de5 xing2 zhuang4 he2 da4
cues.en: then ground it down to the right shape and

cues.zh: 小组装在一起
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zu3 zhuang1 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: size, and assembled the pieces together

cues.zh: 代替喉布放进合适的位置
cues.pinyin: dai4 ti4 hou2 bu4 fang4 jin4 he2 shi4 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: to replace the larynx and put it in the right position.

cues.zh: 可是在最后关头
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 zui4 hou4 guan1 tou2
cues.en: But at the very last moment,

cues.zh: 检测器突然发出警报声
cues.pinyin: jian3 ce4 qi4 tu1 ran2 fa1 chu1 jing3 bao4 sheng1
cues.en: the monitor suddenly sounded an alarm.

cues.zh: 男孩血压垂直下降
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 xue4 ya1 chui2 zhi2 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: The boy's blood pressure dropped sharply,

cues.zh: 手术部位大量出血
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 bu4 wei4 da4 liang4 chu1 xie3
cues.en: and the surgical site was bleeding heavily,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 而且他们找不到出血点
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 men5 zhao3 bu2 dao4 chu1 xie3 dian3
cues.en: and they couldn't find where the bleeding was coming from.

cues.zh: 主任让黄姐用止血钳夹住静脉
cues.pinyin: zhu3 ren4 rang4 huang2 jie3 yong4 zhi3 xue4 qian2 jia1 zhu4 jing4 mai4
cues.en: The attending told Dr. Huang to clamp the vein with hemostatic forceps,

cues.zh: 但是依旧没有用
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 jiu4 mei2 you3 yong4
cues.en: but it still didn't help.

cues.zh: 最后主任意识到
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zhu3 ren4 yi4 shi2 dao4
cues.en: Finally the attending realized

cues.zh: 是在拉钩时用了一根损伤的静脉壶
cues.pinyin: shi4 zai4 la1 gou1 shi2 yong4 le5 yi1 gen1 sun3 shang1 de5 jing4 mai4 hu2
cues.en: a vein had been damaged while retracting with the hook —

cues.zh: 连接了左右颈静脉
cues.pinyin: lian2 jie1 le5 zuo3 you4 jing3 jing4 mai4
cues.en: one connecting the left and right jugular veins.

cues.zh: 于是立刻让肖恩用线
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 li4 ke4 rang4 xiao4 en1 yong4 xian4
cues.en: So he immediately had Shaun use thread

cues.zh: 在血口两端打个双重结
cues.pinyin: zai4 xue4 kou3 liang3 duan1 da3 ge4 shuang1 chong2 jie2
cues.en: to tie a double knot at both ends of the wound.

cues.zh: 男孩情况稳定下来了
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 qing2 kuang4 wen3 ding4 xia4 lai2 le5
cues.en: The boy's condition stabilized.

cues.zh: 手术结束后
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 hou4
cues.en: After the surgery was over,

cues.zh: 黄姐教男孩如何发声
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 jiao4 nan2 hai2 ru2 he2 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: Dr. Huang taught the boy how to make sounds.

cues.zh: 男孩试着去做
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 shi4 zhe5 qu4 zuo4
cues.en: The boy tried it.

cues.zh: 虽然只能用喉部发出模糊的呃呃声
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zhi3 neng2 yong4 hou2 bu4 fa1 chu1 mo2 hu2 de5 e4 e4 sheng1
cues.en: Although he could only make a vague, muffled "uh-uh" with his throat,

cues.zh: 但爸爸却说
cues.pinyin: dan4 ba4 ba4 que4 shuo1
cues.en: his father said

cues.zh: 这是他听过最动人的声音
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ta1 ting1 guo4 zui4 dong4 ren2 de5 sheng1 yin1
cues.en: it was the most moving sound he'd ever heard.

cues.zh: 手术十分成功
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shi2 fen1 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: The surgery was a total success.

cues.zh: 这是一个奇迹
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 qi2 ji4
cues.en: It was a miracle.

cues.zh: 男孩向肖恩表达了感谢
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 xiang4 xiao4 en1 biao3 da2 le5 gan3 xie4
cues.en: The boy thanked Shaun,

cues.zh: 他拯救了自己未来的人生
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng3 jiu4 le5 zi4 ji3 wei4 lai2 de5 ren2 sheng1
cues.en: saying he had saved his future.

cues.zh: 另一边
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 大钟和布朗接收了一个昏迷的女消防员
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 he2 bu4 lang3 jie1 shou1 le5 yi2 ge4 hun1 mi2 de5 nv3 xiao1 fang2 yuan2
cues.en: Dr. Dazhong and Browne took in an unconscious female firefighter,

cues.zh: 小美
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3
cues.en: Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 她被一只狗袭击了
cues.pinyin: ta1 bei4 yi1 zhi1 gou3 xi2 ji1 le5
cues.en: She had been attacked by a dog.

cues.zh: 左臂被撕咬得血弱模糊
cues.pinyin: zuo3 bi4 bei4 si1 yao3 de2 xue4 ruo4 mo2 hu2
cues.en: Her left arm was torn up and bloody.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 稳定骨盒碎片
cues.pinyin: wen3 ding4 gu3 he2 sui4 pian4
cues.en: They stabilized the bone fragments

cues.zh: 并且还植入了血管
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 hai2 zhi2 ru4 le5 xue4 guan3
cues.en: and also grafted in blood vessels.

cues.zh: 结束后小美移植的皮肤和软组织似
cues.pinyin: jie2 shu4 hou4 xiao3 mei3 yi2 zhi2 de5 pi2 fu1 he2 ruan3 zu3 zhi1 shi4
cues.en: Afterward, Xiaomei's transplanted skin and soft tissue seemed

cues.zh: 乎固定的很好
cues.pinyin: hu1 gu4 ding4 de5 hen3 hao3
cues.en: to be holding well,

cues.zh: 而且切口部分看起来不错
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 qie1 kou3 bu4 fen4 kan4 qi3 lai2 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: and the incision looked good too.

cues.zh: 医生们成功重新接上了二头肌
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 cheng2 gong1 chong2 xin1 jie1 shang4 le5 er4 tou2 ji1
cues.en: The doctors successfully reattached the biceps

cues.zh: 的肌肉和肌腱
cues.pinyin: de5 ji1 rou4 he2 ji1 jian4
cues.en: muscle and tendon.

cues.zh: 只不过良好的术后情况好像只体现在表面
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 liang2 hao3 de5 shu4 hou4 qing2 kuang4 hao3 xiang4 zhi3 ti3 xian4 zai4 biao3 mian4
cues.en: But the good post-op signs seemed to be only on the surface —

cues.zh: 小美的胳膊没有感觉
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 ge1 bo2 mei2 you3 gan3 jue2
cues.en: Xiaomei had no feeling in her arm.

cues.zh: 梅医生布朗和大钟在办公室讨
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 bu4 lang3 he2 da4 zhong1 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 tao3
cues.en: Dr. Mei, Browne, and Dr. Dazhong discussed

cues.zh: 论小美的情况
cues.pinyin: lun4 xiao3 mei3 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Xiaomei's case in the office.

cues.zh: 缝合恢复的不错
cues.pinyin: feng2 he2 hui1 fu4 de5 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: The wound had healed up well.

cues.zh: 应该是在骨头和肌肉之间的神
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 zai4 gu3 tou5 he2 ji1 rou4 zhi1 jian1 de5 shen2
cues.en: It must be that the nerve between the bone and the muscle

cues.zh: 经受到了压迫
cues.pinyin: jing1 shou4 dao4 le5 ya1 po4
cues.en: was being compressed.

cues.zh: 这跨度太大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 kua4 du4 tai4 da4
cues.en: But the gap was too large

cues.zh: 难以用移植恢复
cues.pinyin: nan2 yi3 yong4 yi2 zhi2 hui1 fu4
cues.en: to fix with a graft.

cues.zh: 大家提议
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 ti2 yi4
cues.en: The team suggested

cues.zh: 用硅胶和锯胰胶纸做一个神经导管
cues.pinyin: yong4 gui1 jiao1 he2 ju4 yi2 jiao1 zhi3 zuo4 yi2 ge4 shen2 jing1 dao3 guan3
cues.en: making a nerve conduit out of silicone and a biodegradable polymer,

cues.zh: 用来引导断端神经末梢朝着彼此生长
cues.pinyin: yong4 lai2 yin3 dao3 duan4 duan1 shen2 jing1 mo4 shao1 chao2 zhe5 bi3 ci3 sheng1 zhang3
cues.en: to guide the nerve endings at each severed end to grow toward each other,

cues.zh: 让神经沿着通路生长
cues.pinyin: rang4 shen2 jing1 yan2 zhe5 tong1 lu4 sheng1 zhang3
cues.en: letting the nerve grow along the pathway

cues.zh: 并连接起来
cues.pinyin: bing4 lian2 jie1 qi3 lai2
cues.en: and reconnect.

cues.zh: 这样有风险
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 you3 feng1 xian3
cues.en: It was risky,

cues.zh: 但值得一试
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhi2 de5 yi1 shi4
cues.en: but worth a try.

cues.zh: 主管梅医生同意了
cues.pinyin: zhu3 guan3 mei2 yi1 sheng1 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: Attending physician Dr. Mei agreed.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 手术很成功
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 hen3 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: The surgery was a success.

cues.zh: 之后小美的力气可能会变小
cues.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 xiao3 mei3 de5 li4 qi4 ke3 neng2 hui4 bian4 xiao3
cues.en: Afterward, Xiaomei's strength might decrease a little,

cues.zh: 但绝对不会影响到正常工作
cues.pinyin: dan4 jue2 dui4 bu2 hui4 ying3 xiang3 dao4 zheng4 chang2 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: but it definitely wouldn't affect her normal work.

cues.zh: 而另一边
cues.pinyin: er2 ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 肖恩被分手了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 bei4 fen1 shou3 le5
cues.en: Shaun got dumped.

cues.zh: 这又是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 you4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: So what happened there?

cues.zh: 之前因为肖恩和丽雅
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 yin1 wei4 xiao4 en1 he2 li4 ya3
cues.en: Earlier, because Shaun and Lea

cues.zh: 一起去看父亲的事情
cues.pinyin: yi4 qi3 qu4 kan4 fu4 qin1 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: went together to deal with his father,

cues.zh: 让小丽有些伤心
cues.pinyin: rang4 xiao3 li4 you3 xie1 shang1 xin1
cues.en: it upset Lea a bit,

cues.zh: 俩人出现了嫌隙
cues.pinyin: lia3 ren2 chu1 xian4 le5 xian2 xi4
cues.en: and a rift grew between them.

cues.zh: 但后来肖恩让丽雅这个室友
cues.pinyin: dan4 hou4 lai2 xiao4 en1 rang4 li4 ya3 zhe4 ge5 shi4 you3
cues.en: But later, Shaun had Lea's roommate

cues.zh: 搬出了出租屋
cues.pinyin: ban1 chu1 le5 chu1 zu1 wu1
cues.en: move out of the rented apartment,

cues.zh: 再加上偶尔的谈心
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 shang4 ou3 er3 de5 tan2 xin1
cues.en: and with a few heart-to-heart talks,

cues.zh: 肖恩和小丽又恢复如初
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 he2 xiao3 li4 you4 hui1 fu4 ru2 chu1
cues.en: Shaun and Lea went back to normal.

cues.zh: 尽管丽雅到了医院任职
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 li4 ya3 dao4 le5 yi1 yuan4 ren4 zhi2
cues.en: Even though Lea started working at the hospital

cues.zh: 和肖恩经常见面
cues.pinyin: he2 xiao4 en1 jing1 chang2 jian4 mian4
cues.en: and saw Shaun often,

cues.zh: 肖丽雅依旧觉得没关系
cues.pinyin: xiao4 li4 ya3 yi1 jiu4 jue2 de5 mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: Shaun and Lea still felt it was fine.

cues.zh: 可是这天
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 tian1
cues.en: But one day,

cues.zh: 俩人一起去酒吧放松时
cues.pinyin: lia3 ren2 yi4 qi3 qu4 jiu3 ba1 fang4 song1 shi2
cues.en: when the two of them went to a bar to relax,

cues.zh: 碰见了丽雅和她的男朋友
cues.pinyin: peng4 jian4 le5 li4 ya3 he2 ta1 de5 nan2 peng2 you3
cues.en: they ran into Lea and her boyfriend.

cues.zh: 丽雅性格活泼跳脱
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 xing4 ge2 huo2 po1 tiao4 tuo1
cues.en: Lea, who's lively and unrestrained by nature,

cues.zh: 彻底打乱了这对小情侣之间暧昧的气氛
cues.pinyin: che4 di3 da3 luan4 le5 zhe4 dui4 xiao3 qing2 lv3 zhi1 jian1 ai4 mei4 de5 qi4 fen1
cues.en: completely broke the romantic mood between the couple.

cues.zh: 但是没什么大不了的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei2 shen2 me5 da4 bu4 liao3 de5
cues.en: But it wasn't a big deal —

cues.zh: 萧恩他们并没有很介意
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 ta1 men5 bing4 mei2 you3 hen3 jie4 yi4
cues.en: Shaun and the others didn't mind much.

cues.zh: 他们还一起上台
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hai2 yi4 qi3 shang4 tai2
cues.en: They even went up on stage together.
